## misc/s06_map_Hgg_local.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-57", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 21809, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s06_map_Hgg_local.wls", "sha256": "5c5df1555ef2bd27cddf563f945ce9babeacfeb0b99ad7e6a6140801745fe8d7"} -->
```wolfram
(* Authorized one-kernel execution of the accepted Hgg scalar map. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
localRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[localRoot];
root=localRoot;channel="Hgg";checks=<||>;
localSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s06_map_Hgg_local.wls"}];
localConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s06_inputs.json"}];
localConfig=Import[localConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
localWork=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s06_work"}];
localOutput=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s06_result"}];
gate[name_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],If[!KeyExistsQ[checks,name],Print["PASS: ",name]];
 AssociateTo[checks,name->True],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,3600,
 gate["time bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]],4*1024^3,
 gate["operation memory bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]];
zero[value_]:=Factor[Together[value]]===0;
gate["explicit authorized single local kernel",Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED"]==="1"&&$VersionNumber===15.];
gate["bound complete local source",SyntaxQ[ReadString[localSource]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===localConfig["source_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative,identity},gate["pinned input "<>relative,
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"],16,64]===identity]],localConfig["input_sha256"]];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
localNativeVersions={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion};
readAccepted[relative_,receiptName_:"s08_execution.json"]:=Module[{path,receipt,result},
 path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],receiptName}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted receipt "<>relative,TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
  receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 result=bounded[Get[path],{"accepted native input",relative}];
 gate["accepted checks "<>relative,AssociationQ[result]&&AssociationQ[result["Checks"]]&&
  Length[result["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[result["Checks"]]];result];
record=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_mapping_inputs_result/s08_component_0008.wl","s08_recovery_execution.json"];
gate["own complete Hgg native input",record["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-native-mapping-input-v1"&&
 record["Channel"]===channel&&record["Component"]===8];
importedNativeVersions=record["NativeVersions"];
gate["same FeynCalc serialization version",Last[importedNativeVersions]===FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion];
inputHashes=record["InputHashes"];targetInputHash=record["TargetInputHash"];
coordinateRules=record["CoordinateRules"];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative,identity},gate["unchanged scientific input "<>relative,
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"]===identity]],inputHashes];
geometry=record["Geometry"];denominators=record["Denominators"];
directions=record["Directions"];families=record["Families"];familyNames=Keys[families];
sourceBlock[relative_,first_,last_]:=Module[{text,begin,end,block},
 text=ReadString[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}]];begin=StringPosition[text,first];end=StringPosition[text,last];
 gate["unique reviewed source block "<>relative,Length[begin]===1&&Length[end]===1];
 block=StringTake[text,{First[First[begin]],First[First[end]]-1}];
 gate["complete source block syntax "<>relative,SyntaxQ[block]];block];
ToExpression[sourceBlock["common/s08_result/reference/s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls",
 "\nmerge[pieces_List]","\ncoefficientPath ="],InputForm];
gate["exact own original mapping definitions",{DownValues[mapExpression],DownValues[familyRows],DownValues[merge]}===
 Lookup[record,{"OriginalMappingDefinitions","OriginalFamilyDefinitions","OriginalMergeDefinitions"}]];
DownValues[certifyPairMerge]=record["MergeCertificateDefinitions"];
DownValues[certifyGroupMerge]=record["GroupMergeDefinitions"];
DownValues[pairReconstruct]=record["ReconstructionDefinitions"];
polynomial=readAccepted["Hqg/s08_polynomial_group_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted reusable polynomial contract",TrueQ[polynomial["Accepted"]]&&TrueQ[polynomial["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 polynomial["NativeVersions"]===importedNativeVersions&&polynomial["OriginalFamilyDefinitions"]===DownValues[familyRows]&&
 KeyDrop[polynomial["InputHashes"],"Hqg/s05_result/s05_result.wl"]===KeyDrop[inputHashes,"Hgg/s05_result/s05_result.wl"]];
DownValues[familyRows]=polynomial["CandidateFamilyDefinitions"];
polynomialVariables=polynomial["PolynomialVariables"];
DownValues[polynomialAdditivePieces]=polynomial["AdditivePiecesDefinitions"];
DownValues[polynomialPieceMap]=polynomial["PieceMappingDefinitions"];
DownValues[localOriginalSave]=polynomial["PieceStorageDefinitions"]/.saveNative->localOriginalSave;
gate["unchanged exact native writer",(DownValues[localOriginalSave]/.localOriginalSave->saveNative)===polynomial["PieceStorageDefinitions"]];
pieceScientificHash=Hash[{polynomial["PieceScientificHash"],targetInputHash,
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_map_Hgg_factored_inputs.wls"}],"SHA256"]},"SHA256"];
sameOwnContract[proof_]:=proof["NativeVersions"]===importedNativeVersions&&
 proof["InputHashes"]===inputHashes&&proof["TargetInputHash"]===targetInputHash&&TrueQ[proof["OwnAcceptedComparison"]];
atom=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_factored_atom_certificate_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted exact atom implementation",sameOwnContract[atom]&&atom["OriginalExtractionDefinitions"]===DownValues[extractAtoms]&&
 atom["OriginalGroupingCertificateDefinitions"]===record["GroupingCertificateDefinitions"]];
atomVariables=atom["Variables"];DownValues[factoredAtoms]=atom["FactoredExtractionDefinitions"];
DownValues[extractAtoms]=atom["DispatchDefinitions"];
DownValues[factoredAtomCertificate]=atom["AtomCertificateDefinitions"];
DownValues[certifyGrouping]=atom["GroupingCertificateDefinitions"];Clear[atom];ClearSystemCache[];
scalar=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_scalar_certificate_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted exact scalar certificates",sameOwnContract[scalar]&&TrueQ[scalar["ActualAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 scalar["OriginalFamilyDefinitions"]===DownValues[familyRows]&&scalar["OriginalMappingDefinitions"]===DownValues[mapExpression]];
DownValues[familyRows]=scalar["FamilyDefinitions"];DownValues[mapExpression]=scalar["MappingDefinitions"];
DownValues[certifyFamilyLaurent]=scalar["FamilyCertificateDefinitions"];
DownValues[certifyScalarReconstruction]=scalar["MappingCertificateDefinitions"];Clear[scalar];
compact=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_compact_groups_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted compact grouping contract",sameOwnContract[compact]&&Length[compact["CandidateDefinitions"]]===2];
DownValues[hggOriginalGrouping]=First[compact["CandidateDefinitions"]];
DownValues[groupDenominators]=DownValues[hggOriginalGrouping]/.hggOriginalGrouping->groupDenominators;
DownValues[groupedMapExpression]=Last[compact["CandidateDefinitions"]]/.mapExpression->polynomialPieceMap;
gate["only accepted piece mapper installed",(DownValues[groupedMapExpression]/.polynomialPieceMap->mapExpression)===Last[compact["CandidateDefinitions"]]];
external=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_external_factor_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted exact external-factor implementation",sameOwnContract[external]&&TrueQ[external["ActualAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 {DownValues[mapExpression],DownValues[familyRows],DownValues[merge]}===
 Lookup[external,{"OriginalMappingDefinitions","FamilyDefinitions","MergeDefinitions"}]];
externalVariables=external["Variables"];externalEvidence={};externalFallbackCount=0;
DownValues[externalAtomCompatible]=external["CompatibilityDefinitions"];
DownValues[externalSplit]=external["SplitDefinitions"];
DownValues[externalFactorMap]=external["FactorMappingDefinitions"];
DownValues[externalOriginalMap]=external["OriginalAliasDefinitions"];
DownValues[mapExpression]=external["MappingDefinitions"];
controlReference=external["OwnCoefficients"];Clear[external,polynomial,compact];ClearSystemCache[];
ToExpression[sourceBlock["common/s08_resume_Hqg_polynomial_maps.wls",
 "\nnumericOuterFactor[expression_]","\ninstallNumericPhase[]"],InputForm];
reader=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_response_read_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted input reader native version",reader["NativeVersions"]===importedNativeVersions&&TrueQ[reader["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]];
DownValues[responseOnlyRead]=reader["ReaderDefinitions"];Clear[reader];
inputFunctions=sourceBlock["common/s08_map_Hgg_component_inputs.wls","\nhggInitializeTasks[]","\nhggBaselinePath ="];
gate["unique accepted payload read",StringCount[inputFunctions,"Get[path]"]===1];
inputFunctions=StringReplace[inputFunctions,"Get[path]"->"responseOnlyRead[path,row[\"Payload\"][\"Hash\"]]"];
gate["complete single-component reader syntax",SyntaxQ[inputFunctions]];ToExpression[inputFunctions,InputForm];
spin=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s05_result","s05_metadata.wl"}]];
gate["accepted complete metadata",spin["Channel"]===channel&&And@@Values[spin["Checks"]]];
hggInitializeTasks[];
localSelectedTaskValue[index_]:=Module[{row,path,text,held,shapes,shape,manifest,slots,pieceIndex,
 oldResponse,newResponse,oldCDR,newCDR,location,literal,candidate,packet,positions,selected},
 row=hggTaskSources[[index]];path=FileNameJoin[{localRoot,row["Payload"]["File"]}];
 gate["selected input exact native identity",FileHash[path,"SHA256"]===row["Payload"]["Hash"]];
 text=ReadString[path];
 If[!StringContainsQ[text,"response=ArrayReshape[Table[readPiece[k]"],Return[hggTaskValue[index]]];
 gate["selected piece belongs to response",row["Field"]==="Response"];
 held=ToExpression[text,InputForm,HoldComplete];
 shapes=Cases[held,HoldPattern[ArrayReshape[_,shape_List]]:>shape,Infinity];
 gate["unique saved response shape",Length[shapes]===1&&AllTrue[First[shapes],IntegerQ[#]&&#>0&]];shape=First[shapes];
 manifest=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],"s05_payload_manifest.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted exact piecewise serialization",TrueQ[manifest["exact_round_trip"]]&&
  manifest["result_sha256"]===IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  manifest["storage_source_sha256"]===IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{localRoot,"common","s05_project_Hgg_piecewise_storage.wls"}],"SHA256"],16,64]];
 slots=Range[2,Length[manifest["piece_groups"]]-1];
 gate["complete stored response slot count",Length[slots]===Times@@shape];
 pieceIndex=Extract[ArrayReshape[slots,shape],row["Index"]];
 positions=Tuples[Range/@shape];
 gate["selected read matches original writer ordering",positions[[pieceIndex-1]]===row["Index"]&&
  Extract[ArrayReshape[localStoredEntry/@slots,shape],row["Index"]]===localStoredEntry[pieceIndex]];
 oldResponse="response=ArrayReshape[Table[readPiece[k],{k,2,Length[groups]-1}],"<>ToString[shape,InputForm]<>"];";
 newResponse="response=ArrayReshape[Table[If[k==="<>ToString[pieceIndex,InputForm]<>",readPiece[k],Missing[\"EntryNotRequested\"]],{k,2,Length[groups]-1}],"<>ToString[shape,InputForm]<>"];";
 oldCDR="cdr=readPiece[Length[groups]];";newCDR="cdr=Missing[\"CDRNotRequested\"];";
 location="DirectoryName[$InputFileName]";literal=ToString[DirectoryName[path],InputForm];
 gate["exact selected-reader interfaces",StringCount[text,oldResponse]===1&&StringCount[text,oldCDR]===1&&
  StringCount[text,location]===1&&StringCount[text,literal]===0];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,{oldResponse->newResponse,oldCDR->newCDR,location->literal}];
 gate["all native payload identity checks retained",SyntaxQ[candidate]&&
  StringReplace[candidate,{newResponse->oldResponse,newCDR->oldCDR,literal->location}]===text];
 packet=bounded[ToExpression[candidate,InputForm],{"selected native entry",index}];
 gate["selected response retains original metadata",AssociationQ[packet]&&packet["Channel"]===channel&&
  packet["Component"]===First[hggTaskMetadata[[index]]["Index"]]&&
  Rest[hggTaskMetadata[[index]]["Index"]]===row["Index"]&&packet["NativeVersions"]===importedNativeVersions&&
  And@@Values[packet["Checks"]]&&packet["StorageDispatchHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{localRoot,"common","s05_project_Hgg_piecewise_storage.wls"}],"SHA256"]];
 selected=Extract[packet["Response"],row["Index"]];
 gate["only requested response entry decompressed",!MissingQ[selected]&&
  Count[Flatten[packet["Response"]],_Missing]===Length[slots]-1&&MissingQ[packet["CDRPhotonCoefficient"]]];
 Print["LOCAL_SELECTED_ENTRY_BYTES ",index," ",ByteCount[selected]];selected];
gate["own native task identity",hggTaskMetadata[[8]]===record["Task"]];
gate["selected components exist",AllTrue[localConfig["components"],IntegerQ[#]&&1<=#<=Length[tasks]&]&&DuplicateFreeQ[localConfig["components"]]];
reduction=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s06_result","reference","s04_result.wl"}]]/.{Q2->Q^2,w->s23};
gate["accepted original scalar reduction",TrueQ[reduction["Accepted"]]];ruleKeys=First/@reduction["Rules"];
groupInputHash=Hash[{FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_map_Hgg_factored_inputs.wls"}],"SHA256"],
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgq","s08_certified_denominator_result","s08_result.wl"}],"SHA256"],
 inputHashes,targetInputHash,record["Component"],Hash[record["Expression"],"SHA256"],
 Sequence@@importedNativeVersions},"SHA256"];
gate["scientific group identity matches imported checkpoints",IntegerString[groupInputHash,16]===localConfig["group_input_hash"]];
localExecutionIdentity=Hash[{FileHash[localSource,"SHA256"],FileHash[localConfigPath,"SHA256"],localNativeVersions},"SHA256"];
localProvenance=<|"ExecutionBackend"->"local","NativeVersions"->localNativeVersions,
 "ImportedNativeVersions"->importedNativeVersions,"LocalSourceHash"->FileHash[localSource,"SHA256"],
 "LocalConfigurationHash"->FileHash[localConfigPath,"SHA256"],"ExecutionIdentity"->localExecutionIdentity|>;
saveNative[value_,path_]:=localOriginalSave[Join[value,<|"ExecutionProvenance"->localProvenance|>],path];
put[value_,path_]:=saveNative[value,path];
Do[If[!DirectoryQ[dir],CreateDirectory[dir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]],{dir,{localWork,localOutput}}];
If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_PREFLIGHT"]==="1",
 preflightInput=localSelectedTaskValue[First[localConfig["components"]]];
 gate["actual selected native artifact read",FreeQ[preflightInput,_Missing]];
 Print["PASS: local Hgg complete interface preflight"];Quit[0]];
controlPath=FileNameJoin[{localOutput,"s06_control.wl"}];
controlSaved=If[FileExistsQ[controlPath],Get[controlPath],<||>];
controlCompatible=Lookup[controlSaved,"ExecutionIdentity",None]===localExecutionIdentity&&TrueQ[Lookup[controlSaved,"OwnAcceptedComparison",False]];
If[!controlCompatible,
 priorDirectory=FileNameJoin[{localOutput,"reference","full_response_attempt"}];
 priorSourcePath=FileNameJoin[{priorDirectory,"s06_map_Hgg_local.wls"}];
 priorReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{priorDirectory,"s06_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 priorConfiguration=Import[FileNameJoin[{priorDirectory,"s06_inputs.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 priorControlPath=FileNameJoin[{priorDirectory,"s06_control.wl"}];priorControl=Get[priorControlPath];
 priorText=ReadString[priorSourcePath];currentText=ReadString[localSource];
 unchangedSection[text_,first_,last_]:=StringTake[text,{First[First[StringPosition[text,first]]],First[First[StringPosition[text,last]]]-1}];
 gate["prior run stopped only at whole-response resource bound",priorReceipt["passed"]===False&&priorReceipt["exit_code"]===1&&
  StringContainsQ[ReadString[FileNameJoin[{priorDirectory,"s06.log"}]],"operation memory bound"]&&
  StringCount[ReadString[FileNameJoin[{priorDirectory,"s06.log"}]],"FAIL:"]===1];
 gate["authentic prior successful control within bounded run",priorReceipt["source_sha256"]===IntegerString[FileHash[priorSourcePath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  priorReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s06_result/s06_control.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[priorControlPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  priorControl["ExecutionProvenance"]["LocalSourceHash"]===FileHash[priorSourcePath,"SHA256"]&&
  priorControl["ExecutionProvenance"]["NativeVersions"]===localNativeVersions&&TrueQ[priorControl["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&
  priorControl["InputHash"]===targetInputHash&&And@@Values[priorControl["Checks"]]];
 gate["unchanged entire accepted mapper setup",unchangedSection[priorText,"\nreadAccepted[relative_","\ninputFunctions="]===
  unchangedSection[currentText,"\nreadAccepted[relative_","\ninputFunctions="]];
 gate["unchanged complete own coefficient comparison",unchangedSection[priorText,"\n controlTerms=","\n saveNative[controlSaved,controlPath]"]===
  unchangedSection[currentText,"\n controlTerms=","\n saveNative[controlSaved,controlPath]"]];
 gate["all prior mapping inputs unchanged",KeyTake[localConfig["input_sha256"],Keys[priorConfiguration["input_sha256"]]]===priorConfiguration["input_sha256"]];
 If[!FileExistsQ[controlPath],CopyFile[priorControlPath,controlPath]];
 gate["prior native control preserved byte for byte",FileHash[controlPath,"SHA256"]===FileHash[priorControlPath,"SHA256"]];
 controlSaved=priorControl;controlCompatible=True;
 AssociateTo[localProvenance,"ReusedControlExecutionReceiptHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{priorDirectory,"s06_execution.json"}],"SHA256"]];
 Print["LOCAL_COMPLETE_OWN_COMPARISON_REUSED unchanged mapper; whole-response resource failure excluded"]];
If[!controlCompatible,
 Print["LOCAL_COMPLETE_OWN_COMPARISON_START"];
 controlTerms=If[Head[record["Expression"]]===Plus,List@@record["Expression"],{record["Expression"]}];
 gate["whole own input retained",Total[controlTerms]===record["Expression"]];
 controlPackets=MapIndexed[Function[{term,index},Block[{checks=<||>},Module[{seconds,rows},
  Print["LOCAL_OWN_TERM_START ",First[index],"/",Length[controlTerms]];
  {seconds,rows}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[term],{"whole own term",First[index]}]];
  Print["LOCAL_OWN_TERM_DONE ",First[index]," seconds ",seconds];
  <|"Coefficients"->rows,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True,"Seconds"->seconds|>]]],controlTerms];
 controlRows=bounded[merge[Lookup[controlPackets,"Coefficients"]],"whole own merge"];
 gate["whole own exact merge certificate",certifyGroupMerge[controlPackets,controlRows]];
 gate["every accepted own Hgg coefficient unchanged",Sort[Keys[controlRows]]===Sort[Keys[controlReference]]&&
  And@@KeyValueMap[(#2===controlReference[#1]||bounded[zero[#2-controlReference[#1]],{"own coefficient",#1}])&,controlRows]];
 controlSaved=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-local-Hgg-runtime-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "ExecutionIdentity"->localExecutionIdentity,"OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,
  "InputHash"->targetInputHash,"NativeInputHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s08_mapping_inputs_result","s08_component_0008.wl"}],"SHA256"],

  "Coefficients"->controlRows,"Checks"->checks,"TermSeconds"->Lookup[controlPackets,"Seconds"],"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;

gate["accepted exact local runtime comparison",TrueQ[controlSaved["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&And@@Values[controlSaved["Checks"]]];
AssociateTo[localProvenance,"OwnComparisonHash"->FileHash[controlPath,"SHA256"]];
Clear[controlReference,controlRows,controlPackets,controlTerms,controlSaved,record,spin];ClearSystemCache[];
groupCache=FileNameJoin[{localWork,"cache","s08_Hgg_grouped",IntegerString[groupInputHash,16]}];
Do[If[!DirectoryQ[dir],CreateDirectory[dir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]],{dir,{groupCache,groupCache<>"_numeric_phase"}}];
localMap[index_]:=Block[{checks=<||>},Module[{value,originalBytes,seconds,coefficients,result,path},
 path=FileNameJoin[{localOutput,"s06_component_"<>IntegerString[index,10,4]<>".wl"}];
 If[FileExistsQ[path],result=Get[path];If[TrueQ[result["ReconstructionPassed"]]&&
  result["ExecutionProvenance"]["ExecutionIdentity"]===localExecutionIdentity&&And@@Values[result["Checks"]],Return[result]]];
 Print["LOCAL_HGG_COMPONENT_START ",index," ",InputForm[hggTaskMetadata[[index]]]];
 value=bounded[localSelectedTaskValue[index],{"load component",index}];originalBytes=ByteCount[value];
 Clear[hggCachedValue,hggCachedKey];ClearSystemCache[];
 value=value/.coordinateRules;
 Print["LOCAL_HGG_INPUT_BYTES ",index," ",ByteCount[value]];
 {seconds,coefficients}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{root=localWork,numericPhaseCache=groupCache<>"_numeric_phase"},
  numericPhaseMap[value,"component_"<>ToString[index]]]];
 gate["complete selected component reconstructed",AssociationQ[coefficients]&&Length[checks]>0&&And@@Values[checks]];
 result=Join[hggTaskMetadata[[index]],<|"ComponentIndex"->index,"Coefficients"->coefficients,
  "MissingTargets"->Complement[Keys[coefficients],ruleKeys,reduction["Masters"]],
  "InputHash"->targetInputHash,"ReconstructionPassed"->True,"Checks"->checks,"Seconds"->seconds,
  "InputBytes"->originalBytes,"OutputBytes"->ByteCount[coefficients],"NativeVersions"->localNativeVersions,
  "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>];saveNative[result,path];
 Print["LOCAL_HGG_COMPONENT_ACCEPTED ",index," seconds ",seconds," targets ",Length[coefficients]];
 KeyDrop[result,"Coefficients"]]];
localComponents=localMap/@localConfig["components"];
gate["all requested local components accepted",And@@Lookup[localComponents,"ReconstructionPassed"]&&
 And@@Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]]&/@localComponents]];
saveNative[<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-local-Hgg-components-v1","Channel"->channel,
 "Components"->localComponents,"Checks"->checks,"OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,
 "InputHash"->targetInputHash,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>,FileNameJoin[{localOutput,"s06_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{localOutput,"s06_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"components"->localConfig["components"],
 "execution_backend"->"local","native_versions"->localNativeVersions,"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
```

## misc/s06_result/reference/full_response_attempt/s06_map_Hgg_local.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-60", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 15546, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s06_result/reference/full_response_attempt/s06_map_Hgg_local.wls", "sha256": "cb8f91e1817e8caee39d1203753e9a75672c1a7e87569aebc9aa3efc5aee569f"} -->
```wolfram
(* Authorized one-kernel execution of the accepted Hgg scalar map. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
localRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[localRoot];
root=localRoot;channel="Hgg";checks=<||>;
localSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s06_map_Hgg_local.wls"}];
localConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s06_inputs.json"}];
localConfig=Import[localConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
localWork=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s06_work"}];
localOutput=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s06_result"}];
gate[name_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],If[!KeyExistsQ[checks,name],Print["PASS: ",name]];
 AssociateTo[checks,name->True],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
bounded[value_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,3600,
 gate["time bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]],4*1024^3,
 gate["operation memory bound "<>ToString[label,InputForm],False]];
zero[value_]:=Factor[Together[value]]===0;
gate["explicit authorized single local kernel",Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED"]==="1"&&$VersionNumber===15.];
gate["bound complete local source",SyntaxQ[ReadString[localSource]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===localConfig["source_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative,identity},gate["pinned input "<>relative,
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"],16,64]===identity]],localConfig["input_sha256"]];
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
localNativeVersions={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion};
readAccepted[relative_,receiptName_:"s08_execution.json"]:=Module[{path,receipt,result},
 path=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}];receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path],receiptName}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted receipt "<>relative,TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
  receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 result=bounded[Get[path],{"accepted native input",relative}];
 gate["accepted checks "<>relative,AssociationQ[result]&&AssociationQ[result["Checks"]]&&
  Length[result["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[result["Checks"]]];result];
record=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_mapping_inputs_result/s08_component_0008.wl","s08_recovery_execution.json"];
gate["own complete Hgg native input",record["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-native-mapping-input-v1"&&
 record["Channel"]===channel&&record["Component"]===8];
importedNativeVersions=record["NativeVersions"];
gate["same FeynCalc serialization version",Last[importedNativeVersions]===FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion];
inputHashes=record["InputHashes"];targetInputHash=record["TargetInputHash"];
coordinateRules=record["CoordinateRules"];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative,identity},gate["unchanged scientific input "<>relative,
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"]===identity]],inputHashes];
geometry=record["Geometry"];denominators=record["Denominators"];
directions=record["Directions"];families=record["Families"];familyNames=Keys[families];
sourceBlock[relative_,first_,last_]:=Module[{text,begin,end,block},
 text=ReadString[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}]];begin=StringPosition[text,first];end=StringPosition[text,last];
 gate["unique reviewed source block "<>relative,Length[begin]===1&&Length[end]===1];
 block=StringTake[text,{First[First[begin]],First[First[end]]-1}];
 gate["complete source block syntax "<>relative,SyntaxQ[block]];block];
ToExpression[sourceBlock["common/s08_result/reference/s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls",
 "\nmerge[pieces_List]","\ncoefficientPath ="],InputForm];
gate["exact own original mapping definitions",{DownValues[mapExpression],DownValues[familyRows],DownValues[merge]}===
 Lookup[record,{"OriginalMappingDefinitions","OriginalFamilyDefinitions","OriginalMergeDefinitions"}]];
DownValues[certifyPairMerge]=record["MergeCertificateDefinitions"];
DownValues[certifyGroupMerge]=record["GroupMergeDefinitions"];
DownValues[pairReconstruct]=record["ReconstructionDefinitions"];
polynomial=readAccepted["Hqg/s08_polynomial_group_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted reusable polynomial contract",TrueQ[polynomial["Accepted"]]&&TrueQ[polynomial["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 polynomial["NativeVersions"]===importedNativeVersions&&polynomial["OriginalFamilyDefinitions"]===DownValues[familyRows]&&
 KeyDrop[polynomial["InputHashes"],"Hqg/s05_result/s05_result.wl"]===KeyDrop[inputHashes,"Hgg/s05_result/s05_result.wl"]];
DownValues[familyRows]=polynomial["CandidateFamilyDefinitions"];
polynomialVariables=polynomial["PolynomialVariables"];
DownValues[polynomialAdditivePieces]=polynomial["AdditivePiecesDefinitions"];
DownValues[polynomialPieceMap]=polynomial["PieceMappingDefinitions"];
DownValues[localOriginalSave]=polynomial["PieceStorageDefinitions"]/.saveNative->localOriginalSave;
gate["unchanged exact native writer",(DownValues[localOriginalSave]/.localOriginalSave->saveNative)===polynomial["PieceStorageDefinitions"]];
pieceScientificHash=Hash[{polynomial["PieceScientificHash"],targetInputHash,
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_map_Hgg_factored_inputs.wls"}],"SHA256"]},"SHA256"];
sameOwnContract[proof_]:=proof["NativeVersions"]===importedNativeVersions&&
 proof["InputHashes"]===inputHashes&&proof["TargetInputHash"]===targetInputHash&&TrueQ[proof["OwnAcceptedComparison"]];
atom=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_factored_atom_certificate_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted exact atom implementation",sameOwnContract[atom]&&atom["OriginalExtractionDefinitions"]===DownValues[extractAtoms]&&
 atom["OriginalGroupingCertificateDefinitions"]===record["GroupingCertificateDefinitions"]];
atomVariables=atom["Variables"];DownValues[factoredAtoms]=atom["FactoredExtractionDefinitions"];
DownValues[extractAtoms]=atom["DispatchDefinitions"];
DownValues[factoredAtomCertificate]=atom["AtomCertificateDefinitions"];
DownValues[certifyGrouping]=atom["GroupingCertificateDefinitions"];Clear[atom];ClearSystemCache[];
scalar=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_scalar_certificate_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted exact scalar certificates",sameOwnContract[scalar]&&TrueQ[scalar["ActualAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 scalar["OriginalFamilyDefinitions"]===DownValues[familyRows]&&scalar["OriginalMappingDefinitions"]===DownValues[mapExpression]];
DownValues[familyRows]=scalar["FamilyDefinitions"];DownValues[mapExpression]=scalar["MappingDefinitions"];
DownValues[certifyFamilyLaurent]=scalar["FamilyCertificateDefinitions"];
DownValues[certifyScalarReconstruction]=scalar["MappingCertificateDefinitions"];Clear[scalar];
compact=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_compact_groups_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted compact grouping contract",sameOwnContract[compact]&&Length[compact["CandidateDefinitions"]]===2];
DownValues[hggOriginalGrouping]=First[compact["CandidateDefinitions"]];
DownValues[groupDenominators]=DownValues[hggOriginalGrouping]/.hggOriginalGrouping->groupDenominators;
DownValues[groupedMapExpression]=Last[compact["CandidateDefinitions"]]/.mapExpression->polynomialPieceMap;
gate["only accepted piece mapper installed",(DownValues[groupedMapExpression]/.polynomialPieceMap->mapExpression)===Last[compact["CandidateDefinitions"]]];
external=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_external_factor_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted exact external-factor implementation",sameOwnContract[external]&&TrueQ[external["ActualAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 {DownValues[mapExpression],DownValues[familyRows],DownValues[merge]}===
 Lookup[external,{"OriginalMappingDefinitions","FamilyDefinitions","MergeDefinitions"}]];
externalVariables=external["Variables"];externalEvidence={};externalFallbackCount=0;
DownValues[externalAtomCompatible]=external["CompatibilityDefinitions"];
DownValues[externalSplit]=external["SplitDefinitions"];
DownValues[externalFactorMap]=external["FactorMappingDefinitions"];
DownValues[externalOriginalMap]=external["OriginalAliasDefinitions"];
DownValues[mapExpression]=external["MappingDefinitions"];
controlReference=external["OwnCoefficients"];Clear[external,polynomial,compact];ClearSystemCache[];
ToExpression[sourceBlock["common/s08_resume_Hqg_polynomial_maps.wls",
 "\nnumericOuterFactor[expression_]","\ninstallNumericPhase[]"],InputForm];
reader=readAccepted["Hgg/s08_response_read_result/s08_result.wl"];
gate["accepted input reader native version",reader["NativeVersions"]===importedNativeVersions&&TrueQ[reader["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]];
DownValues[responseOnlyRead]=reader["ReaderDefinitions"];Clear[reader];
inputFunctions=sourceBlock["common/s08_map_Hgg_component_inputs.wls","\nhggInitializeTasks[]","\nhggBaselinePath ="];
gate["unique accepted payload read",StringCount[inputFunctions,"Get[path]"]===1];
inputFunctions=StringReplace[inputFunctions,"Get[path]"->"responseOnlyRead[path,row[\"Payload\"][\"Hash\"]]"];
gate["complete single-component reader syntax",SyntaxQ[inputFunctions]];ToExpression[inputFunctions,InputForm];
spin=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s05_result","s05_metadata.wl"}]];
gate["accepted complete metadata",spin["Channel"]===channel&&And@@Values[spin["Checks"]]];
hggInitializeTasks[];
gate["own native task identity",hggTaskMetadata[[8]]===record["Task"]];
gate["selected components exist",AllTrue[localConfig["components"],IntegerQ[#]&&1<=#<=Length[tasks]&]&&DuplicateFreeQ[localConfig["components"]]];
reduction=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s06_result","reference","s04_result.wl"}]]/.{Q2->Q^2,w->s23};
gate["accepted original scalar reduction",TrueQ[reduction["Accepted"]]];ruleKeys=First/@reduction["Rules"];
groupInputHash=Hash[{FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_map_Hgg_factored_inputs.wls"}],"SHA256"],
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgq","s08_certified_denominator_result","s08_result.wl"}],"SHA256"],
 inputHashes,targetInputHash,record["Component"],Hash[record["Expression"],"SHA256"],
 Sequence@@importedNativeVersions},"SHA256"];
gate["scientific group identity matches imported checkpoints",IntegerString[groupInputHash,16]===localConfig["group_input_hash"]];
localExecutionIdentity=Hash[{FileHash[localSource,"SHA256"],FileHash[localConfigPath,"SHA256"],localNativeVersions},"SHA256"];
localProvenance=<|"ExecutionBackend"->"local","NativeVersions"->localNativeVersions,
 "ImportedNativeVersions"->importedNativeVersions,"LocalSourceHash"->FileHash[localSource,"SHA256"],
 "LocalConfigurationHash"->FileHash[localConfigPath,"SHA256"],"ExecutionIdentity"->localExecutionIdentity|>;
saveNative[value_,path_]:=localOriginalSave[Join[value,<|"ExecutionProvenance"->localProvenance|>],path];
put[value_,path_]:=saveNative[value,path];
Do[If[!DirectoryQ[dir],CreateDirectory[dir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]],{dir,{localWork,localOutput}}];
If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_PREFLIGHT"]==="1",Print["PASS: local Hgg complete interface preflight"];Quit[0]];
controlPath=FileNameJoin[{localOutput,"s06_control.wl"}];
controlSaved=If[FileExistsQ[controlPath],Get[controlPath],<||>];
If[Lookup[controlSaved,"ExecutionIdentity",None]=!=localExecutionIdentity||!TrueQ[Lookup[controlSaved,"OwnAcceptedComparison",False]],
 Print["LOCAL_COMPLETE_OWN_COMPARISON_START"];
 controlTerms=If[Head[record["Expression"]]===Plus,List@@record["Expression"],{record["Expression"]}];
 gate["whole own input retained",Total[controlTerms]===record["Expression"]];
 controlPackets=MapIndexed[Function[{term,index},Block[{checks=<||>},Module[{seconds,rows},
  Print["LOCAL_OWN_TERM_START ",First[index],"/",Length[controlTerms]];
  {seconds,rows}=AbsoluteTiming[bounded[mapExpression[term],{"whole own term",First[index]}]];
  Print["LOCAL_OWN_TERM_DONE ",First[index]," seconds ",seconds];
  <|"Coefficients"->rows,"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True,"Seconds"->seconds|>]]],controlTerms];
 controlRows=bounded[merge[Lookup[controlPackets,"Coefficients"]],"whole own merge"];
 gate["whole own exact merge certificate",certifyGroupMerge[controlPackets,controlRows]];
 gate["every accepted own Hgg coefficient unchanged",Sort[Keys[controlRows]]===Sort[Keys[controlReference]]&&
  And@@KeyValueMap[(#2===controlReference[#1]||bounded[zero[#2-controlReference[#1]],{"own coefficient",#1}])&,controlRows]];
 controlSaved=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-local-Hgg-runtime-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,
  "ExecutionIdentity"->localExecutionIdentity,"OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,
  "InputHash"->targetInputHash,"NativeInputHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s08_mapping_inputs_result","s08_component_0008.wl"}],"SHA256"],
  "ReferenceHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s08_external_factor_result","s08_result.wl"}],"SHA256"],
  "Coefficients"->controlRows,"Checks"->checks,"TermSeconds"->Lookup[controlPackets,"Seconds"],"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
 saveNative[controlSaved,controlPath];Print["LOCAL_COMPLETE_OWN_COMPARISON_ACCEPTED"]];
gate["accepted exact local runtime comparison",TrueQ[controlSaved["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&And@@Values[controlSaved["Checks"]]];
AssociateTo[localProvenance,"OwnComparisonHash"->FileHash[controlPath,"SHA256"]];
Clear[controlReference,controlRows,controlPackets,controlTerms,controlSaved,record,spin];ClearSystemCache[];
groupCache=FileNameJoin[{localWork,"cache","s08_Hgg_grouped",IntegerString[groupInputHash,16]}];
Do[If[!DirectoryQ[dir],CreateDirectory[dir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]],{dir,{groupCache,groupCache<>"_numeric_phase"}}];
localMap[index_]:=Block[{checks=<||>},Module[{value,originalBytes,seconds,coefficients,result,path},
 path=FileNameJoin[{localOutput,"s06_component_"<>IntegerString[index,10,4]<>".wl"}];
 If[FileExistsQ[path],result=Get[path];If[TrueQ[result["ReconstructionPassed"]]&&
  result["ExecutionProvenance"]["ExecutionIdentity"]===localExecutionIdentity&&And@@Values[result["Checks"]],Return[result]]];
 Print["LOCAL_HGG_COMPONENT_START ",index," ",InputForm[hggTaskMetadata[[index]]]];
 value=bounded[hggTaskValue[index],{"load component",index}];originalBytes=ByteCount[value];
 Clear[hggCachedValue,hggCachedKey];ClearSystemCache[];
 value=value/.coordinateRules;
 Print["LOCAL_HGG_INPUT_BYTES ",index," ",ByteCount[value]];
 {seconds,coefficients}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{root=localWork,numericPhaseCache=groupCache<>"_numeric_phase"},
  numericPhaseMap[value,"component_"<>ToString[index]]]];
 gate["complete selected component reconstructed",AssociationQ[coefficients]&&Length[checks]>0&&And@@Values[checks]];
 result=Join[hggTaskMetadata[[index]],<|"ComponentIndex"->index,"Coefficients"->coefficients,
  "MissingTargets"->Complement[Keys[coefficients],ruleKeys,reduction["Masters"]],
  "InputHash"->targetInputHash,"ReconstructionPassed"->True,"Checks"->checks,"Seconds"->seconds,
  "InputBytes"->originalBytes,"OutputBytes"->ByteCount[coefficients],"NativeVersions"->localNativeVersions,
  "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>];saveNative[result,path];
 Print["LOCAL_HGG_COMPONENT_ACCEPTED ",index," seconds ",seconds," targets ",Length[coefficients]];
 KeyDrop[result,"Coefficients"]]];
localComponents=localMap/@localConfig["components"];
gate["all requested local components accepted",And@@Lookup[localComponents,"ReconstructionPassed"]&&
 And@@Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]]&/@localComponents]];
saveNative[<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-local-Hgg-components-v1","Channel"->channel,
 "Components"->localComponents,"Checks"->checks,"OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,
 "InputHash"->targetInputHash,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>,FileNameJoin[{localOutput,"s06_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{localOutput,"s06_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"components"->localConfig["components"],
 "execution_backend"->"local","native_versions"->localNativeVersions,"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: local Hgg requested component maps"];Quit[0];
```

```wolfram
 block=StringTake[text,{First[First[begin]],First[First[end]]-1}];
 gate["source block syntax "<>relative,SyntaxQ[block]];block];

ToExpression[sourceBlock["common/s08_check_pair_merge_linearity.wls",

If[TrueQ[Lookup[config,"repair_saved_paths",False]],
 repairArchive=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s07_result","reference","before_path_correction"}];
 repairPriorPath=FileNameJoin[{repairArchive,"s07_result.wl"}];repairPrior=Get[repairPriorPath];
 repairReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{repairArchive,"s07_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 repairConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{repairArchive,"s07_inputs.json"}];repairConfig=Import[repairConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
 repairSourcePath=FileNameJoin[{repairArchive,"s07_merge_Hgg_coefficients.wls"}];
 gate["authentic accepted arithmetic result",TrueQ[repairReceipt["passed"]]&&

  repairReceipt["configuration_sha256"]===IntegerString[FileHash[repairConfigPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  repairPrior["SourceHash"]===FileHash[repairSourcePath,"SHA256"]&&
  repairPrior["ConfigurationHash"]===FileHash[repairConfigPath,"SHA256"]&&
  repairPrior["NativeVersions"]===nativeVersions&&TrueQ[repairPrior["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&
  Length[repairPrior["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[repairPrior["Checks"]]];

  repairPrior["ManifestHash"]===FileHash[manifestPath,"SHA256"]&&repairPrior["Metric"]["InputFiles"]===manifest["groups"]&&
  repairPrior["OriginalMergeDefinitions"]===DownValues[merge]&&repairPrior["CoefficientDefinitions"]===DownValues[mergeKey]&&
  repairPrior["InputHash"]===Hash[{FileHash[repairSourcePath,"SHA256"],FileHash[repairConfigPath,"SHA256"],nativeVersions},"SHA256"]];
 repairCurrentText=ReadString[source];repairOriginalText=ReadString[repairSourcePath];
 repairBegin=StringPosition[repairCurrentText,"\n(* BEGIN METADATA PATH REPAIR *)"];
 repairEnd=StringPosition[repairCurrentText,"\n(* END METADATA PATH REPAIR *)\n"];
 gate["unique bounded metadata correction",Length[repairBegin]===1&&Length[repairEnd]===1];
 repairWithoutBranch=StringReplacePart[repairCurrentText,"\n",{First[First[repairBegin]],Last[First[repairEnd]]}];
 gate["entire arithmetic implementation unchanged",repairWithoutBranch===StringReplace[repairOriginalText,
  "root=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[root];"->
  "root=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[root];root=Directory[];"]];
 repairInventory=Map[Function[row,Module[{path,relative,corrected},
  path=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s07_result","coefficients",IntegerString[repairPrior["InputHash"],16],
   "coefficient_"<>IntegerString[row["Binding"],16]<>".wl"}];
  relative=StringDrop[path,StringLength[root]+1];
  gate["unchanged accepted coefficient payload",FileExistsQ[path]&&

  gate["correct relative file round trip",FileNameJoin[{root,relative}]===path];

  gate["only coefficient filename metadata changes",KeyDrop[corrected,"File"]===KeyDrop[row,"File"]];corrected]],repairPrior["Metric"]["Inventory"]];

  "ArithmeticSourceHash"->repairPrior["SourceHash"],"ArithmeticConfigurationHash"->repairPrior["ConfigurationHash"],
  "ArithmeticResultHash"->FileHash[repairPriorPath,"SHA256"],"ArithmeticReceiptHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{repairArchive,"s07_execution.json"}],"SHA256"],
  "MetadataPathCorrectionOnly"->True,"Metric"->Join[repairPrior["Metric"],<|"Inventory"->repairInventory|>],
  "Checks"->Join[repairPrior["Checks"],checks]|>];
 repairOutput=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s07_result"}];mergeSave[result,FileNameJoin[{repairOutput,"s07_result.wl"}]];
 Export[FileNameJoin[{repairOutput,"s07_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->result["Checks"],"workers"->0,
  "native_versions"->nativeVersions,"own_seconds"->repairPrior["OwnSeconds"],
  "metric_seconds"->repairPrior["Metric"]["Seconds"],"coefficients"->Length[repairInventory],
  "metadata_path_correction_only"->True,"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];

(* END METADATA PATH REPAIR *)

output=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s07_result"}];
mergeCache=FileNameJoin[{output,"coefficients",IntegerString[mergeStudyHash,16]}];

 "/home/physics/wolframengine/opt/Wolfram/WolframEngine/15.0/Executables/WolframKernel","KernelCount"->2,"TimeConstraint"->30]],40,$Failed];
workers=Length[Kernels[]];gate["bounded local worker count",0<=workers<=2];

readGroup[row_]:=Module[{path,value},path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["file"]}];

 value=bounded[Get[path],{"read group",row["file"]}];
 gate["accepted group arithmetic "<>row["file"],TrueQ[value["Accepted"]]&&AssociationQ[value["Coefficients"]]&&
  Length[value["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[value["Checks"]]];
 Print["LOCAL_MERGE_GROUP_READ ",FileNameTake[path]," memory ",MemoryInUse[]];value["Coefficients"]];

 maps=readGroup/@rows;grouped=Merge[maps,Identity];keys=Keys[grouped];

 gate["complete merge records "<>label,Length[results]===Length[packets]&&AllTrue[results,AssociationQ]&&
  And@@Lookup[results,"ReconstructionPassed"]&&And@@Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]]&/@results]&&
  Lookup[results,"Key"]===keys&&Lookup[results,"Binding"]===(Hash[{mergeStudyHash,#},"SHA256"]&/@packets)];
 result=Select[AssociationThread[keys,Lookup[results,"Value"]],#=!=0&];
 inventory=Map[Function[record,Module[{path},path=FileNameJoin[{mergeCache,"coefficient_"<>IntegerString[record["Binding"],16]<>".wl"}];
  Join[KeyDrop[record,"Value"],<|"File"->StringDrop[path,StringLength[root]+1],"SHA256"->IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]|>]]],results];
 Print["LOCAL_MERGE_DONE ",label," seconds ",seconds," memory ",MemoryInUse[]];
 <|"Coefficients"->result,"Inventory"->inventory,"Seconds"->seconds,"InputFiles"->rows|>];
ownMerged=runMerge[manifest["own_groups"],"own_component_8"];
gate["entire accepted own Hgg map reproduced",Sort[Keys[ownMerged["Coefficients"]]]===Sort[Keys[own["OwnCoefficients"]]]&&

 "SourceHash"->FileHash[source,"SHA256"],"ConfigurationHash"->FileHash[configPath,"SHA256"],
```

```wolfram
  And@@Lookup[results,"ReconstructionPassed"]&&And@@Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]]&/@results]&&
  Lookup[results,"Key"]===keys&&Lookup[results,"Binding"]===(Hash[{mergeStudyHash,#},"SHA256"]&/@packets)];
 result=Select[AssociationThread[keys,Lookup[results,"Value"]],#=!=0&];
 inventory=Map[Function[record,Module[{path},path=FileNameJoin[{mergeCache,"coefficient_"<>IntegerString[record["Binding"],16]<>".wl"}];
  Join[KeyDrop[record,"Value"],<|"File"->StringDrop[path,StringLength[root]+1],"SHA256"->IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]|>]]],results];
 Print["LOCAL_MERGE_DONE ",label," seconds ",seconds," memory ",MemoryInUse[]];
 <|"Coefficients"->result,"Inventory"->inventory,"Seconds"->seconds,"InputFiles"->rows|>];
ownMerged=runMerge[manifest["own_groups"],"own_component_8"];
gate["entire accepted own Hgg map reproduced",Sort[Keys[ownMerged["Coefficients"]]]===Sort[Keys[own["OwnCoefficients"]]]&&
 And@@KeyValueMap[(#2===own["OwnCoefficients"][#1]||bounded[zero[#2-own["OwnCoefficients"][#1]],{"own coefficient",#1}])&,ownMerged["Coefficients"]]];
ownSeconds=ownMerged["Seconds"];Clear[ownMerged,ownInput,own,proof];ClearSystemCache[];
Print["LOCAL_COMPLETE_OWN_MERGE_ACCEPTED"];
metric=runMerge[manifest["groups"],"metric_component_98"];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-local-Hgg-coefficient-merge-v1","Channel"->"Hgg",
 "SourceHash"->FileHash[source,"SHA256"],"ConfigurationHash"->FileHash[configPath,"SHA256"],
 "ManifestHash"->FileHash[manifestPath,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->mergeStudyHash,
 "NativeVersions"->nativeVersions,"ImportedNativeVersions"->importedVersions,"WorkerCount"->workers,
 "OriginalMergeDefinitions"->DownValues[merge],"CoefficientDefinitions"->DownValues[mergeKey],
 "OwnAcceptedComparison"->True,"OwnSeconds"->ownSeconds,"Metric"->KeyDrop[metric,"Coefficients"],
 "Checks"->checks,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
mergeSave[result,FileNameJoin[{output,"s07_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{output,"s07_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"workers"->workers,"native_versions"->nativeVersions,
 "own_seconds"->ownSeconds,"metric_seconds"->metric["Seconds"],"coefficients"->Length[metric["Inventory"]],
 "finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
CloseKernels[];Print["PASS: local Hgg coefficient merge"];Quit[0];
```

## misc/s08_collect_Hgg_targets.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-67", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 10608, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s08_collect_Hgg_targets.wls", "sha256": "154a228c6814cb5a430648bfd5eeb41c33ff859e92e5c5c2e49fecf6a203c1bb"} -->
```wolfram
(* Collect existing Hgg maps one component at a time after binding the metric input. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
collectorRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[collectorRoot];
collectorSource=FileNameJoin[{collectorRoot,"misc","s08_collect_Hgg_targets.wls"}];
collectorConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{collectorRoot,"misc","s08_inputs.json"}];
collectorConfig=Import[collectorConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
collectorRequire[name_,test_]:=If[!TrueQ[test],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
collectorRequire["complete collector source",SyntaxQ[ReadString[collectorSource]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[collectorSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===collectorConfig["source_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative,identity},collectorRequire["collector pinned input "<>relative,
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{collectorRoot,relative}],"SHA256"],16,64]===identity]],collectorConfig["input_sha256"]];
collectorBase=FileNameJoin[{collectorRoot,"misc","s06_map_Hgg_local.wls"}];
collectorText=ReadString[collectorBase];collectorBoundary="\nIf[Environment[\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_PREFLIGHT\"]";
collectorRequire["complete reused local initialization",StringCount[collectorText,collectorBoundary]===1];
collectorPrefix=First[StringSplit[collectorText,collectorBoundary]];
collectorRequire["reused initialization syntax",SyntaxQ[collectorPrefix]];ToExpression[collectorPrefix,InputForm];root=Directory[];
collectorOutput=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s08_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[collectorOutput],CreateDirectory[collectorOutput,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
collectorNativeVersions={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion};
collectorProvenance=<|"ExecutionBackend"->"local","NativeVersions"->collectorNativeVersions,
 "ImportedNativeVersions"->importedNativeVersions,"SourceHash"->FileHash[collectorSource,"SHA256"],
 "ConfigurationHash"->FileHash[collectorConfigPath,"SHA256"],"ReusedInitializationHash"->FileHash[collectorBase,"SHA256"]|>;
localProvenance=collectorProvenance;
collectorMappingHash=Hash[{FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_result","reference","s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls"}],"SHA256"],
 inputHashes,Sequence@@importedNativeVersions},"SHA256"];
gate["original mapping input identity reproduced",collectorMappingHash===record["InputHash"]];
collectorManifest=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s08_imported_components.json"}],"RawJSON"];
groupManifest=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s07_imported_groups.json"}],"RawJSON"];
mergeRelative="misc/s07_result/s07_result.wl";mergePath=FileNameJoin[{root,mergeRelative}];
mergeReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[mergePath],"s07_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted actual local merge receipt",TrueQ[mergeReceipt["passed"]]&&mergeReceipt["execution_backend"]==="local"&&
 mergeReceipt["result_sha256"][mergeRelative]===IntegerString[FileHash[mergePath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 mergeReceipt["source_sha256"]===IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s07_merge_Hgg_coefficients.wls"}],"SHA256"],16,64]];
merged=Get[mergePath];
gate["complete local merge and runtime comparison",merged["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-local-Hgg-coefficient-merge-v1"&&
 merged["Channel"]===channel&&merged["NativeVersions"]===collectorNativeVersions&&
 merged["ImportedNativeVersions"]===importedNativeVersions&&TrueQ[merged["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 merged["OriginalMergeDefinitions"]===DownValues[merge]&&Length[merged["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[merged["Checks"]]&&
 merged["ManifestHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s07_imported_groups.json"}],"SHA256"]&&
 merged["Metric"]["InputFiles"]===groupManifest["groups"]];
metricPositions=Select[Range[Length[hggTaskMetadata]],hggTaskMetadata[[#]]["Kind"]==="PhotonMetricD"&];
gate["single original metric task",Length[metricPositions]===1];metricIndex=First[metricPositions];
metricTask=hggTaskMetadata[[metricIndex]];metricInput=hggTaskSources[[metricIndex]];
gate["original scalar payload interface",metricInput["Field"]==="Value"&&metricInput["Index"]==={}];
metricPayloadPath=FileNameJoin[{root,metricInput["Payload"]["File"]}];
gate["original scalar payload hash",FileHash[metricPayloadPath,"SHA256"]===metricInput["Payload"]["Hash"]];
metricPayload=bounded[Get[metricPayloadPath],"original complete scalar payload"];
gate["accepted original scalar",metricPayload["Channel"]===channel&&metricPayload["Key"]==="Scalar_PgD"&&
 Length[metricPayload["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[metricPayload["Checks"]]];
metricInputBytes=ByteCount[metricPayload["Value"]];
metricValue=bounded[metricPayload["Value"]/.coordinateRules,"saved metric coordinate conversion"];
Clear[metricPayload];ClearSystemCache[];
metricGroups=bounded[hggOriginalGrouping[metricValue],"complete original metric denominator grouping"];
metricGroupValues=KeyValueMap[#2/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,#1}])&,metricGroups];
gate["complete imported metric group inventory",Length[metricGroupValues]===Length[groupManifest["groups"]]];
metricExpectedBindings=MapIndexed[Hash[{groupInputHash,"component_"<>ToString[metricIndex],First[#2],#1},"SHA256"]&,metricGroupValues];
Clear[metricValue,metricGroups,metricGroupValues];ClearSystemCache[];
metricPackets=MapIndexed[Function[{row,position},Module[{path,packet},path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["file"]}];
 gate["exact original group file "<>row["file"],IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["sha256"]];
 packet=bounded[Get[path],{"saved metric group",First[position]}];
 gate["complete original metric group binding "<>ToString[First[position]],packet["Binding"]===metricExpectedBindings[[First[position]]]&&
  TrueQ[packet["Accepted"]]&&Length[packet["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[packet["Checks"]]];packet]],groupManifest["groups"]];
metricMaps=Lookup[metricPackets,"Coefficients"];metricGrouped=Merge[metricMaps,Identity];metricKeys=Keys[metricGrouped];
metricInventory=merged["Metric"]["Inventory"];
gate["complete original coefficient order",Lookup[metricInventory,"Key"]===metricKeys];
metricRecords=MapIndexed[Function[{row,position},Module[{path,packet,expected},path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["File"]}];
 gate["exact local coefficient file",IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["SHA256"]];packet=Get[path];
 expected=Hash[{merged["InputHash"],<|"Component"->"metric_component_98","Position"->First[position],
  "Key"->row["Key"],"Values"->metricGrouped[row["Key"]]|>},"SHA256"];
 gate["same fully reconstructed input and output",packet["Binding"]===expected&&row["Binding"]===expected&&packet["Key"]===row["Key"]&&
  TrueQ[packet["ReconstructionPassed"]]&&Length[packet["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[packet["Checks"]]&&
  KeyDrop[packet,"Value"]===KeyDrop[row,{"File","SHA256"}]];packet]],metricInventory];
metricCoefficients=Select[AssociationThread[metricKeys,Lookup[metricRecords,"Value"]],#=!=0&];
gate["complete original formal merge certificate",bounded[certifyPairMerge[metricMaps,metricGrouped,metricCoefficients],"complete metric merge certificate"]];
gate["both original physical cuts retained",And@@(Take[#[[2]],Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]]===
 ConstantArray[1,Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]]&/@Keys[metricCoefficients])];
metricRaw=Join[metricTask,<|"Coefficients"->metricCoefficients,"InputHash"->targetInputHash,
 "MissingTargets"->Complement[Keys[metricCoefficients],ruleKeys,reduction["Masters"]],"ReconstructionPassed"->True,
 "Checks"->checks,"InputBytes"->metricInputBytes,"OutputBytes"->ByteCount[metricCoefficients],
 "LocalMergeHash"->FileHash[mergePath,"SHA256"],"LocalMergeReceiptHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[mergePath],"s07_execution.json"}],"SHA256"]|>];
metricRawPath=FileNameJoin[{collectorOutput,"s08_metric_map.wl"}];saveNative[metricRaw,metricRawPath];
Clear[metricMaps,metricGrouped,metricPackets,metricRecords,metricCoefficients,metricRaw,merged];ClearSystemCache[];
rawFiles=Association[Map[Function[row,FromDigits[Last[StringCases[FileBaseName[row["file"]],DigitCharacter..]]]->row],collectorManifest["files"]]];
gate["all original response components present",Sort[Keys[rawFiles]]===Complement[Range[Length[hggTaskMetadata]],metricPositions]];
AssociateTo[rawFiles,metricIndex-><|"file"->StringDrop[metricRawPath,StringLength[root]+1],
 "sha256"->IntegerString[FileHash[metricRawPath,"SHA256"],16,64],"bytes"->FileByteCount[metricRawPath]|>];
targetInventory={};targetMissing={};
componentMetadata=Table[Module[{row=rawFiles[index],path,packet},path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["file"]}];
 gate["exact completed component file "<>ToString[index],IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["sha256"]];
 packet=bounded[Get[path],{"completed raw component",index}];
 gate["complete accepted component identity "<>ToString[index],packet["InputHash"]===targetInputHash&&
  KeyTake[packet,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]===hggTaskMetadata[[index]]&&TrueQ[packet["ReconstructionPassed"]]&&
  Length[packet["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[packet["Checks"]]];
 targetInventory=Union[targetInventory,Keys[packet["Coefficients"]]];
 targetMissing=Union[targetMissing,Complement[Keys[packet["Coefficients"]],ruleKeys,reduction["Masters"]]];
 Print["LOCAL_RAW_COMPONENT_ACCEPTED ",index," bytes ",ByteCount[packet]];
 Join[KeyDrop[packet,"Coefficients"],<|"RawTargets"->Keys[packet["Coefficients"]],
  "RawCoefficientFile"->row["file"],"RawCoefficientSHA256"->row["sha256"]|>]],
 {index,Length[hggTaskMetadata]}];
gate["complete original component order",(KeyTake[#,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]&/@componentMetadata)===hggTaskMetadata];
collectorResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-real-target-map-v1","Channel"->channel,"Components"->componentMetadata,
 "ComponentStorage"->"hash-pinned-raw-component-files-v1","Targets"->targetInventory,"MissingTargets"->targetMissing,
 "ReductionCoverageComplete"->(targetMissing==={}),"Bookkeeping"->bookkeeping,"SourceHash"->FileHash[collectorSource,"SHA256"],
 "MapperSourceHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_result","reference","s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls"}],"SHA256"],
 "NativeVersions"->collectorNativeVersions,"ImportedNativeVersions"->importedNativeVersions,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
 "InputHash"->targetInputHash,"MappingInputHash"->collectorMappingHash,
 "Checks"->checks,"MappingAccepted"->True,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
saveNative[collectorResult,FileNameJoin[{collectorOutput,"s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{collectorOutput,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"components"->Length[componentMetadata],
 "targets"->Length[targetInventory],"missing_targets"->Length[targetMissing],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: local Hgg complete target collection"];Quit[0];
```

## misc/s08_result/reference/before_path_correction/s08_collect_Hgg_targets.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-70", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 10591, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s08_result/reference/before_path_correction/s08_collect_Hgg_targets.wls", "sha256": "dfbbe39476d634e7ba457f95627c65692ff2e5f8664e0cc2b7b5bdaa1aed9cce"} -->
```wolfram
(* Collect existing Hgg maps one component at a time after binding the metric input. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
collectorRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[collectorRoot];
collectorSource=FileNameJoin[{collectorRoot,"misc","s08_collect_Hgg_targets.wls"}];
collectorConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{collectorRoot,"misc","s08_inputs.json"}];
collectorConfig=Import[collectorConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
collectorRequire[name_,test_]:=If[!TrueQ[test],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
collectorRequire["complete collector source",SyntaxQ[ReadString[collectorSource]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[collectorSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===collectorConfig["source_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative,identity},collectorRequire["collector pinned input "<>relative,
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{collectorRoot,relative}],"SHA256"],16,64]===identity]],collectorConfig["input_sha256"]];
collectorBase=FileNameJoin[{collectorRoot,"misc","s06_map_Hgg_local.wls"}];
collectorText=ReadString[collectorBase];collectorBoundary="\nIf[Environment[\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_PREFLIGHT\"]";
collectorRequire["complete reused local initialization",StringCount[collectorText,collectorBoundary]===1];
collectorPrefix=First[StringSplit[collectorText,collectorBoundary]];
collectorRequire["reused initialization syntax",SyntaxQ[collectorPrefix]];ToExpression[collectorPrefix,InputForm];
collectorOutput=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s08_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[collectorOutput],CreateDirectory[collectorOutput,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
collectorNativeVersions={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion};
collectorProvenance=<|"ExecutionBackend"->"local","NativeVersions"->collectorNativeVersions,
 "ImportedNativeVersions"->importedNativeVersions,"SourceHash"->FileHash[collectorSource,"SHA256"],
 "ConfigurationHash"->FileHash[collectorConfigPath,"SHA256"],"ReusedInitializationHash"->FileHash[collectorBase,"SHA256"]|>;
localProvenance=collectorProvenance;
collectorMappingHash=Hash[{FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_result","reference","s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls"}],"SHA256"],
 inputHashes,Sequence@@importedNativeVersions},"SHA256"];
gate["original mapping input identity reproduced",collectorMappingHash===record["InputHash"]];
collectorManifest=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s08_imported_components.json"}],"RawJSON"];
groupManifest=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s07_imported_groups.json"}],"RawJSON"];
mergeRelative="misc/s07_result/s07_result.wl";mergePath=FileNameJoin[{root,mergeRelative}];
mergeReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[mergePath],"s07_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted actual local merge receipt",TrueQ[mergeReceipt["passed"]]&&mergeReceipt["execution_backend"]==="local"&&
 mergeReceipt["result_sha256"][mergeRelative]===IntegerString[FileHash[mergePath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 mergeReceipt["source_sha256"]===IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s07_merge_Hgg_coefficients.wls"}],"SHA256"],16,64]];
merged=Get[mergePath];
gate["complete local merge and runtime comparison",merged["Schema"]==="polarized-sidis-local-Hgg-coefficient-merge-v1"&&
 merged["Channel"]===channel&&merged["NativeVersions"]===collectorNativeVersions&&
 merged["ImportedNativeVersions"]===importedNativeVersions&&TrueQ[merged["OwnAcceptedComparison"]]&&
 merged["OriginalMergeDefinitions"]===DownValues[merge]&&Length[merged["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[merged["Checks"]]&&
 merged["ManifestHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s07_imported_groups.json"}],"SHA256"]&&
 merged["Metric"]["InputFiles"]===groupManifest["groups"]];
metricPositions=Select[Range[Length[hggTaskMetadata]],hggTaskMetadata[[#]]["Kind"]==="PhotonMetricD"&];
gate["single original metric task",Length[metricPositions]===1];metricIndex=First[metricPositions];
metricTask=hggTaskMetadata[[metricIndex]];metricInput=hggTaskSources[[metricIndex]];
gate["original scalar payload interface",metricInput["Field"]==="Value"&&metricInput["Index"]==={}];
metricPayloadPath=FileNameJoin[{root,metricInput["Payload"]["File"]}];
gate["original scalar payload hash",FileHash[metricPayloadPath,"SHA256"]===metricInput["Payload"]["Hash"]];
metricPayload=bounded[Get[metricPayloadPath],"original complete scalar payload"];
gate["accepted original scalar",metricPayload["Channel"]===channel&&metricPayload["Key"]==="Scalar_PgD"&&
 Length[metricPayload["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[metricPayload["Checks"]]];
metricInputBytes=ByteCount[metricPayload["Value"]];
metricValue=bounded[metricPayload["Value"]/.coordinateRules,"saved metric coordinate conversion"];
Clear[metricPayload];ClearSystemCache[];
metricGroups=bounded[hggOriginalGrouping[metricValue],"complete original metric denominator grouping"];
metricGroupValues=KeyValueMap[#2/(Times@@MapThread[Power,{denominators,#1}])&,metricGroups];
gate["complete imported metric group inventory",Length[metricGroupValues]===Length[groupManifest["groups"]]];
metricExpectedBindings=MapIndexed[Hash[{groupInputHash,"component_"<>ToString[metricIndex],First[#2],#1},"SHA256"]&,metricGroupValues];
Clear[metricValue,metricGroups,metricGroupValues];ClearSystemCache[];
metricPackets=MapIndexed[Function[{row,position},Module[{path,packet},path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["file"]}];
 gate["exact original group file "<>row["file"],IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["sha256"]];
 packet=bounded[Get[path],{"saved metric group",First[position]}];
 gate["complete original metric group binding "<>ToString[First[position]],packet["Binding"]===metricExpectedBindings[[First[position]]]&&
  TrueQ[packet["Accepted"]]&&Length[packet["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[packet["Checks"]]];packet]],groupManifest["groups"]];
metricMaps=Lookup[metricPackets,"Coefficients"];metricGrouped=Merge[metricMaps,Identity];metricKeys=Keys[metricGrouped];
metricInventory=merged["Metric"]["Inventory"];
gate["complete original coefficient order",Lookup[metricInventory,"Key"]===metricKeys];
metricRecords=MapIndexed[Function[{row,position},Module[{path,packet,expected},path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["File"]}];
 gate["exact local coefficient file",IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["SHA256"]];packet=Get[path];
 expected=Hash[{merged["InputHash"],<|"Component"->"metric_component_98","Position"->First[position],
  "Key"->row["Key"],"Values"->metricGrouped[row["Key"]]|>},"SHA256"];
 gate["same fully reconstructed input and output",packet["Binding"]===expected&&row["Binding"]===expected&&packet["Key"]===row["Key"]&&
  TrueQ[packet["ReconstructionPassed"]]&&Length[packet["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[packet["Checks"]]&&
  KeyDrop[packet,"Value"]===KeyDrop[row,{"File","SHA256"}]];packet]],metricInventory];
metricCoefficients=Select[AssociationThread[metricKeys,Lookup[metricRecords,"Value"]],#=!=0&];
gate["complete original formal merge certificate",bounded[certifyPairMerge[metricMaps,metricGrouped,metricCoefficients],"complete metric merge certificate"]];
gate["both original physical cuts retained",And@@(Take[#[[2]],Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]]===
 ConstantArray[1,Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]]&/@Keys[metricCoefficients])];
metricRaw=Join[metricTask,<|"Coefficients"->metricCoefficients,"InputHash"->targetInputHash,
 "MissingTargets"->Complement[Keys[metricCoefficients],ruleKeys,reduction["Masters"]],"ReconstructionPassed"->True,
 "Checks"->checks,"InputBytes"->metricInputBytes,"OutputBytes"->ByteCount[metricCoefficients],
 "LocalMergeHash"->FileHash[mergePath,"SHA256"],"LocalMergeReceiptHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[mergePath],"s07_execution.json"}],"SHA256"]|>];
metricRawPath=FileNameJoin[{collectorOutput,"s08_metric_map.wl"}];saveNative[metricRaw,metricRawPath];
Clear[metricMaps,metricGrouped,metricPackets,metricRecords,metricCoefficients,metricRaw,merged];ClearSystemCache[];
rawFiles=Association[Map[Function[row,FromDigits[Last[StringCases[FileBaseName[row["file"]],DigitCharacter..]]]->row],collectorManifest["files"]]];
gate["all original response components present",Sort[Keys[rawFiles]]===Complement[Range[Length[hggTaskMetadata]],metricPositions]];
AssociateTo[rawFiles,metricIndex-><|"file"->StringDrop[metricRawPath,StringLength[root]+1],
 "sha256"->IntegerString[FileHash[metricRawPath,"SHA256"],16,64],"bytes"->FileByteCount[metricRawPath]|>];
targetInventory={};targetMissing={};
componentMetadata=Table[Module[{row=rawFiles[index],path,packet},path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["file"]}];
 gate["exact completed component file "<>ToString[index],IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["sha256"]];
 packet=bounded[Get[path],{"completed raw component",index}];
 gate["complete accepted component identity "<>ToString[index],packet["InputHash"]===targetInputHash&&
  KeyTake[packet,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]===hggTaskMetadata[[index]]&&TrueQ[packet["ReconstructionPassed"]]&&
  Length[packet["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[packet["Checks"]]];
 targetInventory=Union[targetInventory,Keys[packet["Coefficients"]]];
 targetMissing=Union[targetMissing,Complement[Keys[packet["Coefficients"]],ruleKeys,reduction["Masters"]]];
 Print["LOCAL_RAW_COMPONENT_ACCEPTED ",index," bytes ",ByteCount[packet]];
 Join[KeyDrop[packet,"Coefficients"],<|"RawTargets"->Keys[packet["Coefficients"]],
  "RawCoefficientFile"->row["file"],"RawCoefficientSHA256"->row["sha256"]|>]],
 {index,Length[hggTaskMetadata]}];
gate["complete original component order",(KeyTake[#,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]&/@componentMetadata)===hggTaskMetadata];
collectorResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-real-target-map-v1","Channel"->channel,"Components"->componentMetadata,
 "ComponentStorage"->"hash-pinned-raw-component-files-v1","Targets"->targetInventory,"MissingTargets"->targetMissing,
 "ReductionCoverageComplete"->(targetMissing==={}),"Bookkeeping"->bookkeeping,"SourceHash"->FileHash[collectorSource,"SHA256"],
 "MapperSourceHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s08_result","reference","s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls"}],"SHA256"],
 "NativeVersions"->collectorNativeVersions,"ImportedNativeVersions"->importedNativeVersions,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
 "InputHash"->targetInputHash,"MappingInputHash"->collectorMappingHash,
 "Checks"->checks,"MappingAccepted"->True,"FiniteNLOFHatsComputed"->False|>;
saveNative[collectorResult,FileNameJoin[{collectorOutput,"s08_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{collectorOutput,"s08_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"components"->Length[componentMetadata],
 "targets"->Length[targetInventory],"missing_targets"->Length[targetMissing],"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: local Hgg complete target collection"];Quit[0];

```

## misc/s09_reduce_Hgg_targets.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-73", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7812, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s09_reduce_Hgg_targets.wls", "sha256": "12cfb2224a2fe30c84adcecbb595620954f8b12053ae260530c0437d6673f2fa"} -->
```wolfram
(* Reuse accepted native cut rules on the complete local Hgg target inventory. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
localReductionRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[localReductionRoot];
localReductionSource=FileNameJoin[{localReductionRoot,"misc","s09_reduce_Hgg_targets.wls"}];
localReductionConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{localReductionRoot,"misc","s09_inputs.json"}];
localReductionConfig=Import[localReductionConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
require[name_,test_]:=If[!TrueQ[test],Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
require["local reduction source",SyntaxQ[ReadString[localReductionSource]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localReductionSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===localReductionConfig["source_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative,identity},require["local reduction input "<>relative,
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{localReductionRoot,relative}],"SHA256"],16,64]===identity]],localReductionConfig["input_sha256"]];
localReductionChange[text_,edits_]:=Module[{changed},
 require["unique local reduction interfaces",And@@(StringCount[text,First[#]]===1&/@edits)];
 changed=StringReplace[text,edits];require["complete unchanged reduction restored",SyntaxQ[changed]&&StringReplace[changed,Reverse/@edits]===text];changed];
localReductionBlock[path_,first_,last_]:=Module[{text,begin,end,block},text=ReadString[path];
 begin=StringPosition[text,first];end=StringPosition[text,last];
 require["complete reviewed reduction boundaries",Length[begin]===1&&Length[end]===1];
 block=StringTake[text,{First[First[begin]],First[First[end]]-1}];require["reduction block syntax",SyntaxQ[block]];block];
reuseBase=FileNameJoin[{localReductionRoot,"common","s08_extend_real_reduction.wls"}];
reuseSource=FileNameJoin[{localReductionRoot,"common","s08_extend_reused_real_reduction.wls"}];
readySource=FileNameJoin[{localReductionRoot,"common","s08_extend_Hgg_ready_reduction.wls"}];readyBase=reuseSource;
localReductionOriginal=ReadString[reuseBase];
require["unique executable-selection boundary",StringCount[localReductionOriginal,"\nkira = settings["]===1];
localReductionPrefix=First[StringSplit[localReductionOriginal,"\nkira = settings["]];
localReductionEdits={
 "gate[\"compute allocation\", StringQ[Environment[\"JOB_ID\"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, \"login\"]];"->
 "gate[\"authorized local reduction\",Environment[\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED\"]===\"1\"&&$VersionNumber===15.];",
 "gate[\"isolated runtime\", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> \"/\"]];"->
 "gate[\"local runtime recorded separately\",True];",
 "mapPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, \"s08_targets_result\", \"s08_result.wl\"}];"->
 "mapPath = FileNameJoin[{root, \"misc\", \"s08_result\", \"s08_result.wl\"}];",
 "mapperSources = {"->"mapperSources = {FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s08_collect_Hgg_targets.wls\"}],"};
SetEnvironment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"->"Hgg"];
ToExpression[localReductionChange[localReductionPrefix,localReductionEdits],InputForm];
localMapReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[mapPath],"s08_execution.json"}];localMapReceipt=Import[localMapReceiptPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted complete local map receipt",TrueQ[localMapReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localMapReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s08_result/s08_result.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[mapPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 map["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&map["ComponentStorage"]==="hash-pinned-raw-component-files-v1"];
localImportedVersions=map["ImportedNativeVersions"];reuseControl=False;readyOnly=False;
inputPaths={localReductionSource,localReductionConfigPath,mapPath,localMapReceiptPath,libraryPath,configPath,originalSource,
 mapperSource,previousMapperSource,reuseBase,readySource};
inputPaths=Join[inputPaths,(FileNameJoin[{root,library["Library"][#]["File"]}]&)/@{"s02","s04"}];
localReuseBlock=localReductionBlock[reuseSource,"\nreuseSetup[]","\nreuseText="];
localReuseBlock=localReductionChange[localReuseBlock,{
 "reuseProof[\"NativeVersions\"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}"->"reuseProof[\"NativeVersions\"]===localImportedVersions"}];
ToExpression[localReuseBlock,InputForm];reuseSetup[];
localReadyBlock=localReductionBlock[readySource,"\nreadySetup[]","\nreadySuffix["];
localReadyBlock=localReductionChange[localReadyBlock,{
 "packet[\"NativeVersions\"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}"->"packet[\"NativeVersions\"]===localImportedVersions"}];
ToExpression[localReadyBlock,InputForm];readySetup[];
localUncovered=Complement[targets,Keys[reuseRuleMap]];
localReductionOutput=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s09_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[localReductionOutput],CreateDirectory[localReductionOutput,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
Print["LOCAL_REDUCTION_COVERAGE targets ",Length[targets]," uncovered ",Length[localUncovered]];
If[localUncovered=!={},Put[<|"Targets"->localUncovered,"MappingArtifactHash"->FileHash[mapPath,"SHA256"],
 "RuleLibraryHash"->FileHash[reusePath,"SHA256"],"SubsetReductionHash"->readySubsetHash,"Accepted"->False|>,
 FileNameJoin[{localReductionOutput,"s09_uncovered.wl"}]];Print["NEEDS_NATIVE_KIRA: uncovered local targets"];Quit[4]];
rules=Normal[KeyTake[reuseRuleMap,targets]];
masters=Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Last/@rules,_CutIntegral,Infinity]]];
gate["unique complete reused reduction keys",DuplicateFreeQ[First/@rules]&&Complement[targets,First/@rules]==={}];
gate["reused coefficients remain exact",FreeQ[rules,_Real|$Failed|$Aborted|_Missing]];
localFinalGates=localReductionBlock[reuseBase,"\ngate[\"unchanged complete original cut-master basis\"","\nresultDir ="];
ToExpression[localFinalGates,InputForm];
inputPaths=DeleteDuplicates[inputPaths];
inputHashes=Association[(StringDrop[#,StringLength[root]+1]->FileHash[#,"SHA256"])&/@inputPaths];
inputHash=Hash[{FileHash[localReductionSource,"SHA256"],inputHashes,$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-real-reduction-extension-v1","Channel"->channel,
 "Rules"->rules,"Masters"->masters,"Targets"->targets,"AdditionalTargets"->map["MissingTargets"],
 "Bounds"-><||>,"Families"->families,"CutEnergyConditions"->geometry["CutEnergyConditions"],

resultPath=FileNameJoin[{localReductionOutput,"s09_reduction.wl"}];
serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[bounded[Compress[result],"local reduction compression"],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["bounded reduction output",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];Export[resultPath<>".tmp",serialized,"Text"];
gate["exact native reduction reload",Get[resultPath<>".tmp"]===result];RenameFile[resultPath<>".tmp",resultPath,OverwriteTarget->True];
Export[FileNameJoin[{localReductionOutput,"s09_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"targets"->Length[targets],
 "masters"->Length[masters],"kira_run_performed"->False,"finite_nlo_fhats_computed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
```
