```wolfram
gate["accepted reference factorization definitions", TrueQ[recoilReceipt["passed"]] &&
  recoilReceipt["result_sha256"][recoilProofRelative] === IntegerString[FileHash[recoilProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64] &&
  recoilProof["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-recoil-factorization-comparison-v1" &&
  recoilProof["SourceHash"] === FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_check_recoil_factorization.wls"}],"SHA256"] &&
  And@@Values[recoilProof["Checks"]] && recoilProof["ProductionSourceHash"] === sourceHash &&
  recoilProof["NativeVersions"] === localAssemblyImportedVersions &&
  First[recoilProof["OriginalDefinitions"]] === DownValues[softRows]];
DownValues[recoilData] = recoilProof["HelperDefinitions"];
DownValues[softRows] = recoilProof["RowDefinitions"];
gate["exact reference endpoint factorization installed", DownValues[recoilData] === recoilProof["HelperDefinitions"] &&
  DownValues[softRows] === recoilProof["RowDefinitions"]];

referenceSeriesControlCode = "referenceOriginalOrdinary[component_] := Module[{coefficients,terms,ordinary},\n" <>
  "coefficients=Select[component[\"ReducedCoefficients\"],#=!=0&]/.transverseRule;\n" <>
  referenceSeriesOldCall <> "\nordinary];";
gate["original ordinary coefficient calculation syntax", SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesControlCode]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesControlCode, InputForm];
referenceSeriesIndices = Select[Range[Length[mapped["Components"]]],
  AnyTrue[Values[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]], # =!= 0 &] &];
gate["own nonzero ordinary control available", referenceSeriesIndices =!= {}];
referenceSeriesControlIndex = First[MinimalBy[referenceSeriesIndices,
  ByteCount[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]] &]];
referenceSeriesControl = mapped["Components"][[referenceSeriesControlIndex]];
referenceSeriesControlHash = Hash[referenceSeriesControl, "SHA256"];
referenceSeriesStudyDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, "misc", "s11_result", "own_reference"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[referenceSeriesStudyDirectory], CreateDirectory[referenceSeriesStudyDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
referenceSeriesStudyPath = FileNameJoin[{referenceSeriesStudyDirectory, "s12_result.wl"}];
referenceSeriesStudy = If[FileExistsQ[referenceSeriesStudyPath], Get[referenceSeriesStudyPath], <||>];
referenceSeriesBinding = Hash[{FileHash[referenceSeriesPath, "SHA256"], inputHash,
  FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"], referenceSeriesControlHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
If[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Binding", None] === referenceSeriesBinding &&
  TrueQ[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Accepted", False]] && AssociationQ[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Checks", None]] &&
  Length[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]] > 0 && And @@ Values[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]],
  referenceSeriesControlValue = referenceSeriesStudy["CandidateValue"],
  Print["OWN_REFERENCE_SERIES_CONTROL ", channel, " component ", referenceSeriesControlIndex,
    " input_bytes ", ByteCount[referenceSeriesControl["ReducedCoefficients"]]];
  ClearSystemCache[];
  referenceSeriesOriginalPath=FileNameJoin[{referenceSeriesStudyDirectory,"s12_original_ordinary.wl"}];
  referenceSeriesOriginalBinding=Hash[{referenceSeriesControl,transverseRule,regions["OrdinaryMasters"],
    DownValues[epsilonSeries],$Version,$FeynCalcVersion,$Assumptions},"SHA256"];
  referenceSeriesOriginalPacket=If[FileExistsQ[referenceSeriesOriginalPath],Get[referenceSeriesOriginalPath],<||>];
  If[Lookup[referenceSeriesOriginalPacket,"Binding",None]===referenceSeriesOriginalBinding&&
     KeyExistsQ[referenceSeriesOriginalPacket,"Value"]&&
     Lookup[referenceSeriesOriginalPacket,"ValueHash",None]===Hash[referenceSeriesOriginalPacket["Value"],"SHA256"],
    referenceSeriesOriginalValue=referenceSeriesOriginalPacket["Value"];referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds=0;
    gate["exact saved original ordinary reused",True],
    {referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds, referenceSeriesOriginalValue} = AbsoluteTiming[referenceOriginalOrdinary[referenceSeriesControl]];
    gate["original ordinary control fully evaluated",FreeQ[referenceSeriesOriginalValue,
     _CutIntegral|_SeriesData|_Series|_Integrate|_Missing|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted]];
    referenceSeriesOriginalPacket=<|"Binding"->referenceSeriesOriginalBinding,
     "Value"->referenceSeriesOriginalValue,"ValueHash"->Hash[referenceSeriesOriginalValue,"SHA256"],
     "Seconds"->referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}|>;
    put[referenceSeriesOriginalPacket,referenceSeriesOriginalPath]];
  ClearSystemCache[];
  {referenceSeriesCandidateSeconds, referenceSeriesControlValue} = AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[referenceSeriesControl, referenceSeriesControlIndex]];
  gate["own complete original ordinary contribution reproduced", bounded[
    zeroCoefficient[Expand[referenceSeriesControlValue - referenceSeriesOriginalValue, eps]], "own ordinary reference comparison"]];
  referenceSeriesStudy = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-own-reference-series-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
    "Binding" -> referenceSeriesBinding, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
    "SourceHash" -> FileHash[referenceSeriesPath, "SHA256"], "ParentProofHash" -> FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"],
    "ControlIndex" -> referenceSeriesControlIndex, "ControlHash" -> referenceSeriesControlHash,
    "ControlCoefficients" -> referenceSeriesControl["ReducedCoefficients"], "CandidateValue" -> referenceSeriesControlValue,
    "InputProjectionFootprint" -> referenceInputFootprint,
    "OriginalValue" -> referenceSeriesOriginalValue, "OriginalSeconds" -> referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds,
    "CandidateSeconds" -> referenceSeriesCandidateSeconds, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
    "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
  referenceSeriesSerialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[referenceSeriesStudy], InputForm] <> "]\n";
  gate["bounded own recurrence comparison output", StringLength[referenceSeriesSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
  Export[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp", referenceSeriesSerialized, "Text"];
  gate["exact own recurrence comparison reload", Get[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp"] === referenceSeriesStudy];
  RenameFile[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp", referenceSeriesStudyPath, OverwriteTarget -> True]];
gate["own reference recurrence comparison accepted", TrueQ[referenceSeriesStudy["Accepted"]] &&
  TrueQ[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]["own complete original ordinary contribution reproduced"]]];
Print["OWN_REFERENCE_SERIES_ACCEPTED ", channel, " ", InputForm[KeyTake[referenceSeriesStudy,
  {"ControlIndex", "OriginalSeconds", "CandidateSeconds"}]]];
referenceSeriesOrdinary[component_, index_] := If[index === referenceSeriesControlIndex,
  gate["reused own ordinary coefficient exact task", Hash[component, "SHA256"] === referenceSeriesControlHash];
  referenceSeriesControlValue, candidateOrdinary[component, index]];
(* Component-specific recoil memos are discarded after each unchanged assembly call. *)
localRecoilDefinitions=recoilProof["HelperDefinitions"];
gate["only general recoil definition retained",AllTrue[localRecoilDefinitions,!FreeQ[First[#],_Pattern]&]];
localMemoryAssemble[component_,index_]:=Module[
 {value,beforeDefinitions=DownValues[recoilData],beforeMemory=MemoryInUse[],memoBytes},
 value=Block[{recoilData},
  DownValues[recoilData]=localRecoilDefinitions;
  With[{answer=assemble[component,index]},memoBytes=ByteCount[DownValues[recoilData]];answer]];
 gate["component recoil definitions restored",DownValues[recoilData]===beforeDefinitions];
 ClearSystemCache[];
 Print["COMPONENT_MEMORY ",index," temporary_memo_bytes ",memoBytes,
  " memory_before ",beforeMemory," memory_after ",MemoryInUse[]];
 value];

(* Compare the complete smallest nonzero own component before remaining integration. *)
factoredControlIndex=referenceSeriesControlIndex;
factoredTask=mapped["Components"][[factoredControlIndex]];
factoredControlBinding=Hash[{FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,"SHA256"],inputHash,Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"],
  FileHash[recoilProofPath,"SHA256"],$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
factoredControlRoot=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s11_work","controls",IntegerString[factoredControlBinding,16]}];
factoredOriginalCache=FileNameJoin[{factoredControlRoot,"original"}];
factoredCandidateCache=FileNameJoin[{factoredControlRoot,"candidate"}];
Do[If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]],
  {directory,{factoredOriginalCache,factoredCandidateCache}}];
factoredCanonicalPath=FileNameJoin[{cache,"component_"<>IntegerString[factoredControlIndex,10,4]<>".wl"}];
If[FileExistsQ[factoredCanonicalPath],
  factoredControl=Get[factoredCanonicalPath];factoredOriginalSeconds=0,
  Print["OWN_ORIGINAL_ENDPOINT_CONTROL ",channel," ",factoredControlIndex];
  {factoredOriginalSeconds,factoredControl}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{cache=factoredOriginalCache,softRows,referenceSeriesOrdinary},
    DownValues[softRows]=referenceSeriesParent["OriginalDefinitions"][[3]];
    referenceSeriesOrdinary[component_,index_]:=(
      gate["original endpoint reuses exact own ordinary input",Hash[component,"SHA256"]===referenceSeriesControlHash];
      referenceSeriesStudy["OriginalValue"]);
    assemble[factoredTask,factoredControlIndex]]]];
gate["accepted own complete original control",AssociationQ[factoredControl] && TrueQ[factoredControl["Accepted"]] &&
  factoredControl["InputHash"]===inputHash && And@@Values[factoredControl["Checks"]] &&
  KeyTake[factoredControl,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]===KeyTake[factoredTask,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]];
factoredProofPath=FileNameJoin[{referenceSeriesStudyDirectory,"s12_endpoint_comparison.wl"}];
factoredProof=If[FileExistsQ[factoredProofPath],Get[factoredProofPath],<||>];
If[Lookup[factoredProof,"Binding",None]=!=factoredControlBinding || !TrueQ[Lookup[factoredProof,"Accepted",False]],
  {factoredControlSeconds,factoredControlValue}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{cache=factoredCandidateCache},localMemoryAssemble[factoredTask,factoredControlIndex]]];
  gate["own factored full component accepted",AssociationQ[factoredControlValue] && TrueQ[factoredControlValue["Accepted"]] &&
    And@@Values[factoredControlValue["Checks"]]];
  gate["own complete ordinary unchanged",bounded[zeroCoefficient[factoredControlValue["Ordinary"]-factoredControl["Ordinary"]],"ordinary control"]];
  Do[
    gate["own complete branch assumptions unchanged",factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]===factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]];
    Do[gate["own complete branch "<>ToString[{sign,key}],bounded[zeroCoefficient[
      factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign][key]-factoredControl["Branches"][sign][key]],"endpoint own comparison"]],{key,{"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"}}];
    factoredRows=factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    originalRows=factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    gate["own soft support unchanged",Length[factoredRows]===Length[originalRows] && (Take[#,2]&/@factoredRows)===(Take[#,2]&/@originalRows)];
    gate["own soft coefficients unchanged",And@@MapThread[bounded[zeroCoefficient[Last[#1]-Last[#2]],"own soft comparison"]&,{factoredRows,originalRows}]],
    {sign,{1,-1}}];
  factoredProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-factored-input-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,"Binding"->factoredControlBinding,
    "SourceHash"->FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
    "RecoilProofHash"->FileHash[recoilProofPath,"SHA256"],"ControlIndex"->factoredControlIndex,"ControlTaskHash"->Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"],
    "OriginalControl"->factoredControl,"CompleteControl"->factoredControlValue,"OriginalSeconds"->factoredOriginalSeconds,
    "ControlSeconds"->factoredControlSeconds,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>;
  factoredSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[factoredProof],InputForm]<>"]\n";
  gate["bounded factored comparison output",StringLength[factoredSerialized]<128*1024^2];
  Export[factoredProofPath<>".tmp",factoredSerialized,"Text"];
  gate["exact factored comparison reload",Get[factoredProofPath<>".tmp"]===factoredProof];
  RenameFile[factoredProofPath<>".tmp",factoredProofPath,OverwriteTarget->True]];
gate["complete own factored-input comparison accepted",TrueQ[factoredProof["Accepted"]] &&
  factoredProof["Binding"]===factoredControlBinding && factoredProof["ControlTaskHash"]===Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"] &&
  And@@Values[factoredProof["Checks"]]];
If[!FileExistsQ[factoredCanonicalPath],put[factoredProof["CompleteControl"],factoredCanonicalPath];
  gate["exact accepted own control reused",Get[factoredCanonicalPath]===factoredProof["CompleteControl"]]];
Print["OWN_FACTORED_INPUTS_ACCEPTED ",channel," ",InputForm[KeyTake[factoredProof,{"ControlIndex","OriginalSeconds","ControlSeconds"}]]];

referenceSeriesDistribute = "DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,branchAssumptions,reduce,epsilonSeries,laurentProduct,";
referenceSeriesOutput = "put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s11_result.wl\"}]];";
referenceSeriesChanges = {
  referenceSeriesDistribute -> (referenceSeriesDistribute <>
    "localExactRegulatorSeries,localSeriesRoot,localSeriesSource,recoilData,localRecoilDefinitions,localMemoryAssemble,rationalSeries,checkedRationalSeries,ordinaryMasterProduct,candidateOrdinary,zeroCoefficient,localCanonicalScalarArguments,referenceSeriesOrdinary,referenceSeriesControlIndex,referenceSeriesControlHash,referenceSeriesControlValue,"),
  referenceSeriesOutput -> ("AssociateTo[result,{\"ReferenceSeriesSourceHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,\"SHA256\"],\"OwnReferenceSeriesComparisonHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesStudyPath,\"SHA256\"],\"InputProjectionFootprint\"->referenceInputFootprint,\"FactoredInputComparisonHash\"->FileHash[factoredProofPath,\"SHA256\"]}];\n" <> referenceSeriesOutput)};
gate["unique unchanged integration worker and output interfaces", And @@ (StringCount[referenceSeriesTail, First[#]] === 1 & /@ referenceSeriesChanges)];
referenceSeriesRunTail = StringReplace[referenceSeriesTail, referenceSeriesChanges];
gate["complete original integration tail retained", StringReplace[referenceSeriesRunTail, Reverse /@ referenceSeriesChanges] === referenceSeriesTail && SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesRunTail]];
localAssemblyProvenance="AssociateTo[result,<|\"ExecutionBackend\"->\"local\",\"NativeVersions\"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},\"ImportedNativeVersions\"->localAssemblyImportedVersions,\"LocalDispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[localAssemblySource,\"SHA256\"],\"LocalConfigurationHash\"->FileHash[localAssemblyConfigPath,\"SHA256\"]|>];\n";
gate["unique local assembly export",StringCount[referenceSeriesRunTail,referenceSeriesOutput]===1];
localAssemblyRunTail=StringReplace[referenceSeriesRunTail,referenceSeriesOutput->localAssemblyProvenance<>referenceSeriesOutput];
gate["unchanged complete integration tail after provenance",SyntaxQ[localAssemblyRunTail]&&
 StringReplace[localAssemblyRunTail,localAssemblyProvenance<>referenceSeriesOutput->referenceSeriesOutput]===referenceSeriesRunTail];
localUnscopedRunTail=localAssemblyRunTail;
gate["complete worker task-call coverage",StringCount[localUnscopedRunTail,"assemble@@#&"]===2];
localAssemblyRunTail=StringReplace[localUnscopedRunTail,"assemble@@#&"->"localMemoryAssemble@@#&"];
gate["only task memory scope changed",SyntaxQ[localAssemblyRunTail]&&
 StringReplace[localAssemblyRunTail,"localMemoryAssemble@@#&"->"assemble@@#&"]===localUnscopedRunTail];
ToExpression[localAssemblyRunTail, InputForm];
```

```wolfram
    "ControlSeconds"->factoredControlSeconds,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>;
  factoredSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[factoredProof],InputForm]<>"]\n";
  gate["bounded factored comparison output",StringLength[factoredSerialized]<128*1024^2];
  Export[factoredProofPath<>".tmp",factoredSerialized,"Text"];
  gate["exact factored comparison reload",Get[factoredProofPath<>".tmp"]===factoredProof];
  RenameFile[factoredProofPath<>".tmp",factoredProofPath,OverwriteTarget->True]];
gate["complete own factored-input comparison accepted",TrueQ[factoredProof["Accepted"]] &&
  factoredProof["Binding"]===factoredControlBinding && factoredProof["ControlTaskHash"]===Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"] &&
  And@@Values[factoredProof["Checks"]]];
If[!FileExistsQ[factoredCanonicalPath],put[factoredProof["CompleteControl"],factoredCanonicalPath];
  gate["exact accepted own control reused",Get[factoredCanonicalPath]===factoredProof["CompleteControl"]]];
Print["OWN_FACTORED_INPUTS_ACCEPTED ",channel," ",InputForm[KeyTake[factoredProof,{"ControlIndex","OriginalSeconds","ControlSeconds"}]]];

referenceSeriesDistribute = "DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,branchAssumptions,reduce,epsilonSeries,laurentProduct,";
referenceSeriesOutput = "put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s11_result.wl\"}]];";
referenceSeriesChanges = {
  referenceSeriesDistribute -> (referenceSeriesDistribute <>
    "recoilData,localRecoilDefinitions,localMemoryAssemble,rationalSeries,checkedRationalSeries,ordinaryMasterProduct,candidateOrdinary,zeroCoefficient,localCanonicalScalarArguments,referenceSeriesOrdinary,referenceSeriesControlIndex,referenceSeriesControlHash,referenceSeriesControlValue,"),
  referenceSeriesOutput -> ("AssociateTo[result,{\"ReferenceSeriesSourceHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,\"SHA256\"],\"OwnReferenceSeriesComparisonHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesStudyPath,\"SHA256\"],\"InputProjectionFootprint\"->referenceInputFootprint,\"FactoredInputComparisonHash\"->FileHash[factoredProofPath,\"SHA256\"]}];\n" <> referenceSeriesOutput)};
gate["unique unchanged integration worker and output interfaces", And @@ (StringCount[referenceSeriesTail, First[#]] === 1 & /@ referenceSeriesChanges)];
referenceSeriesRunTail = StringReplace[referenceSeriesTail, referenceSeriesChanges];
gate["complete original integration tail retained", StringReplace[referenceSeriesRunTail, Reverse /@ referenceSeriesChanges] === referenceSeriesTail && SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesRunTail]];
localAssemblyProvenance="AssociateTo[result,<|\"ExecutionBackend\"->\"local\",\"NativeVersions\"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},\"ImportedNativeVersions\"->localAssemblyImportedVersions,\"LocalDispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[localAssemblySource,\"SHA256\"],\"LocalConfigurationHash\"->FileHash[localAssemblyConfigPath,\"SHA256\"]|>];\n";
gate["unique local assembly export",StringCount[referenceSeriesRunTail,referenceSeriesOutput]===1];
localAssemblyRunTail=StringReplace[referenceSeriesRunTail,referenceSeriesOutput->localAssemblyProvenance<>referenceSeriesOutput];
gate["unchanged complete integration tail after provenance",SyntaxQ[localAssemblyRunTail]&&
 StringReplace[localAssemblyRunTail,localAssemblyProvenance<>referenceSeriesOutput->referenceSeriesOutput]===referenceSeriesRunTail];
localUnscopedRunTail=localAssemblyRunTail;
gate["complete worker task-call coverage",StringCount[localUnscopedRunTail,"assemble@@#&"]===2];
localAssemblyRunTail=StringReplace[localUnscopedRunTail,"assemble@@#&"->"localMemoryAssemble@@#&"];
gate["only task memory scope changed",SyntaxQ[localAssemblyRunTail]&&
 StringReplace[localAssemblyRunTail,"localMemoryAssemble@@#&"->"assemble@@#&"]===localUnscopedRunTail];
ToExpression[localAssemblyRunTail, InputForm];
```

```wolfram
(* Local runtime and bounded storage for the unchanged reference real assembly. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
localAssemblyRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[localAssemblyRoot];

localAssemblyConfig=Import[localAssemblyConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
localAssemblyRequire[n_,x_]:=If[!TrueQ[x],Print["FAIL: ",n];Quit[1]];

 IntegerString[FileHash[localAssemblySource,"SHA256"],16,64]===localAssemblyConfig["source_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{p,h},localAssemblyRequire["pinned assembly input "<>p,
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{localAssemblyRoot,p}],"SHA256"],16,64]===h]],localAssemblyConfig["input_sha256"]];
SetEnvironment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"->"Hgg"];
```

```wolfram
localRecoilReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s31_result","s31_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted exact endpoint derivative receipt",TrueQ[localRecoilReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localRecoilReceipt["source_sha256"]===IntegerString[FileHash[localRecoilSource,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 localRecoilReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s31_result/s31_result.wl"]===
  IntegerString[FileHash[localRecoilProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
localRecoilProof=Get[localRecoilProofPath];
gate["accepted endpoint derivative comparison",TrueQ[localRecoilProof["Accepted"]]&&
 And@@Values[localRecoilProof["Checks"]]&&localRecoilProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
 DownValues[recoilData]===recoilProof["HelperDefinitions"]];
Get[localRecoilSource];
gate["exact executed endpoint helpers",DownValues[localExactRecoilRatio]===localRecoilProof["Definitions"]&&
 DownValues[localRecoilTerms]===localRecoilProof["TermDefinitions"]];
localRecoilReferenceText=ReadString[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_check_recoil_factorization.wls"}]];
localRecoilStart="recoilData[coefficient_, sign_] :=";localRecoilEnd="\nsoftRows[";
gate["unique complete reference recoil definition",StringCount[localRecoilReferenceText,localRecoilStart]===1&&
 StringCount[localRecoilReferenceText,localRecoilEnd]===1];
localRecoilOriginal=localRecoilStart<>First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[localRecoilReferenceText,localRecoilStart]],localRecoilEnd]];
localRecoilOldReduction="  ratio = bounded[Factor[Together[derivative]], \"reduce actual logarithmic derivative\"];\n  gate[\"exact reduced logarithmic derivative\", bounded[Factor[Together[ratio - derivative]] === 0,\n    \"logarithmic derivative reconstruction\"]];";
localRecoilNewReduction="  ratio = localExactRecoilRatio[rational];";
gate["single exact derivative reduction replacement",StringCount[localRecoilOriginal,localRecoilOldReduction]===1];
localRecoilChanged=StringReplace[localRecoilOriginal,localRecoilOldReduction->localRecoilNewReduction];
gate["complete original recoil contract retained",SyntaxQ[localRecoilChanged]&&
 StringReplace[localRecoilChanged,localRecoilNewReduction->localRecoilOldReduction]===localRecoilOriginal];
ToExpression[localRecoilChanged,InputForm];

referenceSeriesControlCode = "referenceOriginalOrdinary[component_] := Module[{coefficients,terms,ordinary},\n" <>
  "coefficients=Select[component[\"ReducedCoefficients\"],#=!=0&]/.transverseRule;\n" <>
  referenceSeriesOldCall <> "\nordinary];";
gate["original ordinary coefficient calculation syntax", SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesControlCode]];
ToExpression[referenceSeriesControlCode, InputForm];
referenceSeriesIndices = Select[Range[Length[mapped["Components"]]],
  AnyTrue[Values[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]], # =!= 0 &] &];
gate["own nonzero ordinary control available", referenceSeriesIndices =!= {}];
referenceSeriesControlIndex = First[MinimalBy[referenceSeriesIndices,
  ByteCount[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]] &]];
referenceSeriesControl = mapped["Components"][[referenceSeriesControlIndex]];
referenceSeriesControlHash = Hash[referenceSeriesControl, "SHA256"];
referenceSeriesStudyDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, "misc", "s11_result", "own_reference"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[referenceSeriesStudyDirectory], CreateDirectory[referenceSeriesStudyDirectory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
referenceSeriesStudyPath = FileNameJoin[{referenceSeriesStudyDirectory, "s12_result.wl"}];
referenceSeriesStudy = If[FileExistsQ[referenceSeriesStudyPath], Get[referenceSeriesStudyPath], <||>];
referenceSeriesBinding = Hash[{FileHash[referenceSeriesPath, "SHA256"], inputHash,
  FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"], referenceSeriesControlHash, $Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "SHA256"];
If[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Binding", None] === referenceSeriesBinding &&
  TrueQ[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Accepted", False]] && AssociationQ[Lookup[referenceSeriesStudy, "Checks", None]] &&
  Length[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]] > 0 && And @@ Values[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]],
  referenceSeriesControlValue = referenceSeriesStudy["CandidateValue"],
  Print["OWN_REFERENCE_SERIES_CONTROL ", channel, " component ", referenceSeriesControlIndex,
    " input_bytes ", ByteCount[referenceSeriesControl["ReducedCoefficients"]]];
  ClearSystemCache[];
  referenceSeriesOriginalPath=FileNameJoin[{referenceSeriesStudyDirectory,"s12_original_ordinary.wl"}];
  referenceSeriesOriginalBinding=Hash[{referenceSeriesControl,transverseRule,regions["OrdinaryMasters"],
    DownValues[epsilonSeries],$Version,$FeynCalcVersion,$Assumptions},"SHA256"];
  referenceSeriesOriginalPacket=If[FileExistsQ[referenceSeriesOriginalPath],Get[referenceSeriesOriginalPath],<||>];
  If[Lookup[referenceSeriesOriginalPacket,"Binding",None]===referenceSeriesOriginalBinding&&
     KeyExistsQ[referenceSeriesOriginalPacket,"Value"]&&
     Lookup[referenceSeriesOriginalPacket,"ValueHash",None]===Hash[referenceSeriesOriginalPacket["Value"],"SHA256"],
    referenceSeriesOriginalValue=referenceSeriesOriginalPacket["Value"];referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds=0;
    gate["exact saved original ordinary reused",True],
    {referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds, referenceSeriesOriginalValue} = AbsoluteTiming[referenceOriginalOrdinary[referenceSeriesControl]];
    gate["original ordinary control fully evaluated",FreeQ[referenceSeriesOriginalValue,
     _CutIntegral|_SeriesData|_Series|_Integrate|_Missing|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted]];
    referenceSeriesOriginalPacket=<|"Binding"->referenceSeriesOriginalBinding,
     "Value"->referenceSeriesOriginalValue,"ValueHash"->Hash[referenceSeriesOriginalValue,"SHA256"],
     "Seconds"->referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}|>;
    put[referenceSeriesOriginalPacket,referenceSeriesOriginalPath]];
  ClearSystemCache[];
  {referenceSeriesCandidateSeconds, referenceSeriesControlValue} = AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[referenceSeriesControl, referenceSeriesControlIndex]];
  gate["own complete original ordinary contribution reproduced", bounded[
    zeroCoefficient[Expand[referenceSeriesControlValue - referenceSeriesOriginalValue, eps]], "own ordinary reference comparison"]];
  referenceSeriesStudy = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-own-reference-series-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
    "Binding" -> referenceSeriesBinding, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
    "SourceHash" -> FileHash[referenceSeriesPath, "SHA256"], "ParentProofHash" -> FileHash[referenceSeriesParentPath, "SHA256"],
    "ControlIndex" -> referenceSeriesControlIndex, "ControlHash" -> referenceSeriesControlHash,
    "ControlCoefficients" -> referenceSeriesControl["ReducedCoefficients"], "CandidateValue" -> referenceSeriesControlValue,
    "InputProjectionFootprint" -> referenceInputFootprint,
    "OriginalValue" -> referenceSeriesOriginalValue, "OriginalSeconds" -> referenceSeriesOriginalSeconds,
    "CandidateSeconds" -> referenceSeriesCandidateSeconds, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
    "Checks" -> checks, "Accepted" -> True, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
  referenceSeriesSerialized = "Uncompress[" <> ToString[Compress[referenceSeriesStudy], InputForm] <> "]\n";
  gate["bounded own recurrence comparison output", StringLength[referenceSeriesSerialized] < 128*1024^2];
  Export[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp", referenceSeriesSerialized, "Text"];
  gate["exact own recurrence comparison reload", Get[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp"] === referenceSeriesStudy];
  RenameFile[referenceSeriesStudyPath <> ".tmp", referenceSeriesStudyPath, OverwriteTarget -> True]];
gate["own reference recurrence comparison accepted", TrueQ[referenceSeriesStudy["Accepted"]] &&
  TrueQ[referenceSeriesStudy["Checks"]["own complete original ordinary contribution reproduced"]]];
Print["OWN_REFERENCE_SERIES_ACCEPTED ", channel, " ", InputForm[KeyTake[referenceSeriesStudy,
  {"ControlIndex", "OriginalSeconds", "CandidateSeconds"}]]];
referenceSeriesOrdinary[component_, index_] := If[index === referenceSeriesControlIndex,
  gate["reused own ordinary coefficient exact task", Hash[component, "SHA256"] === referenceSeriesControlHash];
  referenceSeriesControlValue, candidateOrdinary[component, index]];
(* Component-specific recoil memos are discarded after each unchanged assembly call. *)
localRecoilDefinitions=Select[DownValues[recoilData],!FreeQ[First[#],_Pattern]&];
gate["only general recoil definition retained",AllTrue[localRecoilDefinitions,!FreeQ[First[#],_Pattern]&]];
localMemoryAssemble[component_,index_]:=Module[
 {value,beforeDefinitions=DownValues[recoilData],beforeMemory=MemoryInUse[],memoBytes},
 value=Block[{recoilData},
  DownValues[recoilData]=localRecoilDefinitions;
  With[{answer=assemble[component,index]},memoBytes=ByteCount[DownValues[recoilData]];answer]];
 gate["component recoil definitions restored",DownValues[recoilData]===beforeDefinitions];
 ClearSystemCache[];
 Print["COMPONENT_MEMORY ",index," temporary_memo_bytes ",memoBytes,
  " memory_before ",beforeMemory," memory_after ",MemoryInUse[]];
 value];

(* Compare the complete smallest nonzero own component before remaining integration. *)
factoredControlIndex=referenceSeriesControlIndex;
factoredTask=mapped["Components"][[factoredControlIndex]];
factoredControlBinding=Hash[{FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,"SHA256"],inputHash,Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"],
  FileHash[recoilProofPath,"SHA256"],$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
factoredControlRoot=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s11_work","controls",IntegerString[factoredControlBinding,16]}];
factoredOriginalCache=FileNameJoin[{factoredControlRoot,"original"}];
factoredCandidateCache=FileNameJoin[{factoredControlRoot,"candidate"}];
Do[If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]],
  {directory,{factoredOriginalCache,factoredCandidateCache}}];
factoredCanonicalPath=FileNameJoin[{cache,"component_"<>IntegerString[factoredControlIndex,10,4]<>".wl"}];
If[FileExistsQ[factoredCanonicalPath],
  factoredControl=Get[factoredCanonicalPath];factoredOriginalSeconds=0,
  Print["OWN_ORIGINAL_ENDPOINT_CONTROL ",channel," ",factoredControlIndex];
  {factoredOriginalSeconds,factoredControl}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{cache=factoredOriginalCache,softRows,referenceSeriesOrdinary},
    DownValues[softRows]=referenceSeriesParent["OriginalDefinitions"][[3]];
    referenceSeriesOrdinary[component_,index_]:=(
      gate["original endpoint reuses exact own ordinary input",Hash[component,"SHA256"]===referenceSeriesControlHash];
      referenceSeriesStudy["OriginalValue"]);
    assemble[factoredTask,factoredControlIndex]]]];
gate["accepted own complete original control",AssociationQ[factoredControl] && TrueQ[factoredControl["Accepted"]] &&
  factoredControl["InputHash"]===inputHash && And@@Values[factoredControl["Checks"]] &&
  KeyTake[factoredControl,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]===KeyTake[factoredTask,{"Sector","Kind","Index"}]];
factoredProofPath=FileNameJoin[{referenceSeriesStudyDirectory,"s12_endpoint_comparison.wl"}];
factoredProof=If[FileExistsQ[factoredProofPath],Get[factoredProofPath],<||>];
If[Lookup[factoredProof,"Binding",None]=!=factoredControlBinding || !TrueQ[Lookup[factoredProof,"Accepted",False]],
  {factoredControlSeconds,factoredControlValue}=AbsoluteTiming[Block[{cache=factoredCandidateCache},localMemoryAssemble[factoredTask,factoredControlIndex]]];
  gate["own factored full component accepted",AssociationQ[factoredControlValue] && TrueQ[factoredControlValue["Accepted"]] &&
    And@@Values[factoredControlValue["Checks"]]];
  gate["own complete ordinary unchanged",bounded[zeroCoefficient[factoredControlValue["Ordinary"]-factoredControl["Ordinary"]],"ordinary control"]];
  Do[
    gate["own complete branch assumptions unchanged",factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]===factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["Assumptions"]];
    Do[gate["own complete branch "<>ToString[{sign,key}],bounded[zeroCoefficient[
      factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign][key]-factoredControl["Branches"][sign][key]],"endpoint own comparison"]],{key,{"Delta","L0","L1","Regular"}}];
    factoredRows=factoredControlValue["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    originalRows=factoredControl["Branches"][sign]["SoftCoefficients"];
    gate["own soft support unchanged",Length[factoredRows]===Length[originalRows] && (Take[#,2]&/@factoredRows)===(Take[#,2]&/@originalRows)];
    gate["own soft coefficients unchanged",And@@MapThread[bounded[zeroCoefficient[Last[#1]-Last[#2]],"own soft comparison"]&,{factoredRows,originalRows}]],
    {sign,{1,-1}}];
  factoredProof=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-factored-input-comparison-v1","Channel"->channel,"Binding"->factoredControlBinding,
    "SourceHash"->FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
    "RecoilProofHash"->FileHash[recoilProofPath,"SHA256"],"ControlIndex"->factoredControlIndex,"ControlTaskHash"->Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"],
    "OriginalControl"->factoredControl,"CompleteControl"->factoredControlValue,"OriginalSeconds"->factoredOriginalSeconds,
    "ControlSeconds"->factoredControlSeconds,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"Accepted"->True|>;
  factoredSerialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[factoredProof],InputForm]<>"]\n";
  gate["bounded factored comparison output",StringLength[factoredSerialized]<128*1024^2];
  Export[factoredProofPath<>".tmp",factoredSerialized,"Text"];
  gate["exact factored comparison reload",Get[factoredProofPath<>".tmp"]===factoredProof];
  RenameFile[factoredProofPath<>".tmp",factoredProofPath,OverwriteTarget->True]];
gate["complete own factored-input comparison accepted",TrueQ[factoredProof["Accepted"]] &&
  factoredProof["Binding"]===factoredControlBinding && factoredProof["ControlTaskHash"]===Hash[factoredTask,"SHA256"] &&
  And@@Values[factoredProof["Checks"]]];
If[!FileExistsQ[factoredCanonicalPath],put[factoredProof["CompleteControl"],factoredCanonicalPath];
  gate["exact accepted own control reused",Get[factoredCanonicalPath]===factoredProof["CompleteControl"]]];
Print["OWN_FACTORED_INPUTS_ACCEPTED ",channel," ",InputForm[KeyTake[factoredProof,{"ControlIndex","OriginalSeconds","ControlSeconds"}]]];

referenceSeriesDistribute = "DistributeDefinitions[gate,put,bounded,branchAssumptions,reduce,epsilonSeries,laurentProduct,";
referenceSeriesOutput = "put[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s11_result.wl\"}]];";
referenceSeriesChanges = {
  referenceSeriesDistribute -> (referenceSeriesDistribute <>
    "localExactRegulatorSeries,localSeriesRoot,localSeriesSource,localRecoilTerms,localExactRecoilRatio,localRecoilRoot,localRecoilSource,recoilData,localRecoilDefinitions,localMemoryAssemble,rationalSeries,checkedRationalSeries,ordinaryMasterProduct,candidateOrdinary,zeroCoefficient,localCanonicalScalarArguments,referenceSeriesOrdinary,referenceSeriesControlIndex,referenceSeriesControlHash,referenceSeriesControlValue,"),
  referenceSeriesOutput -> ("AssociateTo[result,{\"ReferenceSeriesSourceHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesPath,\"SHA256\"],\"OwnReferenceSeriesComparisonHash\"->FileHash[referenceSeriesStudyPath,\"SHA256\"],\"InputProjectionFootprint\"->referenceInputFootprint,\"FactoredInputComparisonHash\"->FileHash[factoredProofPath,\"SHA256\"]}];\n" <> referenceSeriesOutput)};
gate["unique unchanged integration worker and output interfaces", And @@ (StringCount[referenceSeriesTail, First[#]] === 1 & /@ referenceSeriesChanges)];
referenceSeriesRunTail = StringReplace[referenceSeriesTail, referenceSeriesChanges];
gate["complete original integration tail retained", StringReplace[referenceSeriesRunTail, Reverse /@ referenceSeriesChanges] === referenceSeriesTail && SyntaxQ[referenceSeriesRunTail]];
localAssemblyProvenance="AssociateTo[result,<|\"ExecutionBackend\"->\"local\",\"NativeVersions\"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},\"ImportedNativeVersions\"->localAssemblyImportedVersions,\"LocalDispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[localAssemblySource,\"SHA256\"],\"LocalConfigurationHash\"->FileHash[localAssemblyConfigPath,\"SHA256\"]|>];\n";
gate["unique local assembly export",StringCount[referenceSeriesRunTail,referenceSeriesOutput]===1];
localAssemblyRunTail=StringReplace[referenceSeriesRunTail,referenceSeriesOutput->localAssemblyProvenance<>referenceSeriesOutput];
gate["unchanged complete integration tail after provenance",SyntaxQ[localAssemblyRunTail]&&
 StringReplace[localAssemblyRunTail,localAssemblyProvenance<>referenceSeriesOutput->referenceSeriesOutput]===referenceSeriesRunTail];
localUnscopedRunTail=localAssemblyRunTail;
gate["complete worker task-call coverage",StringCount[localUnscopedRunTail,"assemble@@#&"]===2];
localAssemblyRunTail=StringReplace[localUnscopedRunTail,"assemble@@#&"->"localMemoryAssemble@@#&"];
gate["only task memory scope changed",SyntaxQ[localAssemblyRunTail]&&
 StringReplace[localAssemblyRunTail,"localMemoryAssemble@@#&"->"assemble@@#&"]===localUnscopedRunTail];
ToExpression[localAssemblyRunTail, InputForm];
```

## misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-106", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 20666, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls", "sha256": "668d8910f400f82431f5fa566a71988723ca40a44a64e16c347e28104bc8b304"} -->
```wolfram
(* Local execution of the unchanged native Hgg finite assembly. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
localFiniteRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[localFiniteRoot];
localFiniteSource=FileNameJoin[{localFiniteRoot,"misc","s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"}];
localFiniteConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{localFiniteRoot,"misc","s14_inputs.json"}];
localFiniteConfig=Import[localFiniteConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
localFiniteRequire[n_,x_]:=If[!TrueQ[x],Print["FAIL: ",n];Quit[1]];
localFiniteRequire["bound complete finite source",SyntaxQ[ReadString[localFiniteSource]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===localFiniteConfig["source_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{p,h},localFiniteRequire["pinned finite input "<>p,
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{localFiniteRoot,p}],"SHA256"],16,64]===h]],localFiniteConfig["input_sha256"]];
SetEnvironment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"->"Hgg"];
localFiniteChange[text_,edits_]:=Module[{candidate},
 localFiniteRequire["unique reviewed finite interfaces",And@@(StringCount[text,First[#]]===1&/@edits)];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,edits];localFiniteRequire["complete preserved finite implementation",SyntaxQ[candidate]&&
 StringReplace[candidate,Reverse/@edits]===text];candidate];
localFinitePrefix[text_]:=localFiniteChange[text,{"gate[\"compute allocation\",StringQ[Environment[\"JOB_ID\"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,\"login\"]];\ngate[\"isolated runtime\",StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>\"/\"]];"->"gate[\"authorized local finite assembly\",Environment[\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED\"]===\"1\"&&$VersionNumber===15.];",
"inputPaths={configPath,basePath};"->"inputPaths={configPath,basePath,localFiniteSource,localFiniteConfigPath,FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s11_result\",\"s11_execution.json\"}]};",
"real=loadResult[channel<>\"/s12_result/s12_result.wl\"];"->"real=loadResult[\"misc/s11_result/s11_result.wl\"];\nlocalFiniteImportedVersions=real[\"ImportedNativeVersions\"];\nlocalFiniteReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s11_result\",\"s11_execution.json\"}],\"RawJSON\"];\ngate[\"actual accepted local integrated input\",real[\"NativeVersions\"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&\n Last[localFiniteImportedVersions]===$FeynCalcVersion&&TrueQ[localFiniteReceipt[\"passed\"]]&&\n localFiniteReceipt[\"execution_backend\"]===\"local\"&&\n localFiniteReceipt[\"result_sha256\"][\"misc/s11_result/s11_result.wl\"]===IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s11_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}],\"SHA256\"],16,64]];",
"cache=FileNameJoin[{root,\"cache\",\"s14\",channel,IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];"->"cache=FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s14_work\",IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];",
"saved=If[FileExistsQ[file],Get[file],<||>];"->"saved=localFiniteRead[label,file];"}];
localFinitePhase[text_]:=localFiniteChange[text,{
 "phaseRunProof[\"NativeVersions\"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}"->
 "phaseRunProof[\"NativeVersions\"]===localFiniteImportedVersions",
 "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"->"If[!MemberQ[$Packages,\"FeynCalc`\"],Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]]"}];
(* Keep the accepted assembly and consume Hgg's native MS subtraction. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
hggNativeSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_Hgg_native_subtraction.wls"}];
hggNativeBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_compact_inputs.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[hggNativeBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "0e87dc4d088369ad3cd9754e31c5aedd4e6a80db2f18b3d318abb345cd68a613"||
 !SyntaxQ[Import[hggNativeSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
hggNativeAdapt[text_]:=Module[{old,new,candidate},
 old="subtraction=loadResult[channel<>\"/s11_result/s11_result.wl\"];";
 new="gate[\"own native-subtraction assembly\",channel===\"Hgg\"&&!core];"<>
  "subtraction=loadResult[channel<>\"/s11_native_result/s11_result.wl\"];"<>
  "hggNativeReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_native_result\",\"s11_execution.json\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeSubtractionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_native_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeSubtractionSource=FileNameJoin[{root,\"common\",\"s11_Hgg_native_routes.wls\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeReceipt=Import[hggNativeReceiptPath,\"RawJSON\"];"<>
  "gate[\"bound accepted native subtraction\",TrueQ[hggNativeReceipt[\"passed\"]]&&"<>
   "hggNativeReceipt[\"result_sha256\"][channel<>\"/s11_native_result/s11_result.wl\"]===IntegerString[FileHash[hggNativeSubtractionPath,\"SHA256\"],16,64]&&"<>
   "subtraction[\"SourceHash\"]===FileHash[hggNativeSubtractionSource,\"SHA256\"]&&"<>
   "TrueQ[subtraction[\"AcceptedForProduction\"]]&&TrueQ[subtraction[\"OwnAcceptedSubtractionComparison\"]]&&"<>
   "TrueQ[subtraction[\"FiniteDimensionalSchemeConversionApplied\"]]&&And@@Values[subtraction[\"Checks\"]]&&"<>
   "subtraction[\"OriginalSubtractionHash\"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}],\"SHA256\"]&&"<>
   "FreeQ[subtraction[\"NativeCountertermDifference\"],eps|D|_SeriesData|$Failed|$Aborted]];"<>
  "inputPaths=Join[inputPaths,{hggNativeSource,hggNativeBase,hggNativeReceiptPath,hggNativeSubtractionSource}];";
 If[StringCount[text,old]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique Hgg subtraction input"];Quit[1]];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,old->new];
 If[!SyntaxQ[candidate]||StringReplace[candidate,new->old]=!=text,
  Print["FAIL: unchanged full Hgg assembly prefix"];Quit[1]];candidate];
hggNativeInitialization[text_]:=Module[{old,new,candidate},
 old="ToExpression[phaseRunPrefix,InputForm];";
 new="phaseRunPrefix=localFinitePrefix[hggNativeAdapt[phaseRunPrefix]];"<>old;
 If[StringCount[text,old]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique native assembly prefix handoff"];Quit[1]];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,old->new];
 If[!SyntaxQ[candidate]||StringReplace[candidate,new->old]=!=text,Quit[1]];candidate];
hggNativeText=StringTrim[Import[hggNativeBase,"Text"]];hggNativeTerminal="ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[hggNativeText,hggNativeTerminal],Quit[1]];
hggNativePrefix=StringDrop[hggNativeText,-StringLength[hggNativeTerminal]];
hggNativeEntry="ToExpression[compactAssemblyInitialization,InputForm];";
hggNativeChangedEntry="compactAssemblyInitialization=localFinitePhase[hggNativeInitialization[compactAssemblyInitialization]];"<>hggNativeEntry;
If[StringCount[hggNativePrefix,hggNativeEntry]=!=1,Quit[1]];
hggNativePrefixCandidate=StringReplace[hggNativePrefix,hggNativeEntry->hggNativeChangedEntry];
If[!SyntaxQ[hggNativePrefixCandidate]||StringReplace[hggNativePrefixCandidate,hggNativeChangedEntry->hggNativeEntry]=!=hggNativePrefix,Quit[1]];

(* Reuse the accepted regulator-only phase helper and exact native checkpoints. *)
localFinitePhasePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s34_regulator_only_phase_product.wls"}];
localFiniteProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s34_result","s34_result.wl"}];

gate["accepted complete phase optimization",TrueQ[localFiniteProofReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localFiniteProofReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s34_result/s34_result.wl"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
localFiniteProof=KeyDrop[Get[localFiniteProofPath],{"Candidates","Finite"}];
gate["exact phase proof source and runtime",TrueQ[localFiniteProof["Accepted"]]&&
 And@@Values[localFiniteProof["Checks"]]&&localFiniteProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[localFinitePhasePath,"SHA256"]&&
 localFiniteProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}];
localFiniteChangedInputKeys={"misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls","misc/s14_inputs.json"};
gate["all original mathematical assembly inputs unchanged",
 KeyDrop[inputHashes,localFiniteChangedInputKeys]===KeyDrop[localFiniteProof["InputHashes"],localFiniteChangedInputKeys]&&
 Hash[{sourceHash,localFiniteProof["InputHashes"],$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"]===localFiniteProof["InputHash"]];
Get[localFinitePhasePath];localPhaseInstall[];
gate["validated complete phase implementation installed",DownValues[laurentProduct]===localFiniteProof["LaurentDefinitions"]];
localFiniteResumePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_resume.json"}];
localFiniteResume=Import[localFiniteResumePath,"RawJSON"];
gate["original complete assembly source pinned for reuse",
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,localFiniteResume["parent_source"]}],"SHA256"]===
 localFiniteProof["InputHashes"]["misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"]&&
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,localFiniteResume["parent_config"]}],"SHA256"]===
 localFiniteProof["InputHashes"]["misc/s14_inputs.json"]];

localFiniteGateProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s36_result","s36_result.json"}];

gate["accepted exact scoped Laurent predicate",TrueQ[localFiniteGateReceipt["passed"]]&&

 And@@Values[localFiniteGateProof["checks"]]&&localFiniteGateProof["source_sha256"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}],"SHA256"],16,64]];
localFiniteParentSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_scoped_polynomial_gate","s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"}];
localFiniteParentConfig=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_scoped_polynomial_gate","s14_inputs.json"}];
gate["bound accepted predicate parent generation",

 "misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"->FileHash[localFiniteParentSource,"SHA256"],
 "misc/s14_inputs.json"->FileHash[localFiniteParentConfig,"SHA256"]}];
localFiniteParentInputHash=Hash[{sourceHash,localFiniteParentInputs,$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
localFiniteAcceptedInputHashes={localFiniteProof["InputHash"],localFiniteParentInputHash};


localFiniteFinalParentSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_exact_hat_comparison","s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"}];
localFiniteFinalParentConfig=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_exact_hat_comparison","s14_inputs.json"}];
localFiniteCaptureReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s37_result","s37_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted full-component parent generation",
 TrueQ[localFiniteCaptureReceipt["passed"]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteFinalParentSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===
 localFiniteCaptureReceipt["input_sha256"]["misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteFinalParentConfig,"SHA256"],16,64]===
 localFiniteCaptureReceipt["input_sha256"]["misc/s14_inputs.json"]];
localFiniteFinalParentInputs=inputHashes;

AppendTo[localFiniteAcceptedInputHashes,
 Hash[{sourceHash,localFiniteFinalParentInputs,$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"]];

localFiniteReused=<||>;
localFiniteRead[label_,currentPath_]:=Module[{name,row,path,saved},
 If[FileExistsQ[currentPath],Return[Get[currentPath]]];
 name=FileNameTake[currentPath];
 If[!KeyExistsQ[localFiniteResume["files"],name],Return[<||>]];
 row=localFiniteResume["files"][name];path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["path"]}];
 gate["pinned accepted finite checkpoint "<>ToString[label,InputForm],
  IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["sha256"]];
 saved=Get[path];
 gate["exact accepted finite checkpoint identity "<>ToString[label,InputForm],
  TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&saved["Label"]===label&&MemberQ[localFiniteAcceptedInputHashes,saved["InputHash"]]&&
  KeyExistsQ[saved,"Finite"]&&KeyExistsQ[saved,"PoleResiduals"]];
 AssociateTo[localFiniteReused,name-><|"Label"->label,"Path"->row["path"],"SHA256"->row["sha256"]|>];
 Join[saved,<|"InputHash"->inputHash,"OriginalInputHash"->saved["InputHash"],"CheckpointSHA256"->row["sha256"]|>]];

 And@@Values[localFiniteSumProof["Checks"]]&&TrueQ[localFiniteSumProof["PoleCancellationResolved"]]&&
 localFiniteSumProof["OwnValue"]=!=0];
Get[localFiniteSumPath];
localFinitePoleReduce[value_,assumptions_]:=Module[{expression=reduce[value,assumptions]},
 If[FreeQ[expression,_Log|_PolyLog|_ArcTan|_ArcTanh|_Re|_Im|_Abs|_Piecewise|_ConditionalExpression|_Sign],
  localFiniteExactSum[expression],expression]];
localFinitePoleOld="reduce[Coefficient[combined,eps,n],assumptions]";
localFinitePoleNew="localFinitePoleReduce[Coefficient[combined,eps,n],assumptions]";
localFinitePoleStart="finitePart[parts_,label_,assumptions_] :=";
localFinitePoleEnd="\ndistributions=";
localFinitePoleText=ReadString[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}]];

 StringCount[localFinitePoleText,localFinitePoleEnd]===1];

 Last[StringSplit[localFinitePoleText,localFinitePoleStart]],localFinitePoleEnd]];

 "saved=If[FileExistsQ[file],Get[file],<||>];"->"saved=localFiniteRead[label,file];"}];
```

```wolfram
(* Local execution of the unchanged native Hgg finite assembly. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
localFiniteRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[localFiniteRoot];
localFiniteSource=FileNameJoin[{localFiniteRoot,"misc","s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"}];
localFiniteConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{localFiniteRoot,"misc","s14_inputs.json"}];
localFiniteConfig=Import[localFiniteConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
localFiniteRequire[n_,x_]:=If[!TrueQ[x],Print["FAIL: ",n];Quit[1]];
localFiniteRequire["bound complete finite source",SyntaxQ[ReadString[localFiniteSource]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===localFiniteConfig["source_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{p,h},localFiniteRequire["pinned finite input "<>p,
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{localFiniteRoot,p}],"SHA256"],16,64]===h]],localFiniteConfig["input_sha256"]];
SetEnvironment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"->"Hgg"];
localFiniteChange[text_,edits_]:=Module[{candidate},
 localFiniteRequire["unique reviewed finite interfaces",And@@(StringCount[text,First[#]]===1&/@edits)];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,edits];localFiniteRequire["complete preserved finite implementation",SyntaxQ[candidate]&&
 StringReplace[candidate,Reverse/@edits]===text];candidate];
localFinitePrefix[text_]:=localFiniteChange[text,{"gate[\"compute allocation\",StringQ[Environment[\"JOB_ID\"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,\"login\"]];\ngate[\"isolated runtime\",StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>\"/\"]];"->"gate[\"authorized local finite assembly\",Environment[\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED\"]===\"1\"&&$VersionNumber===15.];",
"inputPaths={configPath,basePath};"->"inputPaths={configPath,basePath,localFiniteSource,localFiniteConfigPath,FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s11_result\",\"s11_execution.json\"}]};",
"real=loadResult[channel<>\"/s12_result/s12_result.wl\"];"->"real=loadResult[\"misc/s11_result/s11_result.wl\"];\nlocalFiniteImportedVersions=real[\"ImportedNativeVersions\"];\nlocalFiniteReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s11_result\",\"s11_execution.json\"}],\"RawJSON\"];\ngate[\"actual accepted local integrated input\",real[\"NativeVersions\"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&\n Last[localFiniteImportedVersions]===$FeynCalcVersion&&TrueQ[localFiniteReceipt[\"passed\"]]&&\n localFiniteReceipt[\"execution_backend\"]===\"local\"&&\n localFiniteReceipt[\"result_sha256\"][\"misc/s11_result/s11_result.wl\"]===IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s11_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}],\"SHA256\"],16,64]];",
"cache=FileNameJoin[{root,\"cache\",\"s14\",channel,IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];"->"cache=FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s14_work\",IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];",
"saved=If[FileExistsQ[file],Get[file],<||>];"->"saved=localFiniteRead[label,file];"}];
localFinitePhase[text_]:=localFiniteChange[text,{
 "phaseRunProof[\"NativeVersions\"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}"->
 "phaseRunProof[\"NativeVersions\"]===localFiniteImportedVersions",
 "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"->"If[!MemberQ[$Packages,\"FeynCalc`\"],Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]]"}];
(* Keep the accepted assembly and consume Hgg's native MS subtraction. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
hggNativeSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_Hgg_native_subtraction.wls"}];
hggNativeBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_compact_inputs.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[hggNativeBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "0e87dc4d088369ad3cd9754e31c5aedd4e6a80db2f18b3d318abb345cd68a613"||
 !SyntaxQ[Import[hggNativeSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
hggNativeAdapt[text_]:=Module[{old,new,candidate},
 old="subtraction=loadResult[channel<>\"/s11_result/s11_result.wl\"];";
 new="gate[\"own native-subtraction assembly\",channel===\"Hgg\"&&!core];"<>
  "subtraction=loadResult[channel<>\"/s11_native_result/s11_result.wl\"];"<>
  "hggNativeReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_native_result\",\"s11_execution.json\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeSubtractionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_native_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeSubtractionSource=FileNameJoin[{root,\"common\",\"s11_Hgg_native_routes.wls\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeReceipt=Import[hggNativeReceiptPath,\"RawJSON\"];"<>
  "gate[\"bound accepted native subtraction\",TrueQ[hggNativeReceipt[\"passed\"]]&&"<>
   "hggNativeReceipt[\"result_sha256\"][channel<>\"/s11_native_result/s11_result.wl\"]===IntegerString[FileHash[hggNativeSubtractionPath,\"SHA256\"],16,64]&&"<>
   "subtraction[\"SourceHash\"]===FileHash[hggNativeSubtractionSource,\"SHA256\"]&&"<>
   "TrueQ[subtraction[\"AcceptedForProduction\"]]&&TrueQ[subtraction[\"OwnAcceptedSubtractionComparison\"]]&&"<>
   "TrueQ[subtraction[\"FiniteDimensionalSchemeConversionApplied\"]]&&And@@Values[subtraction[\"Checks\"]]&&"<>
   "subtraction[\"OriginalSubtractionHash\"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}],\"SHA256\"]&&"<>
   "FreeQ[subtraction[\"NativeCountertermDifference\"],eps|D|_SeriesData|$Failed|$Aborted]];"<>
  "inputPaths=Join[inputPaths,{hggNativeSource,hggNativeBase,hggNativeReceiptPath,hggNativeSubtractionSource}];";
 If[StringCount[text,old]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique Hgg subtraction input"];Quit[1]];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,old->new];
 If[!SyntaxQ[candidate]||StringReplace[candidate,new->old]=!=text,
  Print["FAIL: unchanged full Hgg assembly prefix"];Quit[1]];candidate];
hggNativeInitialization[text_]:=Module[{old,new,candidate},
 old="ToExpression[phaseRunPrefix,InputForm];";
 new="phaseRunPrefix=localFinitePrefix[hggNativeAdapt[phaseRunPrefix]];"<>old;
 If[StringCount[text,old]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique native assembly prefix handoff"];Quit[1]];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,old->new];
 If[!SyntaxQ[candidate]||StringReplace[candidate,new->old]=!=text,Quit[1]];candidate];
hggNativeText=StringTrim[Import[hggNativeBase,"Text"]];hggNativeTerminal="ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[hggNativeText,hggNativeTerminal],Quit[1]];
hggNativePrefix=StringDrop[hggNativeText,-StringLength[hggNativeTerminal]];
hggNativeEntry="ToExpression[compactAssemblyInitialization,InputForm];";
hggNativeChangedEntry="compactAssemblyInitialization=localFinitePhase[hggNativeInitialization[compactAssemblyInitialization]];"<>hggNativeEntry;
If[StringCount[hggNativePrefix,hggNativeEntry]=!=1,Quit[1]];
hggNativePrefixCandidate=StringReplace[hggNativePrefix,hggNativeEntry->hggNativeChangedEntry];
If[!SyntaxQ[hggNativePrefixCandidate]||StringReplace[hggNativePrefixCandidate,hggNativeChangedEntry->hggNativeEntry]=!=hggNativePrefix,Quit[1]];
ToExpression[hggNativePrefixCandidate,InputForm];

(* Reuse the accepted regulator-only phase helper and exact native checkpoints. *)
localFinitePhasePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s34_regulator_only_phase_product.wls"}];
localFiniteProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s34_result","s34_result.wl"}];
localFiniteProofReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s34_result","s34_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted complete phase optimization",TrueQ[localFiniteProofReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localFiniteProofReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s34_result/s34_result.wl"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
localFiniteProof=KeyDrop[Get[localFiniteProofPath],{"Candidates","Finite"}];
gate["exact phase proof source and runtime",TrueQ[localFiniteProof["Accepted"]]&&
 And@@Values[localFiniteProof["Checks"]]&&localFiniteProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[localFinitePhasePath,"SHA256"]&&
 localFiniteProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}];
localFiniteChangedInputKeys={"misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls","misc/s14_inputs.json"};
gate["all original mathematical assembly inputs unchanged",
 KeyDrop[inputHashes,localFiniteChangedInputKeys]===KeyDrop[localFiniteProof["InputHashes"],localFiniteChangedInputKeys]&&
 Hash[{sourceHash,localFiniteProof["InputHashes"],$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"]===localFiniteProof["InputHash"]];
Get[localFinitePhasePath];localPhaseInstall[];
gate["validated complete phase implementation installed",DownValues[laurentProduct]===localFiniteProof["LaurentDefinitions"]];
localFiniteResumePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_resume.json"}];
localFiniteResume=Import[localFiniteResumePath,"RawJSON"];
gate["original complete assembly source pinned for reuse",
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,localFiniteResume["parent_source"]}],"SHA256"]===
 localFiniteProof["InputHashes"]["misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"]&&
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,localFiniteResume["parent_config"]}],"SHA256"]===
 localFiniteProof["InputHashes"]["misc/s14_inputs.json"]];

localFiniteGateProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s36_result","s36_result.json"}];
localFiniteGateReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s36_result","s36_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
localFiniteGateProof=Import[localFiniteGateProofPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted exact scoped Laurent predicate",TrueQ[localFiniteGateReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localFiniteGateReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s36_result/s36_result.json"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteGateProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 And@@Values[localFiniteGateProof["checks"]]&&localFiniteGateProof["source_sha256"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}],"SHA256"],16,64]];
localFiniteParentSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_scoped_polynomial_gate","s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"}];
localFiniteParentConfig=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_scoped_polynomial_gate","s14_inputs.json"}];
gate["bound accepted predicate parent generation",
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteParentSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===localFiniteGateReceipt["source_sha256"]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteParentConfig,"SHA256"],16,64]===
 localFiniteGateReceipt["input_sha256"]["misc/s14_inputs.json"]];
localFiniteParentInputs=inputHashes;
AssociateTo[localFiniteParentInputs,{
 "misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"->FileHash[localFiniteParentSource,"SHA256"],
 "misc/s14_inputs.json"->FileHash[localFiniteParentConfig,"SHA256"]}];
localFiniteParentInputHash=Hash[{sourceHash,localFiniteParentInputs,$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
localFiniteAcceptedInputHashes={localFiniteProof["InputHash"],localFiniteParentInputHash};


localFiniteFinalParentSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_exact_hat_comparison","s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"}];
localFiniteFinalParentConfig=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_exact_hat_comparison","s14_inputs.json"}];
localFiniteCaptureReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s37_result","s37_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted full-component parent generation",
 TrueQ[localFiniteCaptureReceipt["passed"]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteFinalParentSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===
 localFiniteCaptureReceipt["input_sha256"]["misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteFinalParentConfig,"SHA256"],16,64]===
 localFiniteCaptureReceipt["input_sha256"]["misc/s14_inputs.json"]];
localFiniteFinalParentInputs=inputHashes;
AssociateTo[localFiniteFinalParentInputs,{
 "misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"->FileHash[localFiniteFinalParentSource,"SHA256"],
 "misc/s14_inputs.json"->FileHash[localFiniteFinalParentConfig,"SHA256"]}];
AppendTo[localFiniteAcceptedInputHashes,
 Hash[{sourceHash,localFiniteFinalParentInputs,$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"]];

localFiniteReused=<||>;
localFiniteRead[label_,currentPath_]:=Module[{name,row,path,saved},
 If[FileExistsQ[currentPath],Return[Get[currentPath]]];
 name=FileNameTake[currentPath];
 If[!KeyExistsQ[localFiniteResume["files"],name],Return[<||>]];
 row=localFiniteResume["files"][name];path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["path"]}];
 gate["pinned accepted finite checkpoint "<>ToString[label,InputForm],
  IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["sha256"]];
 saved=Get[path];
 gate["exact accepted finite checkpoint identity "<>ToString[label,InputForm],
  TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&saved["Label"]===label&&MemberQ[localFiniteAcceptedInputHashes,saved["InputHash"]]&&
  KeyExistsQ[saved,"Finite"]&&KeyExistsQ[saved,"PoleResiduals"]];
 AssociateTo[localFiniteReused,name-><|"Label"->label,"Path"->row["path"],"SHA256"->row["sha256"]|>];
 Join[saved,<|"InputHash"->inputHash,"OriginalInputHash"->saved["InputHash"],"CheckpointSHA256"->row["sha256"]|>]];

(* Complete the rational/algebraic pole sum with the accepted exact backend. *)
localFiniteSumPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s35_exact_Hgg_finite_poles.wls"}];
localFiniteSumProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s35_result","s35_result.wl"}];
localFiniteSumReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s35_result","s35_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted exact pole summation proof",TrueQ[localFiniteSumReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localFiniteSumReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s35_result/s35_result.wl"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteSumProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
localFiniteSumProof=Get[localFiniteSumProofPath];
gate["exact sum proof source and control",localFiniteSumProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[localFiniteSumPath,"SHA256"]&&
 localFiniteSumProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
 And@@Values[localFiniteSumProof["Checks"]]&&TrueQ[localFiniteSumProof["PoleCancellationResolved"]]&&
 localFiniteSumProof["OwnValue"]=!=0];
Get[localFiniteSumPath];
localFinitePoleReduce[value_,assumptions_]:=Module[{expression=reduce[value,assumptions]},
 If[FreeQ[expression,_Log|_PolyLog|_ArcTan|_ArcTanh|_Re|_Im|_Abs|_Piecewise|_ConditionalExpression|_Sign],
  localFiniteExactSum[expression],expression]];
localFinitePoleOld="reduce[Coefficient[combined,eps,n],assumptions]";
localFinitePoleNew="localFinitePoleReduce[Coefficient[combined,eps,n],assumptions]";
localFinitePoleStart="finitePart[parts_,label_,assumptions_] :=";
localFinitePoleEnd="\ndistributions=";
localFinitePoleText=ReadString[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}]];
gate["unique original pole simplifier source",StringCount[localFinitePoleText,localFinitePoleStart]===1&&
 StringCount[localFinitePoleText,localFinitePoleEnd]===1];
localFinitePoleDefinition=localFinitePoleStart<>First[StringSplit[
 Last[StringSplit[localFinitePoleText,localFinitePoleStart]],localFinitePoleEnd]];
localFinitePoleDefinition=localFiniteChange[localFinitePoleDefinition,{
 "saved=If[FileExistsQ[file],Get[file],<||>];"->"saved=localFiniteRead[label,file];"}];
localFinitePoleEdits={localFinitePoleOld->localFinitePoleNew,localFiniteGateProof["old"]->localFiniteGateProof["new"]};
localFinitePoleCandidate=localFiniteChange[localFinitePoleDefinition,localFinitePoleEdits];
ToExpression[localFinitePoleCandidate,InputForm];
gate["all original pole and finite gates retained",StringReplace[localFinitePoleCandidate,
 Reverse/@localFinitePoleEdits]===localFinitePoleDefinition];


(* Reuse accepted finite parts before evaluating any phase argument. *)
SetAttributes[finitePart,HoldFirst];
localHatComparisonPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s38_exact_Hgg_hat_comparison.wls"}];
localHatComparisonProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s38_result","s38_result.wl"}];
localHatComparisonReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s38_result","s38_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
localHatComparisonChecksPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s38_result","s38_checks.json"}];
localHatComparisonChecks=Import[localHatComparisonChecksPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted complete actual final comparison",
 TrueQ[localHatComparisonReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localHatComparisonReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s38_result/s38_result.wl"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localHatComparisonProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 localHatComparisonReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s38_result/s38_checks.json"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localHatComparisonChecksPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 And@@Values[localHatComparisonChecks["checks"]]&&TrueQ[localHatComparisonChecks["reference_comparison_passed"]]];
localHatComparisonProof=Get[localHatComparisonProofPath];
gate["exact reference helper source and runtime",
 localHatComparisonProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[localHatComparisonPath,"SHA256"]&&
 localHatComparisonProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
 And@@Values[localHatComparisonProof["Checks"]]&&localHatComparisonProof["ControlValue"]=!=0];
Get[localHatComparisonPath];

(* Release consumed transfer buffers before parsing the normalized answer. *)
localHatTransferSource=ReadString[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s31_exact_Hgg_recoil_sum.wls"}]];
localHatTransferStart="localExactRecoilRatio[rational_]:=";
localHatTransferEnd="\nIf[Environment[\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_VALIDATE_RECOIL\"]";
gate["unique complete native polynomial implementation",
 StringCount[localHatTransferSource,localHatTransferStart]===1&&
 StringCount[localHatTransferSource,localHatTransferEnd]===1];
localHatTransferDefinition=localHatTransferStart<>First[StringSplit[
 Last[StringSplit[localHatTransferSource,localHatTransferStart]],localHatTransferEnd]];
localHatTransferAnchor=" value=(ToExpression[output[\"factored\"][\"numerator\"],InputForm]";
localHatTransferReplacement=
 " Clear[terms,pair,lifted,payload,atomRules,rules,encode];ClearSystemCache[];\n"<>localHatTransferAnchor;
localHatTransferCandidate=localFiniteChange[localHatTransferDefinition,
 {localHatTransferAnchor->localHatTransferReplacement}];
ToExpression[localHatTransferCandidate,InputForm];
gate["all transfer equations and gates unchanged",
 StringReplace[localHatTransferCandidate,localHatTransferReplacement->localHatTransferAnchor]===
 localHatTransferDefinition];

SetAttributes[localHatBounded,HoldFirst];
localHatBounded[value_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
 gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" time limit",False]],4*1024^3,
 gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" memory limit",False]];
localHatFinalZero[value_,assumptions_]:=Module[{expression},
 ClearSystemCache[];
 expression=localHatExactReduce[value,assumptions];
 expression===0||FullSimplify[expression,assumptions]===0];

localFiniteMemoryAssemble[index_]:=Module[{before,value},
 ClearSystemCache[];before=MemoryInUse[];value=assemble[index];ClearSystemCache[];
 Print["FINITE_COMPONENT_MEMORY ",index," before ",before," after ",MemoryInUse[]];value];
hggNativeExport="compactAssemblyWrite[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s14_result.wl\"}]];";
hggNativeExportCandidate="AssociateTo[result,{\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[hggNativeSource,\"SHA256\"],"<>
 "\"SubtractionResultHash\"->FileHash[hggNativeSubtractionPath,\"SHA256\"],\"FiniteDimensionalSchemeConversionApplied\"->True}];"<>hggNativeExport;
gate["unique native Hgg finite export",StringCount[phaseRunTail,hggNativeExport]===1];
hggNativeFinal=StringReplace[phaseRunTail,hggNativeExport->hggNativeExportCandidate];
gate["all original final Hgg gates retained",SyntaxQ[hggNativeFinal]&&
 StringReplace[hggNativeFinal,hggNativeExportCandidate->hggNativeExport]===phaseRunTail];
localFiniteTailEdits={
 "resultDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s14_result\"}];"->"resultDir=FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s14_result\"}];",
 hggNativeExport->"AssociateTo[result,<|\"ExecutionBackend\"->\"local\",\"NativeVersions\"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},\"ImportedNativeVersions\"->localFiniteImportedVersions,\"LocalDispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[localFiniteSource,\"SHA256\"],\"LocalConfigurationHash\"->FileHash[localFiniteConfigPath,\"SHA256\"]|>];"<>hggNativeExport,
 "values=assemble/@indices;"->"values=localFiniteMemoryAssemble/@indices;",
 "bounded[zero[\n      hats[name][\"NLO\"]"->"localHatBounded[localHatFinalZero[\n      hats[name][\"NLO\"]"};
ToExpression[localFiniteChange[hggNativeFinal,localFiniteTailEdits],InputForm];
```
