```wolfram
(* Local execution of the unchanged native Hgg finite assembly. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
localFiniteRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[localFiniteRoot];
localFiniteSource=FileNameJoin[{localFiniteRoot,"misc","s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"}];
localFiniteConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{localFiniteRoot,"misc","s14_inputs.json"}];
localFiniteConfig=Import[localFiniteConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
localFiniteRequire[n_,x_]:=If[!TrueQ[x],Print["FAIL: ",n];Quit[1]];
localFiniteRequire["bound complete finite source",SyntaxQ[ReadString[localFiniteSource]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===localFiniteConfig["source_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{p,h},localFiniteRequire["pinned finite input "<>p,
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{localFiniteRoot,p}],"SHA256"],16,64]===h]],localFiniteConfig["input_sha256"]];
SetEnvironment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"->"Hgg"];
localFiniteChange[text_,edits_]:=Module[{candidate},
 localFiniteRequire["unique reviewed finite interfaces",And@@(StringCount[text,First[#]]===1&/@edits)];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,edits];localFiniteRequire["complete preserved finite implementation",SyntaxQ[candidate]&&
 StringReplace[candidate,Reverse/@edits]===text];candidate];
localFinitePrefix[text_]:=localFiniteChange[text,{"gate[\"compute allocation\",StringQ[Environment[\"JOB_ID\"]]&&!StringStartsQ[$MachineName,\"login\"]];\ngate[\"isolated runtime\",StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory,root<>\"/\"]];"->"gate[\"authorized local finite assembly\",Environment[\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED\"]===\"1\"&&$VersionNumber===15.];",
"inputPaths={configPath,basePath};"->"inputPaths={configPath,basePath,localFiniteSource,localFiniteConfigPath,FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s11_result\",\"s11_execution.json\"}]};",
"real=loadResult[channel<>\"/s12_result/s12_result.wl\"];"->"real=loadResult[\"misc/s11_result/s11_result.wl\"];\nlocalFiniteImportedVersions=real[\"ImportedNativeVersions\"];\nlocalFiniteReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s11_result\",\"s11_execution.json\"}],\"RawJSON\"];\ngate[\"actual accepted local integrated input\",real[\"NativeVersions\"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&\n Last[localFiniteImportedVersions]===$FeynCalcVersion&&TrueQ[localFiniteReceipt[\"passed\"]]&&\n localFiniteReceipt[\"execution_backend\"]===\"local\"&&\n localFiniteReceipt[\"result_sha256\"][\"misc/s11_result/s11_result.wl\"]===IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s11_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}],\"SHA256\"],16,64]];",
"cache=FileNameJoin[{root,\"cache\",\"s14\",channel,IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];"->"cache=FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s14_work\",IntegerString[inputHash,16]}];",
"saved=If[FileExistsQ[file],Get[file],<||>];"->"saved=localFiniteRead[label,file];"}];
localFinitePhase[text_]:=localFiniteChange[text,{
 "phaseRunProof[\"NativeVersions\"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}"->
 "phaseRunProof[\"NativeVersions\"]===localFiniteImportedVersions",
 "Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]"->"If[!MemberQ[$Packages,\"FeynCalc`\"],Get[\"FeynCalc`\"]]"}];
(* Keep the accepted assembly and consume Hgg's native MS subtraction. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
hggNativeSource=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_Hgg_native_subtraction.wls"}];
hggNativeBase=FileNameJoin[{Directory[],"common","s14_assemble_finite_compact_inputs.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[hggNativeBase,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "0e87dc4d088369ad3cd9754e31c5aedd4e6a80db2f18b3d318abb345cd68a613"||
 !SyntaxQ[Import[hggNativeSource,"Text"]],Quit[1]];
hggNativeAdapt[text_]:=Module[{old,new,candidate},
 old="subtraction=loadResult[channel<>\"/s11_result/s11_result.wl\"];";
 new="gate[\"own native-subtraction assembly\",channel===\"Hgg\"&&!core];"<>
  "subtraction=loadResult[channel<>\"/s11_native_result/s11_result.wl\"];"<>
  "hggNativeReceiptPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_native_result\",\"s11_execution.json\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeSubtractionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_native_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeSubtractionSource=FileNameJoin[{root,\"common\",\"s11_Hgg_native_routes.wls\"}];"<>
  "hggNativeReceipt=Import[hggNativeReceiptPath,\"RawJSON\"];"<>
  "gate[\"bound accepted native subtraction\",TrueQ[hggNativeReceipt[\"passed\"]]&&"<>
   "hggNativeReceipt[\"result_sha256\"][channel<>\"/s11_native_result/s11_result.wl\"]===IntegerString[FileHash[hggNativeSubtractionPath,\"SHA256\"],16,64]&&"<>
   "subtraction[\"SourceHash\"]===FileHash[hggNativeSubtractionSource,\"SHA256\"]&&"<>
   "TrueQ[subtraction[\"AcceptedForProduction\"]]&&TrueQ[subtraction[\"OwnAcceptedSubtractionComparison\"]]&&"<>
   "TrueQ[subtraction[\"FiniteDimensionalSchemeConversionApplied\"]]&&And@@Values[subtraction[\"Checks\"]]&&"<>
   "subtraction[\"OriginalSubtractionHash\"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s11_result\",\"s11_result.wl\"}],\"SHA256\"]&&"<>
   "FreeQ[subtraction[\"NativeCountertermDifference\"],eps|D|_SeriesData|$Failed|$Aborted]];"<>
  "inputPaths=Join[inputPaths,{hggNativeSource,hggNativeBase,hggNativeReceiptPath,hggNativeSubtractionSource}];";
 If[StringCount[text,old]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique Hgg subtraction input"];Quit[1]];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,old->new];
 If[!SyntaxQ[candidate]||StringReplace[candidate,new->old]=!=text,
  Print["FAIL: unchanged full Hgg assembly prefix"];Quit[1]];candidate];
hggNativeInitialization[text_]:=Module[{old,new,candidate},
 old="ToExpression[phaseRunPrefix,InputForm];";
 new="phaseRunPrefix=localFinitePrefix[hggNativeAdapt[phaseRunPrefix]];"<>old;
 If[StringCount[text,old]=!=1,Print["FAIL: unique native assembly prefix handoff"];Quit[1]];
 candidate=StringReplace[text,old->new];
 If[!SyntaxQ[candidate]||StringReplace[candidate,new->old]=!=text,Quit[1]];candidate];
hggNativeText=StringTrim[Import[hggNativeBase,"Text"]];hggNativeTerminal="ToExpression[phaseRunTail,InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[hggNativeText,hggNativeTerminal],Quit[1]];
hggNativePrefix=StringDrop[hggNativeText,-StringLength[hggNativeTerminal]];
hggNativeEntry="ToExpression[compactAssemblyInitialization,InputForm];";
hggNativeChangedEntry="compactAssemblyInitialization=localFinitePhase[hggNativeInitialization[compactAssemblyInitialization]];"<>hggNativeEntry;
If[StringCount[hggNativePrefix,hggNativeEntry]=!=1,Quit[1]];
hggNativePrefixCandidate=StringReplace[hggNativePrefix,hggNativeEntry->hggNativeChangedEntry];
If[!SyntaxQ[hggNativePrefixCandidate]||StringReplace[hggNativePrefixCandidate,hggNativeChangedEntry->hggNativeEntry]=!=hggNativePrefix,Quit[1]];
ToExpression[hggNativePrefixCandidate,InputForm];

(* Reuse the accepted regulator-only phase helper and exact native checkpoints. *)
localFinitePhasePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s34_regulator_only_phase_product.wls"}];
localFiniteProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s34_result","s34_result.wl"}];
localFiniteProofReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s34_result","s34_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted complete phase optimization",TrueQ[localFiniteProofReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localFiniteProofReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s34_result/s34_result.wl"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
localFiniteProof=KeyDrop[Get[localFiniteProofPath],{"Candidates","Finite"}];
gate["exact phase proof source and runtime",TrueQ[localFiniteProof["Accepted"]]&&
 And@@Values[localFiniteProof["Checks"]]&&localFiniteProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[localFinitePhasePath,"SHA256"]&&
 localFiniteProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}];
localFiniteChangedInputKeys={"misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls","misc/s14_inputs.json"};
gate["all original mathematical assembly inputs unchanged",
 KeyDrop[inputHashes,localFiniteChangedInputKeys]===KeyDrop[localFiniteProof["InputHashes"],localFiniteChangedInputKeys]&&
 Hash[{sourceHash,localFiniteProof["InputHashes"],$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"]===localFiniteProof["InputHash"]];
Get[localFinitePhasePath];localPhaseInstall[];
gate["validated complete phase implementation installed",DownValues[laurentProduct]===localFiniteProof["LaurentDefinitions"]];
localFiniteResumePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_resume.json"}];
localFiniteResume=Import[localFiniteResumePath,"RawJSON"];
gate["original complete assembly source pinned for reuse",
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,localFiniteResume["parent_source"]}],"SHA256"]===
 localFiniteProof["InputHashes"]["misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"]&&
 FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,localFiniteResume["parent_config"]}],"SHA256"]===
 localFiniteProof["InputHashes"]["misc/s14_inputs.json"]];

localFiniteGateProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s36_result","s36_result.json"}];
localFiniteGateReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s36_result","s36_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
localFiniteGateProof=Import[localFiniteGateProofPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted exact scoped Laurent predicate",TrueQ[localFiniteGateReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localFiniteGateReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s36_result/s36_result.json"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteGateProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 And@@Values[localFiniteGateProof["checks"]]&&localFiniteGateProof["source_sha256"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}],"SHA256"],16,64]];
localFiniteParentSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_scoped_polynomial_gate","s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"}];
localFiniteParentConfig=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_scoped_polynomial_gate","s14_inputs.json"}];
gate["bound accepted predicate parent generation",
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteParentSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===localFiniteGateReceipt["source_sha256"]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteParentConfig,"SHA256"],16,64]===
 localFiniteGateReceipt["input_sha256"]["misc/s14_inputs.json"]];
localFiniteParentInputs=inputHashes;
AssociateTo[localFiniteParentInputs,{
 "misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"->FileHash[localFiniteParentSource,"SHA256"],
 "misc/s14_inputs.json"->FileHash[localFiniteParentConfig,"SHA256"]}];
localFiniteParentInputHash=Hash[{sourceHash,localFiniteParentInputs,$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"];
localFiniteAcceptedInputHashes={localFiniteProof["InputHash"],localFiniteParentInputHash};


localFiniteFinalParentSource=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_exact_hat_comparison","s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"}];
localFiniteFinalParentConfig=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s14_result","reference","before_exact_hat_comparison","s14_inputs.json"}];
localFiniteCaptureReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s37_result","s37_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted full-component parent generation",
 TrueQ[localFiniteCaptureReceipt["passed"]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteFinalParentSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===
 localFiniteCaptureReceipt["input_sha256"]["misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteFinalParentConfig,"SHA256"],16,64]===
 localFiniteCaptureReceipt["input_sha256"]["misc/s14_inputs.json"]];
localFiniteFinalParentInputs=inputHashes;
AssociateTo[localFiniteFinalParentInputs,{
 "misc/s14_assemble_Hgg_finite.wls"->FileHash[localFiniteFinalParentSource,"SHA256"],
 "misc/s14_inputs.json"->FileHash[localFiniteFinalParentConfig,"SHA256"]}];
AppendTo[localFiniteAcceptedInputHashes,
 Hash[{sourceHash,localFiniteFinalParentInputs,$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion},"SHA256"]];

localFiniteReused=<||>;
localFiniteRead[label_,currentPath_]:=Module[{name,row,path,saved},
 If[FileExistsQ[currentPath],Return[Get[currentPath]]];
 name=FileNameTake[currentPath];
 If[!KeyExistsQ[localFiniteResume["files"],name],Return[<||>]];
 row=localFiniteResume["files"][name];path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["path"]}];
 gate["pinned accepted finite checkpoint "<>ToString[label,InputForm],
  IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["sha256"]];
 saved=Get[path];
 gate["exact accepted finite checkpoint identity "<>ToString[label,InputForm],
  TrueQ[saved["Accepted"]]&&saved["Label"]===label&&MemberQ[localFiniteAcceptedInputHashes,saved["InputHash"]]&&
  KeyExistsQ[saved,"Finite"]&&KeyExistsQ[saved,"PoleResiduals"]];
 AssociateTo[localFiniteReused,name-><|"Label"->label,"Path"->row["path"],"SHA256"->row["sha256"]|>];
 Join[saved,<|"InputHash"->inputHash,"OriginalInputHash"->saved["InputHash"],"CheckpointSHA256"->row["sha256"]|>]];

(* Complete the rational/algebraic pole sum with the accepted exact backend. *)
localFiniteSumPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s35_exact_Hgg_finite_poles.wls"}];
localFiniteSumProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s35_result","s35_result.wl"}];
localFiniteSumReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s35_result","s35_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted exact pole summation proof",TrueQ[localFiniteSumReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localFiniteSumReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s35_result/s35_result.wl"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFiniteSumProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
localFiniteSumProof=Get[localFiniteSumProofPath];
gate["exact sum proof source and control",localFiniteSumProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[localFiniteSumPath,"SHA256"]&&
 localFiniteSumProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
 And@@Values[localFiniteSumProof["Checks"]]&&TrueQ[localFiniteSumProof["PoleCancellationResolved"]]&&
 localFiniteSumProof["OwnValue"]=!=0];
Get[localFiniteSumPath];
localFinitePoleReduce[value_,assumptions_]:=Module[{expression=reduce[value,assumptions]},
 If[FreeQ[expression,_Log|_PolyLog|_ArcTan|_ArcTanh|_Re|_Im|_Abs|_Piecewise|_ConditionalExpression|_Sign],
  localFiniteExactSum[expression],expression]];
localFinitePoleOld="reduce[Coefficient[combined,eps,n],assumptions]";
localFinitePoleNew="localFinitePoleReduce[Coefficient[combined,eps,n],assumptions]";
localFinitePoleStart="finitePart[parts_,label_,assumptions_] :=";
localFinitePoleEnd="\ndistributions=";
localFinitePoleText=ReadString[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s14_assemble_finite_spin.wls"}]];
gate["unique original pole simplifier source",StringCount[localFinitePoleText,localFinitePoleStart]===1&&
 StringCount[localFinitePoleText,localFinitePoleEnd]===1];
localFinitePoleDefinition=localFinitePoleStart<>First[StringSplit[
 Last[StringSplit[localFinitePoleText,localFinitePoleStart]],localFinitePoleEnd]];
localFinitePoleDefinition=localFiniteChange[localFinitePoleDefinition,{
 "saved=If[FileExistsQ[file],Get[file],<||>];"->"saved=localFiniteRead[label,file];"}];
localFinitePoleEdits={localFinitePoleOld->localFinitePoleNew,localFiniteGateProof["old"]->localFiniteGateProof["new"]};
localFinitePoleCandidate=localFiniteChange[localFinitePoleDefinition,localFinitePoleEdits];
ToExpression[localFinitePoleCandidate,InputForm];
gate["all original pole and finite gates retained",StringReplace[localFinitePoleCandidate,
 Reverse/@localFinitePoleEdits]===localFinitePoleDefinition];


(* Reuse accepted finite parts before evaluating any phase argument. *)
SetAttributes[finitePart,HoldFirst];
localHatComparisonPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s38_exact_Hgg_hat_comparison.wls"}];
localHatComparisonProofPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s38_result","s38_result.wl"}];
localHatComparisonReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s38_result","s38_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
localHatComparisonChecksPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s38_result","s38_checks.json"}];
localHatComparisonChecks=Import[localHatComparisonChecksPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted complete actual final comparison",
 TrueQ[localHatComparisonReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localHatComparisonReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s38_result/s38_result.wl"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localHatComparisonProofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 localHatComparisonReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s38_result/s38_checks.json"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localHatComparisonChecksPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 And@@Values[localHatComparisonChecks["checks"]]&&TrueQ[localHatComparisonChecks["reference_comparison_passed"]]];
localHatComparisonProof=Get[localHatComparisonProofPath];
gate["exact reference helper source and runtime",
 localHatComparisonProof["SourceHash"]===FileHash[localHatComparisonPath,"SHA256"]&&
 localHatComparisonProof["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
 And@@Values[localHatComparisonProof["Checks"]]&&localHatComparisonProof["ControlValue"]=!=0];
Get[localHatComparisonPath];
SetAttributes[localHatBounded,HoldFirst];
localHatBounded[value_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value,1200,
 gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" time limit",False]],4*1024^3,
 gate[ToString[label,InputForm]<>" memory limit",False]];
localHatFinalZero[value_,assumptions_]:=Module[{expression},
 ClearSystemCache[];
 expression=localHatExactReduce[value,assumptions];
 expression===0||FullSimplify[expression,assumptions]===0];

localFiniteMemoryAssemble[index_]:=Module[{before,value},
 ClearSystemCache[];before=MemoryInUse[];value=assemble[index];ClearSystemCache[];
 Print["FINITE_COMPONENT_MEMORY ",index," before ",before," after ",MemoryInUse[]];value];
hggNativeExport="compactAssemblyWrite[result,FileNameJoin[{resultDir,\"s14_result.wl\"}]];";
hggNativeExportCandidate="AssociateTo[result,{\"DispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[hggNativeSource,\"SHA256\"],"<>
 "\"SubtractionResultHash\"->FileHash[hggNativeSubtractionPath,\"SHA256\"],\"FiniteDimensionalSchemeConversionApplied\"->True}];"<>hggNativeExport;
gate["unique native Hgg finite export",StringCount[phaseRunTail,hggNativeExport]===1];
hggNativeFinal=StringReplace[phaseRunTail,hggNativeExport->hggNativeExportCandidate];
gate["all original final Hgg gates retained",SyntaxQ[hggNativeFinal]&&
 StringReplace[hggNativeFinal,hggNativeExportCandidate->hggNativeExport]===phaseRunTail];
localFiniteTailEdits={
 "resultDir=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s14_result\"}];"->"resultDir=FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s14_result\"}];",
 hggNativeExport->"AssociateTo[result,<|\"ExecutionBackend\"->\"local\",\"NativeVersions\"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},\"ImportedNativeVersions\"->localFiniteImportedVersions,\"LocalDispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[localFiniteSource,\"SHA256\"],\"LocalConfigurationHash\"->FileHash[localFiniteConfigPath,\"SHA256\"]|>];"<>hggNativeExport,
 "values=assemble/@indices;"->"values=localFiniteMemoryAssemble/@indices;",
 "bounded[zero[\n      hats[name][\"NLO\"]"->"localHatBounded[localHatFinalZero[\n      hats[name][\"NLO\"]"};
ToExpression[localFiniteChange[hggNativeFinal,localFiniteTailEdits],InputForm];
```

## misc/s15_finalize_Hgg_hats.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-129", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 8235, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s15_finalize_Hgg_hats.wls", "sha256": "451a6d5a9edf93e9a40b8dc11f37450d2e529398bdf0fac201e9be9158a8b705"} -->
```wolfram
(* Local runtime for the unchanged Hgg helicity conversion and final F hats. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
localFinalRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[localFinalRoot];
localFinalSource=FileNameJoin[{localFinalRoot,"misc","s15_finalize_Hgg_hats.wls"}];
localFinalConfigPath=FileNameJoin[{localFinalRoot,"misc","s15_inputs.json"}];
localFinalConfig=Import[localFinalConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
localFinalRequire[n_,x_]:=If[!TrueQ[x],Print["FAIL: ",n];Quit[1]];
localFinalRequire["bound complete final source",SyntaxQ[ReadString[localFinalSource]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localFinalSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===localFinalConfig["source_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{p,h},localFinalRequire["pinned final input "<>p,
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{localFinalRoot,p}],"SHA256"],16,64]===h]],localFinalConfig["input_sha256"]];
SetEnvironment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"->"Hgg"];

localNativeWriterPath=FileNameJoin[{localFinalRoot,"misc","s40_chunked_native_record.wls"}];
localNativeWriterReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{localFinalRoot,"misc","s40_result","s40_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
localNativeWriterChecksPath=FileNameJoin[{localFinalRoot,"misc","s40_result","s40_checks.json"}];
localNativeWriterChecks=Import[localNativeWriterChecksPath,"RawJSON"];
localFinalRequire["accepted complete native storage interface",
 TrueQ[localNativeWriterReceipt["passed"]]&&
 localNativeWriterReceipt["source_sha256"]===IntegerString[FileHash[localNativeWriterPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 localNativeWriterReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s40_checks.json"]===
 IntegerString[FileHash[localNativeWriterChecksPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
 And@@Values[localNativeWriterChecks["checks"]]&&
 localNativeWriterChecks["native_versions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}];
Get[localNativeWriterPath];

localFinalChange[text_]:=Module[{edits,candidate},edits={localFinalWriterOld->"put[value_, path_] := localChunkWrite[value,path];","gate[\"compute allocation\", StringQ[Environment[\"JOB_ID\"]] && !StringStartsQ[$MachineName, \"login\"]];\ngate[\"isolated runtime\", StringStartsQ[$UserBaseDirectory, root <> \"/\"]];"->"gate[\"authorized local final export\",Environment[\"POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED\"]===\"1\"&&$VersionNumber===15.];",
"inputPaths = {};"->"inputPaths = {localFinalSource,localFinalConfigPath};",
"rawPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, \"s14_result\", \"s14_result.wl\"}]; raw = Get[rawPath];"->"rawPath = FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s14_result\",\"s14_result.wl\"}]; raw=Get[rawPath];\nlocalFinalImportedVersions=raw[\"ImportedNativeVersions\"];\ngate[\"actual local finite assembly runtime\",raw[\"NativeVersions\"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&\n Last[localFinalImportedVersions]===$FeynCalcVersion];",
"finalAssemblyReceipt=readInput[channel<>\"/s14_result/s14_execution.json\"];"->"finalAssemblyReceipt=readInput[\"misc/s14_result/s14_execution.json\"];",
"finalAssemblyReceipt[\"result_sha256\"][channel<>\"/s14_result/s14_result.wl\"]"->"finalAssemblyReceipt[\"result_sha256\"][\"misc/s14_result/s14_result.wl\"]",
"schemeDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root,channel,\"s15_native_scheme_result\"}];"->"schemeDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s15_result\",\"scheme\"}];",
"resultDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, \"s15_result\"}];"->"AssociateTo[result,<|\"ExecutionBackend\"->\"local\",\"NativeVersions\"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},\n \"ImportedNativeVersions\"->localFinalImportedVersions,\"LocalDispatchSourceHash\"->FileHash[localFinalSource,\"SHA256\"],\n \"LocalConfigurationHash\"->FileHash[localFinalConfigPath,\"SHA256\"]|>];\nresultDirectory = FileNameJoin[{root,\"misc\",\"s15_result\"}];"};
```

## misc/s16_compare_Hgg_reference_sum.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-135", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 2905, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s16_compare_Hgg_reference_sum.wls", "sha256": "8a02d9449c8f940241011ee7e2afd83e3261906504ac1cceee7882e2822c0b6a"} -->
```wolfram
(* Isolated measurement of the original reference operation on actual Hgg input. *)
$HistoryLength=0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
comparisonSource=ExpandFileName[$InputFileName];
comparisonRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[comparisonSource]];
comparisonDriver=FileNameJoin[{comparisonRoot,"misc","s10_reduce_Hgg_coefficients.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[comparisonDriver,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "0e60864de5711c16810f66e8ddb0d26adb6b2cf66077c324352d7ded6f52f60c",Quit[1]];
comparisonText=ReadString[comparisonDriver];
comparisonPrefix=StringTake[comparisonText,
 First[First[StringPosition[comparisonText,"\nslots = 2;"]]]-1];
comparisonPrefix=StringReplace[comparisonPrefix,
 "$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get[\"FeynCalc`\"];"->"Null;"];
If[!SyntaxQ[comparisonPrefix]||!SyntaxQ[ReadString[comparisonSource]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[comparisonPrefix,InputForm];
comparisonRaw=localReadRaw[1];
comparisonRules=Association[reduction["Rules"]];
comparisonMasters=Union[Cases[Values[KeyTake[comparisonRules,Keys[comparisonRaw["Coefficients"]]]],
 _CutIntegral,Infinity]];
gate["actual Hgg comparison masters are accepted",comparisonMasters=!={}&&
 Complement[comparisonMasters,reduction["Masters"]]==={}];
comparisonMaster=First[comparisonMasters];
comparisonTerms=KeyValueMap[#2 Coefficient[comparisonRules[#1],comparisonMaster]&,
 comparisonRaw["Coefficients"]];
Print["ACTUAL_REFERENCE_INPUT ",InputForm[<|"Component"->1,"Master"->comparisonMaster,
 "TermCount"->Length[DeleteCases[comparisonTerms,0]],"Bytes"->ByteCount[comparisonTerms]|>]];

{comparisonSeconds,comparisonAnswer}=AbsoluteTiming[TimeConstrained[
 referenceCoefficients[comparisonRaw["Coefficients"],{comparisonMaster},"isolated direct reference"],
 180,Missing["TimeLimit"]]];
comparisonResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-direct-reference-comparison-v1",
 "Channel"->channel,"Component"->1,"Master"->comparisonMaster,"Seconds"->comparisonSeconds,
 "SourceHash"->FileHash[comparisonSource,"SHA256"],"ProductionSourceHash"->FileHash[comparisonDriver,"SHA256"],
 "ProductionConfigurationHash"->FileHash[localConfigPath,"SHA256"],
 "InputHash"->inputHash,"RawInputHash"->localRawInputHash,
 "RawCoefficientSHA256"->rawTargetComponents[[1]]["RawCoefficientSHA256"],
 "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Coefficient"->comparisonAnswer,
 "Completed"->AssociationQ[comparisonAnswer],"AdoptedForProduction"->False,"Checks"->checks|>;
comparisonDir=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s16_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[comparisonDir],CreateDirectory[comparisonDir,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
```

## misc/s18_sum_exact_polynomials.py

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-137", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 4682, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s18_sum_exact_polynomials.py", "sha256": "5a8af32c6fb25426ff5fc3dcf4e4bbd65fafa2f47815d2dd705d31dfdf7a53a7"} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exactly sum the native-exported polynomial packets; never infer coefficients."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "common/native/python_flint"))
import flint


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def sum_case(case):
    start = time.monotonic()
    context = flint.fmpq_mpoly_ctx.get(tuple(case["variables"]), "lex")
    poly = lambda value: flint.fmpq_mpoly(value, context)
    factors = {}
    common = {}
    packets = []
    for row in case["terms"]:
        numerator, denominator = poly(row["numerator"]), poly(row["denominator"])
        assert str(poly(str(numerator))) == str(numerator)
        unit = flint.fmpq(row["unit"])
        powers = {}
        reconstructed = poly(str(unit))
        for text, power in row["factors"]:
            assert isinstance(power, int) and power > 0
            factor = poly(text)
            reconstructed *= factor ** power
            leading = factor.leading_coefficient()
            canonical = factor / leading
            assert canonical * leading == factor
            unit *= leading ** power
            key = str(canonical)
            factors[key] = canonical
            powers[key] = powers.get(key, 0) + power
        assert reconstructed == denominator and denominator != 0
        for key, power in powers.items():
            common[key] = max(common.get(key, 0), power)
        packets.append((numerator, denominator, unit, powers))
    keys = sorted(common)
    denominator = poly("1")
    for key in keys:
        denominator *= factors[key] ** common[key]
    total = poly("0")
    multipliers = {}
    for index, (numerator, original_denominator, unit, powers) in enumerate(packets, 1):
        support = tuple(common[key] - powers.get(key, 0) for key in keys)
        if support not in multipliers:
            multiplier = poly("1")
            for key, power in zip(keys, support):
                multiplier *= factors[key] ** power
            multipliers[support] = multiplier
        multiplier = multipliers[support] / unit
        assert original_denominator * multiplier == denominator
        term = numerator * multiplier
        following = total + term
        assert following - total == term
        total = following
        if index % 16 == 0 or index == len(packets):
            print("EXACT_POLYNOMIAL_SUM", case["label"], index, len(packets),
                  round(time.monotonic() - start, 3), flush=True)
    original_total = total
    remaining = dict(common)
    extracted = poly("1")
    for key in keys:
        for unused in range(common[key]):
            quotient, remainder = divmod(total, factors[key])
            assert quotient * factors[key] + remainder == total
            if remainder != 0:
                break
            total = quotient
            extracted *= factors[key]
            remaining[key] -= 1
    assert total * extracted == original_total
    reduced_denominator = poly("1")
    for key in keys:
        reduced_denominator *= factors[key] ** remaining[key]
    assert reduced_denominator * extracted == denominator
    if "expected" in case:
        expected = case["expected"]
        assert total * poly(expected["denominator"]) == poly(expected["numerator"]) * reduced_denominator
    result = {"label": case["label"], "numerator": str(total),
              "denominator": str(reduced_denominator), "seconds": time.monotonic() - start,
              "term_count": len(packets), "factor_count": len(keys),
              "exact_termwise_reconstruction_passed": True,
              "expected_comparison_passed": "expected" in case}
    assert poly(result["numerator"]) == total
    assert poly(result["denominator"]) == reduced_denominator
    return result


def main():
    input_path, output_path = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    assert flint.__version__ == "0.8.0"
    payload = json.loads(input_path.read_text())
    assert payload["schema"] == "polarized-sidis-exact-polynomial-input-v1"
    answer = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-exact-polynomial-output-v1",
              "input_sha256": digest(input_path), "source_sha256": digest(Path(__file__)),
              "flint_version": flint.__version__, "cases": []}
    for case in payload["cases"]:
        answer["cases"].append(sum_case(case))
    temporary = output_path.with_suffix(output_path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(answer))
    os.replace(temporary, output_path)
    print("PASS: exact polynomial comparison backend", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

## misc/s20_Hgg_exact_sum.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-139", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6048, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s20_Hgg_exact_sum.wls", "sha256": "c931b5dcd5725e80f04930686ce7cfd546b0093e12ad080adddd110caf1fb4dd"} -->
```wolfram
(* Exact coefficient addition with a bounded, term-at-a-time native transfer. *)
localPolynomialTransfer[cases_List,path_]:=Module[
 {stream,mappings=<||>,nonzero,variables,encodedVariables,rules,encode,header,rational,
  numerator,denominator,factors,numerical,symbolic,unit,packet,serialized,expected,case},
 stream=OpenWrite[path,CharacterEncoding->"UTF-8"];
 WriteString[stream,"{\"schema\":\"polarized-sidis-exact-polynomial-input-v1\",\"cases\":["];
 Do[
  case=cases[[caseIndex]];nonzero=DeleteCases[case["Terms"],0];expected=Lookup[case,"Expected",None];
  variables=Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[Join[nonzero,If[expected===None,{},{expected}]],_Symbol,Infinity]]];
  gate["exact polynomial transfer supports rational coefficients",FreeQ[nonzero,_Real|_Complex]];
  encodedVariables=Table[Symbol["Global`pfsVar"<>ToString[i]],{i,Length[variables]}];
  gate["unassigned exact polynomial variables",AllTrue[encodedVariables,OwnValues[#]==={}&]];
  rules=Thread[variables->encodedVariables];
  encode[expression_]:=Module[{value,text},value=expression/.rules;text=ToString[value,InputForm];
   gate["native polynomial text reconstructs",ToExpression[text,InputForm]===value];text];
  header=StringTrim[ExportString[<|"label"->case["Label"],
   "variables"->(ToString[#,InputForm]&/@encodedVariables)|>,"RawJSON"]];
  gate["native JSON header shape",StringTake[header,-1]==="}"];
  If[caseIndex>1,WriteString[stream,","]];WriteString[stream,StringDrop[header,-1],",\"terms\":["];
  Do[
   rational=bounded[Together[nonzero[[i]]],{"polynomial transfer",i}];
   numerator=Numerator[rational];denominator=Denominator[rational];
   gate["complete polynomial variable support",PolynomialQ[numerator,variables]&&PolynomialQ[denominator,variables]];
   factors=bounded[FactorList[denominator],{"polynomial denominator",i}];
   numerical=Select[factors,NumberQ[First[#]]&];symbolic=Select[factors,!NumberQ[First[#]]&];
   unit=Times@@(Power@@@numerical);
   gate["exported polynomial denominator reconstructs",zero[denominator-unit (Times@@(Power@@@symbolic))]];
   packet=<|"numerator"->encode[numerator],"denominator"->encode[denominator],"unit"->ToString[unit,InputForm],
    "factors"->({encode[First[#]],Last[#]}&/@symbolic)|>;
   serialized=ExportString[packet,"RawJSON"];
   gate["native JSON term reconstructs",ImportString[serialized,"RawJSON"]===packet];
   If[i>1,WriteString[stream,","]];WriteString[stream,serialized];
   If[Mod[i,64]===0,Print["EXACT_POLYNOMIAL_TRANSFER ",case["Label"]," ",i,"/",Length[nonzero]]],
   {i,Length[nonzero]}];
  WriteString[stream,"]"];
  If[expected=!=None,packet=<|"numerator"->encode[Numerator[Together[expected]]],
    "denominator"->encode[Denominator[Together[expected]]]|>;
   serialized=ExportString[packet,"RawJSON"];
   gate["native expected coefficient JSON reconstructs",ImportString[serialized,"RawJSON"]===packet];
   WriteString[stream,",\"expected\":",serialized]];
  WriteString[stream,"}"];AssociateTo[mappings,case["Label"]->Thread[encodedVariables->variables]],
  {caseIndex,Length[cases]}];
 WriteString[stream,"]}"];Close[stream];
 gate["bounded polynomial transfer file",FileByteCount[path]<512*1024^2];mappings];

localExactPolynomialSum[terms_List,purpose_]:=Module[
 {nonzero,identity,directory,inputPath,outputPath,mappings,process,output,row,value,evidence,
  inputFileHash,outputFileHash,elapsed,start},
 nonzero=DeleteCases[terms,0];
 If[nonzero==={},Return[<|"Value"->0,"Evidence"-><|"TermCount"->0|>|>]];
 If[!FreeQ[nonzero,_Complex],Return[streamedDenominatorSum[terms,purpose]]];
 start=AbsoluteTime[];identity=Hash[{inputHash,purpose,localPolynomialProofHash},"SHA256"];
 directory=FileNameJoin[{cache,"polynomial",IntegerString[identity,16]}];
 If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
 inputPath=FileNameJoin[{directory,"input.json"}];outputPath=FileNameJoin[{directory,"output.json"}];
 mappings=localPolynomialTransfer[{<|"Label"->"production_sum","Terms"->nonzero|>},inputPath];
 inputFileHash=FileHash[inputPath,"SHA256"];
 gate["unchanged validated exact backend",FileHash[localPolynomialBackendPath,"SHA256"]===localPolynomialBackendHash];
 Print["EXACT_POLYNOMIAL_BACKEND_START ",InputForm[purpose]," terms ",Length[nonzero]," bytes ",FileByteCount[inputPath]];
 process=RunProcess[{"python3",localPolynomialBackendPath,inputPath,outputPath}];
 Print[process["StandardOutput"]];Print[process["StandardError"]];
 gate["exact production backend completed",process["ExitCode"]===0&&FileExistsQ[outputPath]];
 output=Import[outputPath,"RawJSON"];outputFileHash=FileHash[outputPath,"SHA256"];
 gate["exact production backend input and source",output["schema"]==="polarized-sidis-exact-polynomial-output-v1"&&
  output["input_sha256"]===IntegerString[inputFileHash,16,64]&&
  output["source_sha256"]===IntegerString[localPolynomialBackendHash,16,64]&&output["flint_version"]==="0.8.0"&&
  Length[output["cases"]]===1];
 row=First[output["cases"]];
 gate["complete production termwise reconstruction",row["label"]==="production_sum"&&
  row["term_count"]===Length[nonzero]&&TrueQ[row["exact_termwise_reconstruction_passed"]]];
 value=(ToExpression[row["numerator"],InputForm]/ToExpression[row["denominator"],InputForm])/.
  mappings["production_sum"];

  "OutputBytes"->ByteCount[value],"BackendSeconds"->row["seconds"],"TransferAndSumSeconds"->elapsed,
  "InputFileHash"->inputFileHash,"OutputFileHash"->outputFileHash,"BackendHash"->localPolynomialBackendHash,
  "OwnHggValidationHash"->localPolynomialProofHash,"ExactTermwiseReconstructionPassed"->True|>;
 DeleteFile[{inputPath,outputPath}];DeleteDirectory[directory];
 Print["EXACT_POLYNOMIAL_ACCEPTED ",InputForm[purpose]," seconds ",elapsed," bytes ",ByteCount[value]];
 <|"Value"->value,"Evidence"->evidence|>];

```

```wolfram
$HistoryLength=0;$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];

reviewText=ReadString[reviewProducer];
reviewPrefix=StringTake[reviewText,First[First[StringPosition[reviewText,"\npolynomialCases="]]]-1];
reviewPrefix=StringReplace[reviewPrefix,"$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get[\"FeynCalc`\"];"->"Null;"];
If[!SyntaxQ[reviewPrefix],Quit[1]];ToExpression[reviewPrefix,InputForm];
reviewHelper=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s20_Hgg_exact_sum.wls"}];
gate["complete exact-sum adapter syntax",SyntaxQ[ReadString[reviewHelper]]];Get[reviewHelper];
reviewOwnPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s19_result","s19_result.wl"}];
reviewOwnReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s19_result","s19_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted own Hgg comparison receipt",TrueQ[reviewOwnReceipt["passed"]]&&
 reviewOwnReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s19_result/s19_result.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[reviewOwnPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
reviewOwn=Get[reviewOwnPath];
gate["complete own Hgg native comparison",TrueQ[reviewOwn["AcceptedOwnHggComparisonPassed"]]&&
 And@@Values[reviewOwn["Checks"]]&&Length[reviewOwn["Evidence"]]===reviewOwn["CoefficientCount"]&&
 AllTrue[reviewOwn["Evidence"],TrueQ[#["expected_comparison_passed"]]&&TrueQ[#["exact_termwise_reconstruction_passed"]]&]];
reviewTransferPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s20_result","s20_transfer.json"}];
{reviewSeconds,reviewMappings}=AbsoluteTiming[localPolynomialTransfer[{
 <|"Label"->"accepted_reference_control","Terms"->controlTerms,"Expected"->controlValue|>,
 <|"Label"->"Hgg_component_1_first_master","Terms"->comparisonTerms|>},reviewTransferPath]];
reviewOldPayload=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s17_result","s17_input.json"}],"RawJSON"];
reviewNewPayload=Import[reviewTransferPath,"RawJSON"];
gate["entire actual polynomial transfer exactly unchanged",reviewNewPayload===reviewOldPayload];
reviewBackendOutput=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s17_result","s17_output.json"}],"RawJSON"];
reviewActualRow=Last[reviewBackendOutput["cases"]];
reviewActualValue=(ToExpression[reviewActualRow["numerator"],InputForm]/ToExpression[reviewActualRow["denominator"],InputForm])/.
 reviewMappings["Hgg_component_1_first_master"];

gate["actual native candidate import exactly unchanged",reviewActualValue===reviewActualRecord["Value"]];
```

```wolfram
(* Capture the actual failed master product using the unchanged stage inputs. *)

If[IntegerString[FileHash[reviewParent,"SHA256"],16,64]=!=
 "090263590df1e9c581f5bf934a622069a8a263e35b6c7aadef648817b34a517e",Quit[1]];
reviewParentText=ReadString[reviewParent];
reviewBoundary="\nreferenceSeriesControlCode = ";
If[StringCount[reviewParentText,reviewBoundary]=!=1,Quit[1]];
reviewInitialization=First[StringSplit[reviewParentText,reviewBoundary]];
If[!SyntaxQ[reviewInitialization]||!SyntaxQ[ReadString[reviewSource]],Quit[1]];
ToExpression[reviewInitialization,InputForm];
reviewIndices=Select[Range[Length[mapped["Components"]]],
 AnyTrue[Values[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]],#=!=0&]&];
reviewIndex=First[MinimalBy[reviewIndices,
 ByteCount[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]]&]];
reviewTask=mapped["Components"][[reviewIndex]];
reviewCoefficients=Select[reviewTask["ReducedCoefficients"],#=!=0&]/.transverseRule;
reviewMasters=Select[Keys[reviewCoefficients],#[[1]]==="R02"&];
gate["unique actual failed master family",Length[reviewMasters]===1];
reviewMaster=First[reviewMasters];
reviewCoefficient=reviewCoefficients[reviewMaster]/.D->4-2eps;
reviewCaptureTail="  <|\"Coefficient\"->coefficient,\"Master\"->master,\"Order\"->order,"<>
 "\"MasterPolynomial\"->polynomial,\"RationalPart\"->rationalPart,"<>
 "\"Answer\"->answer,\"Direct\"->direct,\"Residual\"->residual,"<>
 "\"ProductIdentity\"->productIdentity,"<>
 "\"RetainedResidual\"->Normal[Series[residual,{eps,0,order}]],"<>
 "\"RetainedIdentity\"->zeroCoefficient[Normal[Series[residual,{eps,0,order}]]]|>];";
reviewCaptureText=StringReplace[productText,productOldTail->reviewCaptureTail];
gate["capture preserves the entire failed calculation",
 SyntaxQ[reviewCaptureText]&&
 StringReplace[reviewCaptureText,reviewCaptureTail->productOldTail]===productText];
ToExpression[reviewCaptureText,InputForm];
{reviewSeconds,reviewPacket}=AbsoluteTiming[ordinaryMasterProduct[
 reviewCoefficient,regions["OrdinaryMasters"][reviewMaster],0,{reviewIndex,reviewMaster}]];
gate["complete failed-input capture",AssociationQ[reviewPacket]&&
 And@@(KeyExistsQ[reviewPacket,#]&/@{"Answer","Direct","Residual","RetainedResidual","RetainedIdentity"})];
reviewResidual=bounded[Factor[Together[reviewPacket["RetainedResidual"]]],"captured retained residual"];
reviewResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-master-product-capture-v1",
 "Channel"->channel,"ComponentIndex"->reviewIndex,"Master"->reviewMaster,
 "ComponentHash"->Hash[reviewTask,"SHA256"],"InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,
 "ParentSourceHash"->FileHash[reviewParent,"SHA256"],"SourceHash"->FileHash[reviewSource,"SHA256"],
 "Packet"->reviewPacket,"FactoredRetainedResidual"->reviewResidual,
 "Seconds"->reviewSeconds,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},
 "Checks"->checks,"ProductionAccepted"->False|>;
reviewOutput=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s23_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[reviewOutput],CreateDirectory[reviewOutput,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
put[reviewResult,FileNameJoin[{reviewOutput,"s23_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{reviewOutput,"s23_equations.wl"}],
 ToString[<|"Master"->regions["OrdinaryMasters"][reviewMaster],
 "RetainedResidual"->reviewResidual|>,InputForm],"Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{reviewOutput,"s23_checks.json"}],
 <|"checks"->checks,"component_index"->reviewIndex,"product_identity"->reviewPacket["ProductIdentity"],
 "retained_identity"->reviewPacket["RetainedIdentity"],"retained_residual_bytes"->ByteCount[reviewResidual],
 "seconds"->reviewSeconds,"production_accepted"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["ACTUAL_FAILED_MASTER ",InputForm[reviewMaster]];
Print["ACTUAL_RETAINED_RESIDUAL ",InputForm[reviewResidual]];
Print["PASS: actual Hgg master product captured"];Quit[0];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-147", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 4190, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s24_canonical_Hgg_arguments.wls", "sha256": "0b04a1ec7d2898c1eb77fc2400d0c61ca45558f2e21695dad5b8141ecf33cf8a"} -->
```wolfram
(* Preserve special-function arguments exactly while comparing scalar records. *)
localCanonicalScalarArguments[value_]:=Module[{calls,rules},
 calls=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value,_Log|_PolyLog,{0,Infinity}]];
 rules=Map[Function[call,Module[{argument=Last[call],canonical},
   canonical=Factor[Together[Expand[argument]]];
   gate["canonical special-function argument exactly preserved",
    Factor[Together[Expand[argument-canonical]]]===0];
   call->ReplacePart[call,-1->canonical]]],calls];
 value/.rules];

If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_VALIDATE_ARGUMENTS"]==="1",
 $HistoryLength=0;
 reviewRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];
 reviewSource=FileNameJoin[{reviewRoot,"misc","s24_canonical_Hgg_arguments.wls"}];
 checks=<||>;
 gate[name_,test_]:=If[TrueQ[test],AssociateTo[checks,name->True];Print["PASS: ",name],
  Print["FAIL: ",name];Quit[1]];
 reviewPath=FileNameJoin[{reviewRoot,"misc","s23_result","s23_result.wl"}];
 reviewReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{reviewRoot,"misc","s23_result","s23_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["actual failed product capture accepted",TrueQ[reviewReceipt["passed"]]&&
  reviewReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s23_result/s23_result.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[reviewPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 captured=Get[reviewPath];
 packet=captured["Packet"];
 normalizedResidual=Factor[Together[localCanonicalScalarArguments[packet["RetainedResidual"]]]];
 gate["actual retained product residual is exactly zero",normalizedResidual===0];
 normalizedAnswer=localCanonicalScalarArguments[Normal[Series[packet["Answer"],{eps,0,packet["Order"]}]]];
 normalizedDirect=localCanonicalScalarArguments[packet["Direct"]];
 gate["actual complete retained products agree",Factor[Together[normalizedAnswer-normalizedDirect]]===0];
 argumentCalls=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[packet["RetainedResidual"],_Log|_PolyLog,{0,Infinity}]];
 argumentRecords=Map[<|"Original"->Last[#],"Canonical"->Factor[Together[Expand[Last[#]]]]|>&,argumentCalls];
 gate["all actual argument mappings reconstruct",And@@(Factor[Together[Expand[#["Original"]-#["Canonical"]]]]===0&/@argumentRecords)];
 gate["saved coefficient and master remain unchanged",captured===Get[reviewPath]];
 ordinaryPath=FileNameJoin[{reviewRoot,"misc","s25_result","s25_result.wl"}];
 ordinaryReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{reviewRoot,"misc","s25_result","s25_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["actual complete ordinary capture accepted",TrueQ[ordinaryReceipt["passed"]]&&
  ordinaryReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s25_result/s25_result.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[ordinaryPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 ordinaryCapture=Get[ordinaryPath];
 ordinaryNormalized=Factor[Together[localCanonicalScalarArguments[ordinaryCapture["Difference"]]]];
 gate["complete saved ordinary comparison exactly zero",ordinaryNormalized===0];
 ordinaryCandidate=localCanonicalScalarArguments[ordinaryCapture["Candidate"]];
 ordinaryOriginal=localCanonicalScalarArguments[ordinaryCapture["Original"]];
 gate["complete original and recurrence ordinary agree",Factor[Together[ordinaryCandidate-ordinaryOriginal]]===0];
 gate["complete ordinary inputs remain unchanged",ordinaryCapture===Get[ordinaryPath]];
 reviewOut=FileNameJoin[{reviewRoot,"misc","s24_result"}];
 If[!DirectoryQ[reviewOut],CreateDirectory[reviewOut,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
 result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-exact-function-argument-comparison-v1",
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[reviewSource,"SHA256"],"CaptureHash"->FileHash[reviewPath,"SHA256"],
  "Definitions"->DownValues[localCanonicalScalarArguments],"ArgumentMappings"->argumentRecords,
  "RetainedResidual"->normalizedResidual,"CompleteOrdinaryResidual"->ordinaryNormalized,
  "OrdinaryCaptureHash"->FileHash[ordinaryPath,"SHA256"],"Checks"->checks,"NativeVersion"->$Version,
  "CoefficientAlgorithmChanged"->False,"Accepted"->True|>;
 Put[result,FileNameJoin[{reviewOut,"s24_result.wl"}]];
 Export[FileNameJoin[{reviewOut,"s24_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
  "retained_residual"->normalizedResidual,"coefficient_algorithm_changed"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
 Print["ACTUAL_ARGUMENT_MAPS ",InputForm[argumentRecords]];
 Print["PASS: exact Hgg special-function argument comparison"];Quit[0]];
```

```wolfram
(* Compare the saved original control to the unchanged recurrence on its exact input. *)
$HistoryLength=0;

 "b3f7103b3e55058953f206d7454478e5dc97de61888444354860348fbe498090",Quit[1]];

If[StringCount[reviewParentText,reviewBoundary]=!=1,Quit[1]];

If[!SyntaxQ[reviewInitialization]||!SyntaxQ[ReadString[reviewSource]],Quit[1]];

reviewIndices=Select[Range[Length[mapped["Components"]]],
 AnyTrue[Values[mapped["Components"][[#]]["ReducedCoefficients"]],#=!=0&]&];

reviewOriginalPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s11_result","own_reference","s12_original_ordinary.wl"}];
reviewOriginal=Get[reviewOriginalPath];
reviewBinding=Hash[{reviewTask,transverseRule,regions["OrdinaryMasters"],DownValues[epsilonSeries],
 $Version,$FeynCalcVersion,$Assumptions},"SHA256"];

 reviewOriginal["ValueHash"]===Hash[reviewOriginal["Value"],"SHA256"]];
{reviewSeconds,reviewCandidate}=AbsoluteTiming[candidateOrdinary[reviewTask,reviewIndex]];
reviewDifference=bounded[Expand[reviewCandidate-reviewOriginal["Value"],eps],"complete captured ordinary difference"];
reviewResidual=bounded[Factor[Together[localCanonicalScalarArguments[reviewDifference]]],"factored captured ordinary residual"];
reviewOutput=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s25_result"}];

reviewResult=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-complete-ordinary-capture-v1","Channel"->channel,
 "ComponentIndex"->reviewIndex,"Task"->reviewTask,"Original"->reviewOriginal["Value"],
 "Candidate"->reviewCandidate,"Residual"->reviewResidual,"Difference"->reviewDifference,
 "OriginalBinding"->reviewBinding,"OriginalCacheHash"->FileHash[reviewOriginalPath,"SHA256"],
 "InputHash"->inputHash,"InputHashes"->inputHashes,"SourceHash"->FileHash[reviewSource,"SHA256"],
 "ParentSourceHash"->FileHash[reviewParent,"SHA256"],"Seconds"->reviewSeconds,
 "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks,"ProductionAccepted"->False|>;
put[reviewResult,FileNameJoin[{reviewOutput,"s25_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{reviewOutput,"s25_equations.wl"}],ToString[reviewResidual,InputForm],"Text"];
Export[FileNameJoin[{reviewOutput,"s25_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"component_index"->reviewIndex,
 "residual_bytes"->ByteCount[reviewResidual],"seconds"->reviewSeconds,"production_accepted"->False|>,"RawJSON"];
```

## misc/s26_inspect_Hgg_regulator.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-151", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3156, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s26_inspect_Hgg_regulator.wls", "sha256": "e5e87f60b340b5e655a56151f4c6870624de7d9b8517269854a46590e9c15b89"} -->
```wolfram
(* Inspect the actual coefficient at the reported regulator-valuation memory boundary. *)
$HistoryLength=0;$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
root=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[root];checks=<||>;
gate[n_,v_]:=If[TrueQ[v],AssociateTo[checks,n->True];Print["PASS: ",n],Print["FAIL: ",n];Quit[1]];
source=ExpandFileName[$InputFileName];mapPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s10_result","s10_result.wl"}];
receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s10_result","s10_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
gate["accepted actual reduced input",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&receipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s10_result/s10_result.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[mapPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
mapped=Get[mapPath];
gate["complete accepted reduction",TrueQ[mapped["ReductionCoverageComplete"]]&&And@@Values[mapped["Checks"]]];
log=ReadString[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s11_result","s11.log"}]];
gate["reported component memory boundary",StringContainsQ[log,"coefficient regulator valuation memory limit"]];
indices=Select[Range[Length[mapped["Components"]]],mapped["Components"][[#]]["Index"]==={4,1,1}&];
gate["unique actual failing projection",Length[indices]===1];idx=First[indices];
component=mapped["Components"][[idx]];rule=mapped["TransverseSubstitution"];Clear[mapped];ClearSystemCache[];
coefficients=Select[component["ReducedCoefficients"],#=!=0&]/.rule;
firstMaster=First[Keys[coefficients]];coefficient=coefficients[firstMaster]/.D->4-2eps;
{seconds,pair}=AbsoluteTiming[{Numerator[coefficient],Denominator[coefficient]}];
facts=<|"ComponentIndex"->idx,"Master"->firstMaster,"OriginalBytes"->ByteCount[coefficient],
 "NumeratorBytes"->ByteCount[First[pair]],"DenominatorBytes"->ByteCount[Last[pair]],
 "Head"->Head[coefficient],"NumeratorHead"->Head[First[pair]],"DenominatorHead"->Head[Last[pair]],
 "NumeratorPolynomialInRegulator"->PolynomialQ[First[pair],eps],
 "DenominatorPolynomialInRegulator"->PolynomialQ[Last[pair],eps],
 "NativeExactReconstruction"->(First[pair]/Last[pair]===coefficient),"Seconds"->seconds|>;
gate["native numerator denominator reconstruct exact coefficient",facts["NativeExactReconstruction"]];
out=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s26_result"}];If[!DirectoryQ[out],CreateDirectory[out]];
packet=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-regulator-input-inspection-v1","SourceHash"->FileHash[source,"SHA256"],
 "InputHash"->FileHash[mapPath,"SHA256"],"Index"->component["Index"],"Master"->firstMaster,
 "Coefficient"->coefficient,"Pair"->pair,"Facts"->facts,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Checks"->checks|>;
file=FileNameJoin[{out,"s26_result.wl"}];serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[packet],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["bounded inspection file",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];Export[file,serialized,"Text"];
gate["exact saved inspection reload",Get[file]===packet];
Put[<|"Facts"->facts,"CompleteDenominator"->Last[pair]|>,FileNameJoin[{out,"s26_equations.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{out,"s26_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"facts"->ToString[facts,InputForm]|>,"RawJSON"];
Print["REGULATOR_INPUT ",InputForm[facts]];Print["PASS: actual Hgg regulator input inspected"];Quit[0];

```
<!-- END SOURCE -->

```wolfram
(* Preserve an existing exact regulator-polynomial ratio without multivariate recombination. *)
localRegulatorRational[coefficient_]:=Module[{numerator,denominator,seconds},
 {seconds,{numerator,denominator}}=AbsoluteTiming[{Numerator[coefficient],Denominator[coefficient]}];
 If[PolynomialQ[numerator,eps]&&PolynomialQ[denominator,eps]&&denominator=!=0,
  gate["stored regulator-polynomial ratio reconstructs",numerator/denominator===coefficient];
  Print["REGULATOR_RATIO_PRESERVED bytes ",ByteCount[coefficient]," seconds ",seconds];coefficient,
  bounded[Together[coefficient],"reference fallback regulator rational"]]];

If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_VALIDATE_REGULATOR"]==="1",
 $HistoryLength=0;$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
 root=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];SetDirectory[root];
 source=ExpandFileName[$InputFileName];checks=<||>;
 gate[n_,v_]:=If[TrueQ[v],AssociateTo[checks,n->True];Print["PASS: ",n],Print["FAIL: ",n];Quit[1]];
 SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];bounded[v_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[
  TimeConstrained[v,1200,gate[label<>" time limit",False]],2*1024^3,gate[label<>" memory limit",False]];
 readAccepted[relative_,receiptRelative_]:=Module[{p=FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],receipt},
  receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,receiptRelative}],"RawJSON"];
  gate["accepted input "<>relative,TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&receipt["result_sha256"][relative]===IntegerString[FileHash[p,"SHA256"],16,64]];Get[p]];
 captured=readAccepted["misc/s26_result/s26_result.wl","misc/s26_result/s26_execution.json"];
 own=readAccepted["misc/s23_result/s23_result.wl","misc/s23_result/s23_execution.json"];
 reference=readAccepted["Hqqbar/s12_rational_series_result/s12_result.wl","Hqqbar/s12_rational_series_result/s12_execution.json"];
 argumentProof=readAccepted["misc/s24_result/s24_result.wl","misc/s24_result/s24_execution.json"];
 Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s24_canonical_Hgg_arguments.wls"}]];
 gate["accepted argument comparison retained",TrueQ[argumentProof["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[argumentProof["Checks"]]&&
  DownValues[localCanonicalScalarArguments]===argumentProof["Definitions"]];
 zeroCoefficient[value_]:=Factor[Together[localCanonicalScalarArguments[value]]]===0;
 DownValues[epsilonSeries]=reference["OriginalDefinitions"][[1]];
 DownValues[laurentProduct]=reference["OriginalDefinitions"][[2]];
 DownValues[rationalSeries]=reference["RationalDefinitions"];
 DownValues[checkedRationalSeries]=reference["CheckedRationalDefinitions"];
 DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct]=reference["ProductDefinitions"];
 referenceSeriesComparisonText=ReadString[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_check_rational_master_product.wls"}]];
 gate["executed reference product source retained",reference["SourceHash"]===FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s12_check_rational_master_product.wls"}],"SHA256"]];
 parentPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s11_assemble_Hgg_real.wls"}];parentText=ReadString[parentPath];
 parentConfig=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s11_inputs.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["reviewed actual parent source",parentConfig["source_sha256"]===IntegerString[FileHash[parentPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 start="productOriginalDefinitions = ";finish="recoilProofRelative = ";
 gate["complete executed product adapter boundary",StringCount[parentText,start]===1&&StringCount[parentText,finish]===1];
 adapter=start<>First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[parentText,start]],finish]];
 gate["complete executed product adapter syntax",SyntaxQ[adapter]];ToExpression[adapter,InputForm];
 originalChecked=DownValues[checkedRationalSeries];originalProduct=DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct];
 checkedStart="\ncheckedRationalSeries[";checkedEnd="\nordinaryMasterProduct[";
 gate["complete checked recurrence source boundary",StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText,checkedStart]===1&&StringCount[referenceSeriesComparisonText,checkedEnd]===1];
 checkedText=checkedStart<>First[StringSplit[Last[StringSplit[referenceSeriesComparisonText,checkedStart]],checkedEnd]];
 checkedOld="rational = bounded[Together[coefficient], \"rational master coefficient\"];";
 productOld="rational = bounded[Together[coefficient], \"coefficient regulator valuation\"];";
 replacement="rational = localRegulatorRational[coefficient];";
 gate["only two rational preparation calls changed",StringCount[checkedText,checkedOld]===1&&StringCount[productCorrectedText,productOld]===1];
 checkedNew=StringReplace[checkedText,checkedOld->replacement];productNew=StringReplace[productCorrectedText,productOld->replacement];
 gate["complete recurrence and product retained",SyntaxQ[checkedNew]&&SyntaxQ[productNew]&&
  StringReplace[checkedNew,replacement->checkedOld]===checkedText&&StringReplace[productNew,replacement->productOld]===productCorrectedText];
 ToExpression[checkedNew,InputForm];ToExpression[productNew,InputForm];
 {ownSeconds,ownValue}=AbsoluteTiming[ordinaryMasterProduct[own["Packet"]["Coefficient"],own["Packet"]["Master"],own["Packet"]["Order"],{"Own",own["ComponentIndex"],own["Master"]}]];
 gate["entire accepted own master product reproduced",bounded[zeroCoefficient[ownValue-own["Packet"]["Direct"]],"own regulator preparation comparison"]];
 mapPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s10_result","s10_result.wl"}];

 scalarRules=Get[mapPath]["ScalarConventionRules"];ClearSystemCache[];
 library=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"common","s06_result","s06_result.wl"}]];
 row=library["Library"]["s15"];regionPath=FileNameJoin[{root,row["File"]}];
 gate["pinned scalar master regions",IntegerString[FileHash[regionPath,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["SHA256"]];
 regions=Get[regionPath]/.scalarRules;master=regions["OrdinaryMasters"][captured["Master"]];
 {actualSeconds,actualValue}=AbsoluteTiming[ordinaryMasterProduct[captured["Coefficient"],master,own["Packet"]["Order"],{"Actual",captured["Facts"]["ComponentIndex"],captured["Master"]}]];
 gate["actual failed master product fully evaluated",FreeQ[actualValue,_CutIntegral|_Series|_SeriesData|_Missing|_Real|$Failed|$Aborted]];
 out=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s27_result"}];If[!DirectoryQ[out],CreateDirectory[out]];
 result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-direct-regulator-ratio-comparison-v1","SourceHash"->FileHash[source,"SHA256"],
  "ParentSourceHash"->FileHash[parentPath,"SHA256"],"CaptureHash"->FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s26_result","s26_result.wl"}],"SHA256"],
  "Definitions"->DownValues[localRegulatorRational],"OriginalCheckedDefinitions"->originalChecked,"OriginalProductDefinitions"->originalProduct,
  "CheckedDefinitions"->DownValues[checkedRationalSeries],"ProductDefinitions"->DownValues[ordinaryMasterProduct],
  "OwnValue"->ownValue,"ActualValue"->actualValue,"OwnSeconds"->ownSeconds,"ActualSeconds"->actualSeconds,
  "Checks"->checks,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"Accepted"->True|>;
 file=FileNameJoin[{out,"s27_result.wl"}];serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[result],InputForm]<>"]\n";
 gate["bounded regulator preparation proof",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];Export[file,serialized,"Text"];
 gate["exact regulator preparation proof reload",Get[file]===result];
 Export[FileNameJoin[{out,"s27_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"own_seconds"->ownSeconds,"actual_seconds"->actualSeconds|>,"RawJSON"];
 Print["PASS: direct Hgg regulator ratio validated"];Quit[0]];
```

```wolfram
 reviewReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{localRationalRoot,"misc","s20_result","s20_review_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted exact polynomial backend retained",TrueQ[reviewReceipt["passed"]]&&
  reviewReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s20_interface_review.json"]===
   IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{localRationalRoot,"misc","s20_interface_review.json"}],"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  And@@Values[review["checks"]]&&review["backend_sha256"]===IntegerString[baseHash,16,64]];
 identity=Hash[{coefficient,FileHash[localRationalSource,"SHA256"],backendHash,baseHash},"SHA256"];
 cacheRoot=FileNameJoin[{localRationalRoot,"misc","s11_work","regulator_normalization"}];
 If[!DirectoryQ[cacheRoot],CreateDirectory[cacheRoot,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
 cacheFile=FileNameJoin[{cacheRoot,IntegerString[identity,16]<>".wl"}];
 saved=If[FileExistsQ[cacheFile],Get[cacheFile],<||>];
 If[Lookup[saved,"Binding",None]===identity&&TrueQ[Lookup[saved,"Accepted",False]]&&
   KeyExistsQ[saved,"Value"]&&Lookup[saved,"ValueHash",None]===Hash[saved["Value"],"SHA256"],
  Return[saved["Value"]]];
 pair={Numerator[coefficient],Denominator[coefficient]};
 gate["raw scalar ratio exactly reconstructs",First[pair]/Last[pair]===coefficient&&FreeQ[pair,_Real]];
 atoms=DeleteDuplicates[Join[Cases[pair,p_Power/;!IntegerQ[p[[2]]],Infinity],Cases[pair,_Complex,Infinity]]];
 atomSymbols=Table[Symbol["Global`prrAtom"<>ToString[i]],{i,Length[atoms]}];
 gate["unassigned algebraic input generators",AllTrue[atomSymbols,OwnValues[#]==={}&]];
 atomRules=Thread[atoms->atomSymbols];reverseAtoms=Reverse/@atomRules;lifted=pair/.atomRules;

 rules=Thread[variables->encodedVariables];reverseRules=Reverse/@rules;
 encode[expression_]:=Module[{nativeValue=expression/.rules,nativeText},nativeText=ToString[nativeValue,InputForm];
  gate["complete polynomial transfer text reconstructs",ToExpression[nativeText,InputForm]===nativeValue];nativeText];
 numerator=encode[First[lifted]];denominator=encode[Last[lifted]];
 payload=<|"schema"->"polarized-sidis-regulator-polynomial-input-v1",
  "base_backend_sha256"->IntegerString[baseHash,16,64],
  "variables"->(ToString[#,InputForm]&/@encodedVariables),"numerator"->numerator,"denominator"->denominator|>;
 directory=FileNameJoin[{cacheRoot,IntegerString[identity,16]<>"_"<>ToString[$ProcessID]}];
 If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory]];
 inputPath=FileNameJoin[{directory,"input.json"}];outputPath=FileNameJoin[{directory,"output.json"}];
 Export[inputPath,payload,"RawJSON"];
 gate["exact native polynomial JSON transfer",Import[inputPath,"RawJSON"]===payload&&FileByteCount[inputPath]<128*1024^2];
 inputFileHash=FileHash[inputPath,"SHA256"];
 Print["REGULATOR_POLYNOMIAL_BACKEND_START input_bytes ",ByteCount[coefficient]," transfer_bytes ",FileByteCount[inputPath]];
 process=RunProcess[{"python3",backendPath,inputPath,outputPath}];
 Print[process["StandardOutput"]];Print[process["StandardError"]];
 gate["exact polynomial normalization completed",process["ExitCode"]===0&&FileExistsQ[outputPath]];
 output=Import[outputPath,"RawJSON"];outputFileHash=FileHash[outputPath,"SHA256"];
 gate["complete normalization backend identity",output["schema"]==="polarized-sidis-regulator-polynomial-output-v1"&&
  output["source_sha256"]===IntegerString[backendHash,16,64]&&output["base_backend_sha256"]===IntegerString[baseHash,16,64]&&
  output["input_sha256"]===IntegerString[inputFileHash,16,64]&&output["flint_version"]==="0.8.0"&&
  TrueQ[output["denominator_factorization_reconstructed"]]];
 row=output["result"];

 value=(ToExpression[row["numerator"],InputForm]/ToExpression[row["denominator"],InputForm])/.reverseRules/.reverseAtoms;

  "InputFileHash"->inputFileHash,"OutputFileHash"->outputFileHash,"BackendHash"->backendHash,"BaseBackendHash"->baseHash,

 serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[packet],InputForm]<>"]\n";

 temporary=cacheFile<>".tmp."<>ToString[$ProcessID];Export[temporary,serialized,"Text"];

 DeleteFile[{inputPath,outputPath}];DeleteDirectory[directory];
 Print["REGULATOR_POLYNOMIAL_ACCEPTED seconds ",AbsoluteTime[]-start," input_bytes ",ByteCount[coefficient],

 value];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-155", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 2482, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s28_reduce_regulator_polynomials.py", "sha256": "0919030cfe589e98f54d8ff28148c04c8cf7446004781c8c6bd7c290df7ff116"} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Factor native polynomial denominators and reuse the accepted exact sum backend."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

BASE = Path(__file__).with_name("s18_sum_exact_polynomials.py")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    input_path, output_path = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    payload = json.loads(input_path.read_text())
    assert payload["schema"] == "polarized-sidis-regulator-polynomial-input-v1"
    assert payload["base_backend_sha256"] == digest(BASE)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("accepted_polynomial_backend", BASE)
    backend = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(backend)
    assert backend.flint.__version__ == "0.8.0"
    context = backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly_ctx.get(tuple(payload["variables"]), "lex")
    numerator = backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly(payload["numerator"], context)
    denominator = backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly(payload["denominator"], context)
    assert denominator != 0
    started = time.monotonic()
    unit, factors = denominator.factor()
    reconstructed = backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly(str(unit), context)
    for factor, power in factors:
        assert isinstance(power, int) and power > 0
        reconstructed *= factor ** power
    assert reconstructed == denominator
    factor_seconds = time.monotonic() - started
    print("REGULATOR_DENOMINATOR_FACTORED", len(factors), factor_seconds, flush=True)
    case = {"label": "regulator_normalization", "variables": payload["variables"],
            "terms": [{"numerator": str(numerator), "denominator": str(denominator),
                       "unit": str(unit), "factors": [[str(p), n] for p, n in factors]}]}
    result = backend.sum_case(case)
    answer = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-regulator-polynomial-output-v1",
              "source_sha256": digest(Path(__file__)), "input_sha256": digest(input_path),
              "base_backend_sha256": digest(BASE), "flint_version": backend.flint.__version__,
              "denominator_factorization_reconstructed": True,
              "factor_seconds": factor_seconds, "result": result}
    temporary = output_path.with_suffix(output_path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(answer))
    os.replace(temporary, output_path)
    print("PASS: exact regulator polynomial normalization", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## misc/s29_regulator_series.py

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-157", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 5414, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s29_regulator_series.py", "sha256": "60719fe9098d852fab9ab6ac9c38b7e9e58e451c97ca825a6d1a6942fe36fab0"} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute the pinned rationalSeries recurrence in exact polynomial arithmetic."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

BASE = Path(__file__).with_name("s18_sum_exact_polynomials.py")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    input_path, output_path = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    payload = json.loads(input_path.read_text())
    assert payload["schema"] == "polarized-sidis-regulator-series-input-v1"
    assert payload["base_backend_sha256"] == digest(BASE)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("accepted_polynomial_backend", BASE)
    backend = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(backend)
    assert backend.flint.__version__ == "0.8.0"
    context = backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly_ctx.get(tuple(payload["variables"]), "lex")
    poly = lambda value: backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly(value, context)
    numerator, denominator = poly(payload["numerator"]), poly(payload["denominator"])
    assert denominator != 0
    regulator_index = payload["variables"].index(payload["regulator"])
    regulator = poly(payload["regulator"])
    maximum = payload["maximum_power"]
    assert isinstance(maximum, int)
    started = time.monotonic()

    def coefficients(value):
        grouped = {}
        for powers, coefficient in value.terms():
            reduced = [int(power) for power in powers]
            assert tuple(reduced) == powers
            degree = reduced[regulator_index]
            reduced[regulator_index] = 0
            assert tuple(reduced) not in grouped.setdefault(degree, {})
            grouped[degree][tuple(reduced)] = coefficient
        result = {degree: context.from_dict(terms) for degree, terms in grouped.items()}
        reconstructed = poly("0")
        for degree, coefficient in result.items():
            assert all(powers[regulator_index] == 0 for powers, unused in coefficient.terms())
            reconstructed += coefficient * regulator ** degree
        assert reconstructed == value
        return result

    n_coefficients, d_coefficients = coefficients(numerator), coefficients(denominator)
    factor_cache = {}

    def term(n, d):
        key = str(d)
        if key not in factor_cache:
            unit, factors = d.factor()
            reconstruction = poly(str(unit))
            for factor, power in factors:
                assert isinstance(power, int) and power > 0
                reconstruction *= factor ** power
            assert reconstruction == d
            factor_cache[key] = (str(unit), [[str(f), p] for f, p in factors])
        unit, factors = factor_cache[key]
        return {"numerator": str(n), "denominator": key, "unit": unit, "factors": factors}

    def exact_sum(label, pairs):
        result = backend.sum_case({"label": label, "variables": payload["variables"],
                                   "terms": [term(n, d) for n, d in pairs]})
        assert result["exact_termwise_reconstruction_passed"]
        return poly(result["numerator"]), poly(result["denominator"])

    rows = []
    residual_checks = []
    if numerator != 0:
        n_minimum, d_minimum = min(n_coefficients), min(d_coefficients)
        leading = n_minimum - d_minimum
        count = maximum - leading
        d0 = d_coefficients[d_minimum]
        quotient = []
        for order in range(count + 1):
            n_coefficient = n_coefficients.get(n_minimum + order, poly("0"))
            pairs = [(n_coefficient, d0)]
            for index in range(1, order + 1):
                qn, qd = quotient[order - index]
                pairs.append((-d_coefficients.get(d_minimum + index, poly("0")) * qn, d0 * qd))
            value = exact_sum("regulator_recurrence_" + str(order), pairs)
            quotient.append(value)
            residual = [(-n_coefficient, poly("1"))]
            for index in range(order + 1):
                qn, qd = quotient[order - index]
                residual.append((d_coefficients.get(d_minimum + index, poly("0")) * qn, qd))
            residual_numerator, unused = exact_sum("regulator_residual_" + str(order), residual)
            assert residual_numerator == 0
            residual_checks.append(True)
            rows.append({"power": leading + order, "numerator": str(value[0]), "denominator": str(value[1])})
            print("REGULATOR_SERIES_COEFFICIENT", order, count, round(time.monotonic() - started, 3), flush=True)
    else:
        leading = None
        count = -1
    assert len(rows) == max(0, count + 1) and all(residual_checks)
    answer = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-regulator-series-output-v1",
              "source_sha256": digest(Path(__file__)), "input_sha256": digest(input_path),
              "base_backend_sha256": digest(BASE), "flint_version": backend.flint.__version__,
              "exact_polynomial_reconstruction": True,
              "complete_retained_residual_reconstruction": True,
              "maximum_power": maximum, "leading_power": leading,
              "seconds": time.monotonic() - started, "coefficients": rows}
    temporary = output_path.with_suffix(output_path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(answer))
    os.replace(temporary, output_path)
    print("PASS: exact regulator recurrence and residual reconstruction", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

## misc/s29_result/reference/before_integer_serialization/s29_regulator_series.py

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-159", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 5350, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s29_result/reference/before_integer_serialization/s29_regulator_series.py", "sha256": "ad0492b880b779aeca80e20376f89c571f898ea1bf37b145cce57541073c99a5"} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute the pinned rationalSeries recurrence in exact polynomial arithmetic."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

BASE = Path(__file__).with_name("s18_sum_exact_polynomials.py")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    input_path, output_path = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    payload = json.loads(input_path.read_text())
    assert payload["schema"] == "polarized-sidis-regulator-series-input-v1"
    assert payload["base_backend_sha256"] == digest(BASE)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("accepted_polynomial_backend", BASE)
    backend = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(backend)
    assert backend.flint.__version__ == "0.8.0"
    context = backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly_ctx.get(tuple(payload["variables"]), "lex")
    poly = lambda value: backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly(value, context)
    numerator, denominator = poly(payload["numerator"]), poly(payload["denominator"])
    assert denominator != 0
    regulator_index = payload["variables"].index(payload["regulator"])
    regulator = poly(payload["regulator"])
    maximum = payload["maximum_power"]
    assert isinstance(maximum, int)
    started = time.monotonic()

    def coefficients(value):
        grouped = {}
        for powers, coefficient in value.terms():
            reduced = list(powers)
            degree = reduced[regulator_index]
            reduced[regulator_index] = 0
            assert tuple(reduced) not in grouped.setdefault(degree, {})
            grouped[degree][tuple(reduced)] = coefficient
        result = {degree: context.from_dict(terms) for degree, terms in grouped.items()}
        reconstructed = poly("0")
        for degree, coefficient in result.items():
            assert all(powers[regulator_index] == 0 for powers, unused in coefficient.terms())
            reconstructed += coefficient * regulator ** degree
        assert reconstructed == value
        return result

    n_coefficients, d_coefficients = coefficients(numerator), coefficients(denominator)
    factor_cache = {}

    def term(n, d):
        key = str(d)
        if key not in factor_cache:
            unit, factors = d.factor()
            reconstruction = poly(str(unit))
            for factor, power in factors:
                assert isinstance(power, int) and power > 0
                reconstruction *= factor ** power
            assert reconstruction == d
            factor_cache[key] = (str(unit), [[str(f), p] for f, p in factors])
        unit, factors = factor_cache[key]
        return {"numerator": str(n), "denominator": key, "unit": unit, "factors": factors}

    def exact_sum(label, pairs):
        result = backend.sum_case({"label": label, "variables": payload["variables"],
                                   "terms": [term(n, d) for n, d in pairs]})
        assert result["exact_termwise_reconstruction_passed"]
        return poly(result["numerator"]), poly(result["denominator"])

    rows = []
    residual_checks = []
    if numerator != 0:
        n_minimum, d_minimum = min(n_coefficients), min(d_coefficients)
        leading = n_minimum - d_minimum
        count = maximum - leading
        d0 = d_coefficients[d_minimum]
        quotient = []
        for order in range(count + 1):
            n_coefficient = n_coefficients.get(n_minimum + order, poly("0"))
            pairs = [(n_coefficient, d0)]
            for index in range(1, order + 1):
                qn, qd = quotient[order - index]
                pairs.append((-d_coefficients.get(d_minimum + index, poly("0")) * qn, d0 * qd))
            value = exact_sum("regulator_recurrence_" + str(order), pairs)
            quotient.append(value)
            residual = [(-n_coefficient, poly("1"))]
            for index in range(order + 1):
                qn, qd = quotient[order - index]
                residual.append((d_coefficients.get(d_minimum + index, poly("0")) * qn, qd))
            residual_numerator, unused = exact_sum("regulator_residual_" + str(order), residual)
            assert residual_numerator == 0
            residual_checks.append(True)
            rows.append({"power": leading + order, "numerator": str(value[0]), "denominator": str(value[1])})
            print("REGULATOR_SERIES_COEFFICIENT", order, count, round(time.monotonic() - started, 3), flush=True)
    else:
        leading = None
        count = -1
    assert len(rows) == max(0, count + 1) and all(residual_checks)
    answer = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-regulator-series-output-v1",
              "source_sha256": digest(Path(__file__)), "input_sha256": digest(input_path),
              "base_backend_sha256": digest(BASE), "flint_version": backend.flint.__version__,
              "exact_polynomial_reconstruction": True,
              "complete_retained_residual_reconstruction": True,
              "maximum_power": maximum, "leading_power": leading,
              "seconds": time.monotonic() - started, "coefficients": rows}
    temporary = output_path.with_suffix(output_path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(answer))
    os.replace(temporary, output_path)
    print("PASS: exact regulator recurrence and residual reconstruction", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
