## misc/s29_result/reference/before_runtime_context/s29_regulator_series.py

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-161", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 5414, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s29_result/reference/before_runtime_context/s29_regulator_series.py", "sha256": "60719fe9098d852fab9ab6ac9c38b7e9e58e451c97ca825a6d1a6942fe36fab0"} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute the pinned rationalSeries recurrence in exact polynomial arithmetic."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

BASE = Path(__file__).with_name("s18_sum_exact_polynomials.py")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    input_path, output_path = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    payload = json.loads(input_path.read_text())
    assert payload["schema"] == "polarized-sidis-regulator-series-input-v1"
    assert payload["base_backend_sha256"] == digest(BASE)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("accepted_polynomial_backend", BASE)
    backend = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(backend)
    assert backend.flint.__version__ == "0.8.0"
    context = backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly_ctx.get(tuple(payload["variables"]), "lex")
    poly = lambda value: backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly(value, context)
    numerator, denominator = poly(payload["numerator"]), poly(payload["denominator"])
    assert denominator != 0
    regulator_index = payload["variables"].index(payload["regulator"])
    regulator = poly(payload["regulator"])
    maximum = payload["maximum_power"]
    assert isinstance(maximum, int)
    started = time.monotonic()

    def coefficients(value):
        grouped = {}
        for powers, coefficient in value.terms():
            reduced = [int(power) for power in powers]
            assert tuple(reduced) == powers
            degree = reduced[regulator_index]
            reduced[regulator_index] = 0
            assert tuple(reduced) not in grouped.setdefault(degree, {})
            grouped[degree][tuple(reduced)] = coefficient
        result = {degree: context.from_dict(terms) for degree, terms in grouped.items()}
        reconstructed = poly("0")
        for degree, coefficient in result.items():
            assert all(powers[regulator_index] == 0 for powers, unused in coefficient.terms())
            reconstructed += coefficient * regulator ** degree
        assert reconstructed == value
        return result

    n_coefficients, d_coefficients = coefficients(numerator), coefficients(denominator)
    factor_cache = {}

    def term(n, d):
        key = str(d)
        if key not in factor_cache:
            unit, factors = d.factor()
            reconstruction = poly(str(unit))
            for factor, power in factors:
                assert isinstance(power, int) and power > 0
                reconstruction *= factor ** power
            assert reconstruction == d
            factor_cache[key] = (str(unit), [[str(f), p] for f, p in factors])
        unit, factors = factor_cache[key]
        return {"numerator": str(n), "denominator": key, "unit": unit, "factors": factors}

    def exact_sum(label, pairs):
        result = backend.sum_case({"label": label, "variables": payload["variables"],
                                   "terms": [term(n, d) for n, d in pairs]})
        assert result["exact_termwise_reconstruction_passed"]
        return poly(result["numerator"]), poly(result["denominator"])

    rows = []
    residual_checks = []
    if numerator != 0:
        n_minimum, d_minimum = min(n_coefficients), min(d_coefficients)
        leading = n_minimum - d_minimum
        count = maximum - leading
        d0 = d_coefficients[d_minimum]
        quotient = []
        for order in range(count + 1):
            n_coefficient = n_coefficients.get(n_minimum + order, poly("0"))
            pairs = [(n_coefficient, d0)]
            for index in range(1, order + 1):
                qn, qd = quotient[order - index]
                pairs.append((-d_coefficients.get(d_minimum + index, poly("0")) * qn, d0 * qd))
            value = exact_sum("regulator_recurrence_" + str(order), pairs)
            quotient.append(value)
            residual = [(-n_coefficient, poly("1"))]
            for index in range(order + 1):
                qn, qd = quotient[order - index]
                residual.append((d_coefficients.get(d_minimum + index, poly("0")) * qn, qd))
            residual_numerator, unused = exact_sum("regulator_residual_" + str(order), residual)
            assert residual_numerator == 0
            residual_checks.append(True)
            rows.append({"power": leading + order, "numerator": str(value[0]), "denominator": str(value[1])})
            print("REGULATOR_SERIES_COEFFICIENT", order, count, round(time.monotonic() - started, 3), flush=True)
    else:
        leading = None
        count = -1
    assert len(rows) == max(0, count + 1) and all(residual_checks)
    answer = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-regulator-series-output-v1",
              "source_sha256": digest(Path(__file__)), "input_sha256": digest(input_path),
              "base_backend_sha256": digest(BASE), "flint_version": backend.flint.__version__,
              "exact_polynomial_reconstruction": True,
              "complete_retained_residual_reconstruction": True,
              "maximum_power": maximum, "leading_power": leading,
              "seconds": time.monotonic() - started, "coefficients": rows}
    temporary = output_path.with_suffix(output_path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(answer))
    os.replace(temporary, output_path)
    print("PASS: exact regulator recurrence and residual reconstruction", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```wolfram
localRecoilTerms[rational_]:=Module[
 {factors,functions,genericFactors,generic,rawGeneric,rawTerms,terms},
 factors=If[Head[rational]===Times,List@@rational,{rational}];
 gate["exact native recoil factors retained",Times@@factors===rational];
 functions=Table[Unique["recoilFactor$"],{Length[factors]}];
 genericFactors=(#[s23]&)/@functions;
 generic=s23 D[Times@@genericFactors,s23]/(Times@@genericFactors);
 rawGeneric=(s23 D[#,s23]/#&)/@genericFactors;
 gate["native product rule exactly derived",Together[generic-Total[rawGeneric]]===0];
 rawTerms=(s23 D[#,s23]/#&)/@factors;
 terms=Map[bounded[Cancel[#],"factor derivative cancellation"]&,rawTerms];
 gate["each factor derivative exactly reconstructed",And@@MapThread[
  bounded[Cancel[Together[#1-#2]]===0,"factor derivative reconstruction"]&,{terms,rawTerms}]];
 Print["RECOIL_FACTOR_TERMS count ",Length[terms]," rational_bytes ",ByteCount[rational],
  " terms_bytes ",ByteCount[terms]];
 terms];
(* Sum the exact native recoil derivative with the accepted polynomial backend. *)
localRecoilRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];
localRecoilSource=ExpandFileName[$InputFileName];
localExactRecoilRatio[rational_]:=Module[
 {backendPath,basePath,review,reviewReceipt,backendHash,baseHash,identity,cacheRoot,cacheFile,saved,
```

## misc/s31_sum_recoil_polynomials.py

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-167", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3043, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s31_sum_recoil_polynomials.py", "sha256": "958d2da4c3048340c7cf8f18a389a6835bf43ee7535ab8bbaa393427f17ac35b"} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reduce native derivative terms using the accepted exact polynomial sum."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

BASE = Path(__file__).with_name("s18_sum_exact_polynomials.py")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    input_path, output_path = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    payload = json.loads(input_path.read_text())
    assert payload["schema"] == "polarized-sidis-recoil-polynomial-input-v1"
    assert payload["base_backend_sha256"] == digest(BASE)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("accepted_polynomial_backend", BASE)
    backend = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(backend)
    assert backend.flint.__version__ == "0.8.0"
    context = backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly_ctx.get(tuple(payload["variables"]), "lex")
    poly = lambda text: backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly(text, context)
    started = time.monotonic()
    factor_cache = {}

    def factor(value):
        key = str(value)
        if key not in factor_cache:
            unit, factors = value.factor()
            reconstructed = poly(str(unit))
            for atom, power in factors:
                assert isinstance(power, int) and power > 0
                reconstructed *= atom ** power
            assert reconstructed == value
            factor_cache[key] = (str(unit), [[str(p), n] for p, n in factors])
        return factor_cache[key]

    terms = []
    for row in payload["terms"]:
        numerator, denominator = poly(row["numerator"]), poly(row["denominator"])
        assert denominator != 0
        unit, factors = factor(denominator)
        terms.append({"numerator": str(numerator), "denominator": str(denominator),
                      "unit": unit, "factors": factors})
    result = backend.sum_case({"label": "recoil_derivative", "variables": payload["variables"], "terms": terms})
    assert result["exact_termwise_reconstruction_passed"]
    factored = {}
    for name in ("numerator", "denominator"):
        value = poly(result[name])
        if value == 0:
            factored[name] = "0"
        else:
            unit, factors = factor(value)
            factored[name] = "(" + unit + ")" + "".join("*(" + p + ")^" + str(n) for p, n in factors)
        assert poly(factored[name]) == value
    answer = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-recoil-polynomial-output-v1",
              "source_sha256": digest(Path(__file__)), "input_sha256": digest(input_path),
              "base_backend_sha256": digest(BASE), "flint_version": backend.flint.__version__,
              "factored_output_reconstruction": True, "result": result,
              "factored": factored, "seconds": time.monotonic() - started}
    temporary = output_path.with_suffix(output_path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(answer))
    os.replace(temporary, output_path)
```

```wolfram
 gate["exact pole result reload",Get[resultPath]===result];

 Export[FileNameJoin[{out,"s35_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"own_seconds"->controlSeconds,
  "actual_seconds"->actualSeconds,"pole_cancellation_resolved"->result["PoleCancellationResolved"]|>,"RawJSON"];
 Print["PASS: exact Hgg finite pole sum validated"];Quit[0]];
```

```wolfram
gate["unchanged native assembly source",StringTrim[s14ReviewReconstructed]===s14ReviewText];

uPosition=First[FirstPosition[basis["SpinLabels"],"U"]];

serialized="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[result],InputForm]<>"]\n";
gate["bounded final comparison capture",StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];
path=FileNameJoin[{out,"s37_result.wl"}];Export[path,serialized,"Text"];
```

## misc/s38_exact_Hgg_hat_comparison.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-175", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 8614, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s38_exact_Hgg_hat_comparison.wls", "sha256": "4cdc074e176257463c9b12fe42a07a0636f16e8fca8073e5ce11ec70767a9157"} -->
```wolfram

(* Exact reference comparison without expanding kinematic numerator polynomials. *)
localHatSumRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]];
localHatSumSource=ExpandFileName[$InputFileName];
Get[FileNameJoin[{localHatSumRoot,"misc","s31_exact_Hgg_recoil_sum.wls"}]];

localHatGroupedBackendReady=False;
localHatInstallBackend[]:=Module[{backendPath,receiptPath,receipt,proofPath,definitions,candidate},
 If[TrueQ[localHatGroupedBackendReady],Return[True]];
 backendPath=FileNameJoin[{localHatSumRoot,"misc","s39_grouped_hat_polynomials.py"}];
 receiptPath=FileNameJoin[{localHatSumRoot,"misc","s39_result","s39_execution.json"}];
 proofPath=FileNameJoin[{localHatSumRoot,"misc","s39_result","s39_result.json"}];
 receipt=Import[receiptPath,"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted grouped actual polynomial backend",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
  receipt["source_sha256"]===IntegerString[FileHash[backendPath,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  receipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s39_result/s39_result.json"]===IntegerString[FileHash[proofPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 definitions=DownValues[localExactRecoilRatio];
 gate["unique accepted native backend path",Count[definitions,"s31_sum_recoil_polynomials.py",Infinity]===1];
 candidate=definitions/."s31_sum_recoil_polynomials.py"->"s39_grouped_hat_polynomials.py";
 gate["entire native polynomial transfer retained",
  (candidate/."s39_grouped_hat_polynomials.py"->"s31_sum_recoil_polynomials.py")===definitions];
 DownValues[localExactRecoilRatio]=candidate;localHatGroupedBackendReady=True;True];

localHatRationalTerms[input_]:=Module[
 {denominators,denSymbols,denRules,reverseDen,tagged,pattern,coefficients={},coefficientSymbols={},
  index=<||>,cut,skeleton,expanded,terms,key,position,value,restore},
 denominators=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[input,p:Power[base_,n_Integer]/;n<0&&!NumberQ[base]:>p,Infinity]];
 If[denominators==={},Return[{input}]];
 denSymbols=Table[Symbol["Global`hatDenAtom"<>ToString[i]],{i,Length[denominators]}];
 gate["unassigned denominator generators",AllTrue[denSymbols,OwnValues[#]==={}&]];
 denRules=Thread[denominators->denSymbols];reverseDen=Reverse/@denRules;
 tagged=input/.denRules;
 gate["exact denominator-generator restoration",(tagged/.reverseDen)===input];
 pattern=Alternatives@@denSymbols;
 cut[x_]:=If[FreeQ[x,pattern],
   If[NumberQ[x],Return[x]];
   key=Hash[x,"SHA256"];
   If[KeyExistsQ[index,key],position=index[key];gate["exact repeated opaque coefficient",coefficients[[position]]===x],
    AppendTo[coefficients,x];position=Length[coefficients];AssociateTo[index,key->position];
    AppendTo[coefficientSymbols,Symbol["Global`hatCoefficientAtom"<>ToString[position]]]];
   coefficientSymbols[[position]],
   If[AtomQ[x],x,Map[cut,x]]];
 skeleton=cut[tagged];Clear[cut];
 gate["unassigned opaque polynomial generators",AllTrue[coefficientSymbols,OwnValues[#]==={}&]];
 restore=Thread[coefficientSymbols->coefficients];
 gate["exact full opaque-coefficient restoration",(skeleton/.restore)===tagged];
 expanded=Expand[skeleton];
 gate["exact native distributive reconstruction",Expand[expanded-skeleton]===0];
 terms=If[Head[expanded]===Plus,List@@expanded,{expanded}];
 terms=(terms/.restore)/.reverseDen;
 Print["FACTORED_REFERENCE_TERMS count ",Length[terms]," input_bytes ",ByteCount[input],
  " skeleton_bytes ",ByteCount[skeleton]," terms_bytes ",ByteCount[terms]];
 terms];

localHatExactSum[input_]:=Module[{atoms,symbols,rules,reverse,generic,answer},
 localHatInstallBackend[];
 If[NumberQ[input],Return[input]];
 atoms=DeleteDuplicates[Join[
  Cases[input,_Log|_PolyLog|_ArcTan|_ArcTanh|_Re|_Im|_Abs,Infinity],
  Cases[input,p_Power/;!IntegerQ[p[[2]]],Infinity],Cases[input,_Complex,Infinity]]];
 symbols=Table[Symbol["Global`hatFunctionAtom"<>ToString[i]],{i,Length[atoms]}];
 gate["unassigned exact functional generators",AllTrue[symbols,OwnValues[#]==={}&]];
 rules=Thread[atoms->symbols];reverse=Reverse/@rules;generic=input/.rules;
 gate["exact full functional-atom restoration",(generic/.reverse)===input];
 answer=Block[{localRecoilSource=localHatSumSource,localRecoilTerms},
  localRecoilTerms[value_]:=localHatRationalTerms[value];
  localExactRecoilRatio[generic]];
 answer=answer/.reverse;
 gate["all physical functional generators restored",FreeQ[answer,Alternatives@@symbols]];
 answer];

localHatExactReduce[value_,assumptions_]:=Module[{expression,arguments,rules},
 expression=localHatExactSum[value];
 Print["REFERENCE_PRECOMPRESSION input_bytes ",ByteCount[value]," output_bytes ",ByteCount[expression]];
 expression=Refine[expression,assumptions];
 arguments=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[expression,Log[arg_]:>arg,Infinity]];
 rules=Thread[(Log/@arguments)->(Log[Factor[#]]&/@arguments)];
 expression=PowerExpand[expression/.rules,Assumptions->assumptions];
 localHatExactSum[expression]];

If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_VALIDATE_HAT_SUM"]==="1",
 $HistoryLength=0;$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
 root=localHatSumRoot;SetDirectory[root];checks=<||>;
 gate[n_,x_]:=If[TrueQ[x],If[!KeyExistsQ[checks,n],Print["PASS: ",n]];
  AssociateTo[checks,n->True],Print["FAIL: ",n];Quit[1]];
 SetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];
 bounded[x_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[x,1200,
  gate[ToString[label]<>" time",False]],2*1024^3,gate[ToString[label]<>" memory",False]];
 capturePath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s37_result","s37_result.wl"}];
 receipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s37_result","s37_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted exact final comparison capture",TrueQ[receipt["passed"]]&&
  receipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s37_result/s37_result.wl"]===
  IntegerString[FileHash[capturePath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 capture=Get[capturePath];
 gate["accepted comparison runtime and complete input",TrueQ[capture["Accepted"]]&&And@@Values[capture["Checks"]]&&
  capture["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}&&
  capture["Actual"]-capture["Expected"]===capture["Difference"]];
 capture=KeyDrop[capture,{"Actual","Expected"}];ClearSystemCache[];
 controlPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s35_result","s35_result.wl"}];
 controlReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s35_result","s35_execution.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted nonzero scalar control",TrueQ[controlReceipt["passed"]]&&
  controlReceipt["result_sha256"]["misc/s35_result/s35_result.wl"]===IntegerString[FileHash[controlPath,"SHA256"],16,64]];
 control=Get[controlPath];functions=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[capture["Difference"],_Log,Infinity]];
 controlFunction=SelectFirst[functions,!FreeQ[#,mu2]&,Missing["NoActualScaleLog"]];
 gate["actual logarithmic control factor",!MissingQ[controlFunction]&&control["OwnValue"]=!=0];
 controlInput=control["OwnInput"] controlFunction;controlExpected=control["OwnValue"] controlFunction;
 {controlSeconds,controlValue}=AbsoluteTiming[localHatExactReduce[controlInput,capture["Assumptions"]]];
 gate["complete accepted nonzero functional control",bounded[
  FullSimplify[Factor[Together[controlValue-controlExpected]],capture["Assumptions"]],"functional control"]===0];
 Print["REFERENCE_SUM_CONTROL seconds ",controlSeconds," bytes ",ByteCount[controlValue]];
 {actualSeconds,actualValue}=AbsoluteTiming[localHatExactReduce[capture["Difference"],capture["Assumptions"]]];
 Print["REFERENCE_SUM_ACTUAL seconds ",actualSeconds," input_bytes ",ByteCount[capture["Difference"]],
  " output_bytes ",ByteCount[actualValue]];
 If[ByteCount[actualValue]<16384,Print["REFERENCE_REDUCED_EQUATION ",InputForm[actualValue]]];
 result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-exact-hat-comparison-v1",
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[localHatSumSource,"SHA256"],"CaptureHash"->FileHash[capturePath,"SHA256"],
  "ControlHash"->FileHash[controlPath,"SHA256"],"ControlValue"->controlValue,
  "ControlSeconds"->controlSeconds,"ActualValue"->actualValue,"ActualSeconds"->actualSeconds,
  "Checks"->checks,"NativeVersions"->{$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}|>;
 out=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s38_result"}];If[!DirectoryQ[out],CreateDirectory[out]];
 path=FileNameJoin[{out,"s38_result.wl"}];
 Export[path,"Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[result],InputForm]<>"]\n","Text"];
 gate["exact reference sum proof reload",Get[path]===result];
 {zeroSeconds,isZero}=AbsoluteTiming[actualValue===0||
  bounded[FullSimplify[actualValue,capture["Assumptions"]],"remaining exact comparison"]===0];
 gate["actual original final F1 comparison",isZero];
 Export[FileNameJoin[{out,"s38_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,"actual_seconds"->actualSeconds,
  "remaining_zero_seconds"->zeroSeconds,"reference_comparison_passed"->isZero|>,"RawJSON"];
 Print["PASS: exact Hgg final reference comparison"];Quit[0]];


```

```wolfram
 {denominators,denSymbols,denRules,reverseDen,tagged,pattern,coefficients={},coefficientSymbols={},
  index=<||>,cut,skeleton,expanded,terms,key,position,value,restore},

 If[denominators==={},Return[{input}]];

 denRules=Thread[denominators->denSymbols];reverseDen=Reverse/@denRules;

 pattern=Alternatives@@denSymbols;

    AppendTo[coefficients,x];position=Length[coefficients];AssociateTo[index,key->position];
    AppendTo[coefficientSymbols,Symbol["Global`hatCoefficientAtom"<>ToString[position]]]];
   coefficientSymbols[[position]],
   If[AtomQ[x],x,Map[cut,x]]];

 restore=Thread[coefficientSymbols->coefficients];

 gate["exact native distributive reconstruction",Expand[expanded-skeleton]===0];
 terms=If[Head[expanded]===Plus,List@@expanded,{expanded}];

 Print["FACTORED_REFERENCE_TERMS count ",Length[terms]," input_bytes ",ByteCount[input],
  " skeleton_bytes ",ByteCount[skeleton]," terms_bytes ",ByteCount[terms]];
 terms];

localHatExactSum[input_]:=Module[{atoms,symbols,rules,reverse,generic,answer},

 bounded[x_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[x,1200,

  " output_bytes ",ByteCount[actualValue]];
 If[ByteCount[actualValue]<16384,Print["REFERENCE_REDUCED_EQUATION ",InputForm[actualValue]]];
 result=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-exact-hat-comparison-v1",
  "SourceHash"->FileHash[localHatSumSource,"SHA256"],"CaptureHash"->FileHash[capturePath,"SHA256"],
  "ControlHash"->FileHash[controlPath,"SHA256"],"ControlValue"->controlValue,
```

## misc/s39_grouped_hat_polynomials.py

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-178", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 4101, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s39_grouped_hat_polynomials.py", "sha256": "cbe8f63c1fa9a704f11d96b24b70dcf247851f158113a859ef5e264868832602"} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exactly group identical native denominators before the accepted polynomial sum."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

BASE = Path(__file__).with_name("s18_sum_exact_polynomials.py")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    input_path, output_path = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    payload = json.loads(input_path.read_text())
    assert payload["schema"] == "polarized-sidis-recoil-polynomial-input-v1"
    assert payload["base_backend_sha256"] == digest(BASE)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("accepted_polynomial_backend", BASE)
    backend = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(backend)
    assert backend.flint.__version__ == "0.8.0"
    context = backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly_ctx.get(tuple(payload["variables"]), "lex")
    poly = lambda text: backend.flint.fmpq_mpoly(text, context)
    started = time.monotonic()
    grouped = {}
    visited = 0
    for row in payload["terms"]:
        numerator = poly(row["numerator"])
        key = row["denominator"]
        previous = grouped.get(key, poly("0"))
        following = previous + numerator
        assert following - previous == numerator
        grouped[key] = following
        visited += 1
    assert visited == len(payload["terms"])
    print("EXACT_DENOMINATOR_GROUPS", visited, len(grouped),
          round(time.monotonic() - started, 3), flush=True)
    factor_cache = {}

    def factor(value):
        key = str(value)
        if key not in factor_cache:
            unit, factors = value.factor()
            reconstructed = poly(str(unit))
            for atom, power in factors:
                assert isinstance(power, int) and power > 0
                reconstructed *= atom ** power
            assert reconstructed == value
            factor_cache[key] = (str(unit), [[str(p), n] for p, n in factors])
        return factor_cache[key]

    terms = []
    for index, (denominator_text, numerator) in enumerate(grouped.items(), 1):
        denominator = poly(denominator_text)
        assert denominator != 0
        if numerator != 0:
            unit, factors = factor(denominator)
            terms.append({"numerator": str(numerator), "denominator": str(denominator),
                          "unit": unit, "factors": factors})
        if index % 16 == 0 or index == len(grouped):
            print("EXACT_GROUP_PREPARATION", index, len(grouped), len(terms),
                  round(time.monotonic() - started, 3), flush=True)
    result = backend.sum_case({"label": "recoil_derivative",
                               "variables": payload["variables"], "terms": terms})
    assert result["exact_termwise_reconstruction_passed"]
    assert result["term_count"] == len(terms)
    result["grouped_term_count"] = result["term_count"]
    result["native_denominator_groups"] = len(grouped)
    result["term_count"] = visited
    result["exact_native_group_reconstruction_passed"] = True
    factored = {}
    for name in ("numerator", "denominator"):
        value = poly(result[name])
        if value == 0:
            factored[name] = "0"
        else:
            unit, factors = factor(value)
            factored[name] = "(" + unit + ")" + "".join(
                "*(" + p + ")^" + str(n) for p, n in factors)
        assert poly(factored[name]) == value
    answer = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-recoil-polynomial-output-v1",
              "source_sha256": digest(Path(__file__)), "input_sha256": digest(input_path),
              "base_backend_sha256": digest(BASE), "flint_version": backend.flint.__version__,
              "factored_output_reconstruction": True, "result": result,
              "factored": factored, "seconds": time.monotonic() - started}
    temporary = output_path.with_suffix(output_path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(answer))
    os.replace(temporary, output_path)
    print("PASS: exact grouped denominator polynomial sum", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```wolfram
  Print["FAIL: ",n];Quit[1]];

  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"],16,64]===#2]&,config["input_sha256"]];
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-190", "appendix": "misc/README_sources.md", "bytes": 6253, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "misc/s40_result/reference/leaf_diagnostic/s40_chunked_native_record.wls", "sha256": "3b4f0bce075cbedb60ff183d53b3440706720099d2981181ae7bfffdc777476f"} -->
```wolfram
(* Bounded native storage; mathematical expressions and schemas are unchanged. *)
localChunkSource=ExpandFileName[$InputFileName];
localChunkRoot=DirectoryName[DirectoryName[localChunkSource]];
localChunkWrite[value_,path_]:=Module[
 {directory,partDirectory,relative,manifest=<||>,originals=<||>,pack,intern,template,
  serialized,index,loader,temporary,bytesBefore=MemoryInUse[],threshold=32*1024^2},
 gate["native chunk marker is unassigned",OwnValues[Global`polarizedNativeChunk]==={}&&
  DownValues[Global`polarizedNativeChunk]==={}&&FreeQ[value,Global`polarizedNativeChunk]];
 directory=DirectoryName[path];If[!DirectoryQ[directory],CreateDirectory[directory,CreateIntermediateDirectories->True]];
 relative=FileBaseName[path]<>"_parts";partDirectory=FileNameJoin[{directory,relative}];
 If[!DirectoryQ[partDirectory],CreateDirectory[partDirectory]];
 intern[x_]:=Module[{key,file,serial,reloaded},
  key=IntegerString[Hash[x,"SHA256"],16,64];
  If[KeyExistsQ[originals,key],
   gate["exact repeated native chunk",originals[key]===x],
   AssociateTo[originals,key->x];file=FileNameJoin[{partDirectory,key<>".wl"}];
   serial="Uncompress["<>ToString[Compress[x],InputForm]<>"]\n";
   gate["bounded native chunk",StringLength[serial]<128*1024^2];
   Export[file<>".tmp",serial,"Text"];Clear[serial];ClearSystemCache[];
   reloaded=Get[file<>".tmp"];
   gate["exact native chunk reload",reloaded===x];Clear[reloaded];ClearSystemCache[];
   RenameFile[file<>".tmp",file,OverwriteTarget->True];
   AssociateTo[manifest,key-><|"File"->FileNameJoin[{relative,key<>".wl"}],
    "SHA256"->IntegerString[FileHash[file,"SHA256"],16,64]|>]];
  Global`polarizedNativeChunk[key]];
 pack[x_]:=If[MemberQ[{Association,List},Head[x]]&&ByteCount[x]>threshold,Map[pack,x],intern[x]];
 template=pack[value];
 localChunkReconstructed=template/.HoldPattern[Global`polarizedNativeChunk[key_String]]:>originals[key];
 If[localChunkReconstructed=!=value,
  localChunkDifference[a_,b_,p_]:=If[a===b,{},Which[
   AssociationQ[a]&&AssociationQ[b]&&Keys[a]===Keys[b],Flatten[KeyValueMap[localChunkDifference[#2,b[#1],Append[p,#1]]&,a],1],
   ListQ[a]&&ListQ[b]&&Length[a]===Length[b],Flatten[MapIndexed[localChunkDifference[#1,Extract[b,#2],Join[p,#2]]&,a],1],
   True,{<|"Path"->ToString[p,InputForm],"Heads"->ToString[{Head[a],Head[b]},InputForm],"Bytes"->{ByteCount[a],ByteCount[b]},
    "MarkerCount"->Count[a,_Global`polarizedNativeChunk,Infinity],"MissingCount"->Count[a,_Missing,Infinity],
    "SmallActual"->If[ByteCount[a]<2048,ToString[a,InputForm],"large"]|>}]];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{directory,"s40_reconstruction_difference.json"}],localChunkDifference[localChunkReconstructed,value,{}],"RawJSON"]];
 Clear[localChunkReconstructed,localChunkDifference];
 gate["entire native record exactly reconstructs",
  (template/.HoldPattern[Global`polarizedNativeChunk[key_String]]:>originals[key])===value];
 index=<|"Schema"->"polarized-sidis-chunked-native-v1","Template"->template,"Parts"->manifest,
  "WriterSHA256"->IntegerString[FileHash[localChunkSource,"SHA256"],16,64]|>;
 loader="Module[{dir=DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]],index=Uncompress[INDEX],parts=<||>,load,result},"<>
  "load[key_String]:=If[KeyExistsQ[parts,key],parts[key],Module[{row,file,v},"<>
  "row=Lookup[index[\"Parts\"],key,Missing[\"Part\"]];If[MissingQ[row],Throw[$Failed,\"NativeChunks\"]];"<>
  "file=FileNameJoin[{dir,row[\"File\"]}];If[!FileExistsQ[file]||"<>
  "IntegerString[FileHash[file,\"SHA256\"],16,64]=!=row[\"SHA256\"],Throw[$Failed,\"NativeChunks\"]];"<>
  "v=Get[file];If[v===$Failed||v===$Aborted,Throw[$Failed,\"NativeChunks\"]];AssociateTo[parts,key->v];v]];"<>
  "Catch[result=index[\"Template\"]/.HoldPattern[Global`polarizedNativeChunk[key_String]]:>load[key];"<>
  "If[!FreeQ[result,Global`polarizedNativeChunk],Throw[$Failed,\"NativeChunks\"]];result,\"NativeChunks\"]]\n";
 gate["unique native manifest insertion",StringCount[loader,"INDEX"]===1];
 serialized=StringReplace[loader,"INDEX"->ToString[Compress[index],InputForm]];
 gate["bounded complete native index",SyntaxQ[serialized]&&StringLength[serialized]<128*1024^2];
 temporary=path<>".tmp";Export[temporary,serialized,"Text"];
 gate["exact native index bytes",ReadString[temporary]===serialized];
 RenameFile[temporary,path,OverwriteTarget->True];
 Print["NATIVE_CHUNK_RECORD ",FileNameTake[path]," pieces ",Length[manifest],
  " memory_before ",bytesBefore," memory_after ",MemoryInUse[]];
 <|"Path"->path,"Parts"->manifest,"WriterSHA256"->index["WriterSHA256"]|>];

If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_VALIDATE_CHUNK_WRITER"]==="1",
 $HistoryLength=0;$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
 SetDirectory[localChunkRoot];root=localChunkRoot;checks=<||>;
 gate[n_,x_]:=If[TrueQ[x],If[!KeyExistsQ[checks,n],Print["PASS: ",n]];AssociateTo[checks,n->True],
  Print["FAIL: ",n];Quit[1]];
 config=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s40_inputs.json"}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["bound entire native writer",config["source_sha256"]===IntegerString[FileHash[localChunkSource,"SHA256"],16,64]&&
  SyntaxQ[ReadString[localChunkSource]]];
 KeyValueMap[gate["pinned chunk-writer input "<>#1,
  IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,#1}],"SHA256"],16,64]===#2]&,config["input_sha256"]];
 own=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s35_result","s35_result.wl"}]];
 actual=Get[FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s37_result","s37_result.wl"}]];
 gate["accepted native own and actual inputs",And@@Values[own["Checks"]]&&And@@Values[actual["Checks"]]];
 value=<|"Own"->own,"Actual"->actual|>;Clear[own,actual];ClearSystemCache[];
 out=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s40_result"}];If[!DirectoryQ[out],CreateDirectory[out]];
 path=FileNameJoin[{out,"s40_roundtrip.wl"}];
 {seconds,storage}=AbsoluteTiming[localChunkWrite[value,path]];
 gate["actual record exercises bounded pieces",Length[storage["Parts"]]>1];
 gate["entire actual native reader roundtrip",Get[path]===value];
 Export[FileNameJoin[{out,"s40_checks.json"}],<|"checks"->checks,
  "source_sha256"->IntegerString[FileHash[localChunkSource,"SHA256"],16,64],
  "seconds"->seconds,"part_count"->Length[storage["Parts"]],"parts"->storage["Parts"],
  "native_versions"->{$Version,FeynCalc`$FeynCalcVersion}|>,"RawJSON"];
 Print["PASS: bounded native record writer"];Quit[0]];
```
